attributes.title: Greater New York Dental Meeting 2026
attributes.summary:
The Greater New York Dental Meeting runs November 27 to December 1, 2026, at the Javits Center in Manhattan. The scientific program covers all five days, while the exhibit floor is open November 29 to December 1. The organizer advertises more than six hours of free CE every day, alongside paid courses and hands-on workshops.

The meeting is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider and an AGD PACE Program Provider. Credit equals the number of course hours; attendees claim it in the online CE registry with the code given in each session, and the registry stays open until March 2027. Course listings mark many sessions as recommended for hygienists as well as dentists.

Pre-registration is free until November 26, 2026, and badges are not mailed. Fees for individual paid courses are listed per course on the official site.

attributes.title: RSNA 2026
attributes.summary:
RSNA 2026, the Radiological Society of North America's annual meeting, runs November 29 to December 3, 2026, in Chicago, with technical exhibits open November 29 to December 2. The theme is "At the Center of Care".

The meeting is held at McCormick Place. Registration is open: Full Access members attend at no extra charge, Standard members pay $600 and members-in-training $200, while non-member physicians, physicists and scientists pay $2,525 for in-person plus virtual access, $1,505 in person only or $1,120 virtual only. Recordings stay available until February 26, 2027. RSNA offers discounted rates at partner hotels; the CME credit total is not stated on the pages we checked. RSNA has also announced that its 2027 meeting moves two weeks earlier, to November 14 to 18, 2027.

attributes.title: ASHA Autism Online Conference (Nov-Dec 2026)
attributes.summary: ASHA holds an 18-day online conference from November 30 to December 17, 2026, on practical, evidence-based and neurodiversity-affirming strategies for work with autistic children and adolescents. It combines on-demand recorded sessions with half-hour live chats. ASHA lists up to 2.6 ASHA CEUs (26 professional development hours).

attributes.title: Forward in Health: AI in Healthcare
attributes.credits_text: 4.25 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 4.25 AAPA Cat 1 · 4.25 ANCC CH · 4.25 ACPE
attributes.organizer: University of Wisconsin-Madison Interprofessional Continuing Education Partnership
attributes.summary:
The organizer lists a $1 cost for this 4.25-credit morning, which weighs patient safety against the access and capacity gains AI may bring. It suits clinicians whose organizations are starting to adopt AI tools and who want to hear from clinicians and scientists.

Registration opened November 2, 2026. Attendance is in person at the DeLuca Forum.

attributes.title: Primary Care Pediatrics 2026
attributes.venue: MGB Conference Center at Assembly Row
attributes.summary:
Primary Care Pediatrics runs December 2 to 4, 2026, at the MGB Conference Center at Assembly Row in Somerville, Massachusetts, just outside Boston; participants can also join live online. It is aimed at pediatric primary care physicians, PAs, NPs and trainees.

The course carries 20.5 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and 20.5 ABP MOC points, including 3.25 Massachusetts risk management credits. Physicians pay $650 and nurses, NPs, PAs and residents $400, with $100 off for virtual attendance. A room block at The Row Hotel costs $258 per night until November 1, 2026.

attributes.title: Pri-Med Phoenix 2026
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · AANP CE · AANP Pharm
attributes.summary: Pri-Med's Phoenix regional conference runs December 2 and 3, 2026, at the Phoenix Convention Center. The two days cover common primary care problems, with up to 13 CME/CE credits as AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and AANP contact hours, plus pharmacology credit depending on the sessions chosen. The advance rate is $99.

attributes.title: PSCA Conference 2026: Empowered Counselors. Thriving Students.
attributes.series: Pennsylvania School Counselors Association Annual Conference
attributes.venue: The Penn Stater Hotel & Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The Pennsylvania School Counselors Association holds its 2026 annual conference from December 2 to 4 at The Penn Stater Hotel & Convention Center in State College. The theme is "Empowered Counselors. Thriving Students." Carolyn Stone opens with a December 2 pre-conference on legal literacy and ethical practice in school counseling, John Hodge gives the December 3 keynote, and Terri Tchorzynski closes on December 4 with a session on building proactive systems in school counseling programs.

The conference page lists Act 48 hours for Pennsylvania educators, NCC hours and continuing education units through Lindenwood University, with 6 CEUs awarded for the annual conference. The number of NCC hours is not stated; syllabus and CEU questions go to Lindenwood's K-12 professional development office.

The full conference costs $350 for professional members, $250 for student, retiree and lifetime members and $450 for non-members, with a $50 discount for early registration that ended October 15. A Thursday-only pass, the pre-conference and the recognition dinner are sold separately. The page notes that online registration has closed but on-site registration is accepted. The hotel block at $154 per night closed on November 2, and refunds are not available after that date.

attributes.title: 51st Annual PSPA Fall CME Conference
attributes.summary:
The 51st PSPA Fall CME Conference takes place December 2 to 5, 2026, at the Hershey Lodge in Hershey, Pennsylvania. The state society runs it as a general CME meeting for PAs, with lectures plus separate hands-on workshops.

PSPA says it will apply for more than 35 Category 1 CME credits; the final figure is not published yet. The society's room block at the Hershey Lodge was offered at $185 per night through October 30, 2026. Fees are shown only inside the registration system, so we do not list them here.

attributes.title: Fetch Long Beach Veterinary Conference 2026
attributes.summary:
Fetch Long Beach 2026 takes place December 3 to 5, 2026, at the Long Beach Convention & Entertainment Center in California. dvm360 lists more than 70 CE sessions spread over 25+ learning tracks, including new 30-minute sessions worth half a credit each, plus an exhibit hall.

Three hands-on labs (tibial tuberosity advancement, patellar luxation and multimodal rehabilitation) need a separate registration. dvm360 lists 14 CE hours per person (seven on each of December 4 and 5), or up to 16 with sponsored meal sessions, pending RACE approval. Registration prices are not shown on the public pages; early-bird pricing ended October 2, 2026.

attributes.title: 2026 Scottsdale Headache Symposium
attributes.summary:
This December 3 to 6, 2026 course is aimed at clinicians who treat headache in everyday practice. Earlier editions have included hands-on pre-courses, such as a physical exam master class.

The society lists up to 21 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits for the live activity, up to 19 for the on-demand activity and up to 19 for the on-demand pre-courses. The fees are not published on the page we checked, so confirm them with the society.

attributes.title: The Gulf Atlantic Veterinary Conference 2026
attributes.venue: Fort Lauderdale Marriott Harbor Beach Resort & Spa
attributes.summary:
The Gulf Atlantic Veterinary Conference is the Florida VMA's main small animal and exotics meeting, held December 3 to 6, 2026 (lectures December 3 to 5, an off-site wet lab on December 6), at the Fort Lauderdale Marriott Harbor Beach Resort & Spa. Registration covers lectures, networking events and the exhibit hall; wet labs and hotel rooms are booked separately.

FVMA says the program is approved for CE in jurisdictions that recognize RACE, with hours reported to AAVSB RACEtrack. Each 50-minute lecture counts as one credit; veterinarians can earn up to 24 and veterinary technicians up to 16, chosen from about 188 hours of DVM content and 68 hours of technician content.

The group hotel rate of $299 per night applies to bookings made before November 18, 2026. Registration fees were not visible on the pages we checked.

attributes.title: AES 2026 Annual Meeting
attributes.credits_text: 28 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 28 ANCC CH · 28 ACPE
attributes.summary:
The American Epilepsy Society holds its 2026 Annual Meeting December 4 to 8 in Denver, with an on-demand Digital Select option for those who cannot attend.

AES lists 28 CME credits, 28 nursing CE hours and 28 pharmacy CE hours for the live meeting, and notes the totals may change. The society is ACCME-accredited and the activity is approved for AMA PRA Category 1 Credit.

The venue and registration fees were not shown on the page we checked.

attributes.title: 2026 AOTA Children & Youth Specialty Conference
attributes.summary: AOTA's pediatric specialty conference meets at the Royal Sonesta New Orleans on December 4-5, 2026, with preconference sessions on December 3 and a virtual option. Topics include sensory regulation, feeding, functional cognition, play, childhood trauma and sleep. AOTA lists up to 10.75 contact hours in person and up to 17.5 contact hours for virtual attendees.

attributes.title: SKY Breath Meditation Course for Clinicians, Norcross 2026
attributes.series: Healing Breaths SKY Program for Healthcare Professionals
attributes.cme_provider: NYU Grossman School of Medicine (physician credit, as stated by the organizer at healingbreaths.org/individuals)
attributes.summary: Three 3-hour in-person sessions (Fri 6:30 to 9:30 pm, Sat and Sun 9:30 am to 12:30 pm ET). The organizer states 1 CME/CE credit per class hour: physicians through NYU Grossman School of Medicine, nurses through the American Holistic Nurses Association, dentists through the Academy of General Dentistry; PAs and NPs also receive 1 credit per hour.

attributes.title: Psych Congress PA Institute 2026
attributes.summary:
The Psych Congress PA Institute takes place December 4 to 6, 2026, in Orlando, Florida. HMP Global designs it for psychiatric PAs and PAs interested in psychiatry.

The venue, credit hours and fees were not listed on the Psych Congress events page when we checked.

attributes.title: NJOTA 2026 Annual Conference
attributes.summary: NJOTA moves its 2026 annual conference online, on December 5, 2026 from 9:00 am to 4:00 pm. The program looks at practice areas named in New Jersey's updated Occupational Therapy Practice Act, including maternal health, women's health, LGBTQIA+ health, behavioral health, disaster preparedness and population health.

attributes.title: ASHP Midyear Clinical Meeting & Exhibition 2026
attributes.venue: Orange County Convention Center, West Building
attributes.cme_provider: American Society of Health-System Pharmacists (ACPE-accredited provider)
attributes.summary:
ASHP's 2026 Midyear Clinical Meeting & Exhibition runs December 6 to 9, 2026, in Orlando, with sessions at the Orange County Convention Center West Building. ASHP expects more than 20,000 pharmacists, technicians, students and industry representatives for clinical education, the exhibition, poster sessions, the Personnel Placement Service and the residency showcase.

ASHP is an ACPE-accredited provider. Pharmacists can earn up to 23.25 contact hours and pharmacy technicians up to 20.75 contact hours; technician sessions carry a "T" in the ACPE number. Board certification clinical sessions and intensive studies are sold as separate $60 recertification packages, and posters carry no CE.

Member full registration is $915 through November 6 and $1,015 from November 7; non-members pay $1,315 and $1,415. Pharmacy technician members pay $375 ($410 from November 7). One-day passes are $425 for members and $625 for non-members. The ASHP hotel block closes November 12, and no refunds are given after November 13, 2026.

attributes.title: Hot Topics in Neonatology 2026
attributes.credits_text: 18 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 18 AAPA Cat 1 · 18 ANCC CH
attributes.summary:
The main conference runs December 7 to 9, 2026, at Gaylord National, with a Neonatal Quality Conference as a paid add-on on December 6. You can attend in person or by live stream, and moving from in-person to streaming carries no fee, a useful fallback for a December trip.

Nemours designates up to 18 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, with ABP MOC, ABS Continuous Certification, AAPA and ANCC credit also listed. The early rate has ended: physicians now pay $925, and nurses, APPs, residents and fellows pay $725. The organizer lists 2027 for December 5 to 8 at the Marriott Marquis.

attributes.title: 72nd AAEP Annual Convention & Trade Show
attributes.summary:
The 72nd AAEP Annual Convention takes place December 7 to 11, 2026, at Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas, with the trade show open December 7 to 10. Unlike earlier years, activities begin on a Monday. In-person registration covers more than 110 hours of equine CE, and a virtual option is also sold.

AAEP says the program has been submitted for RACE approval but is not yet approved; nearly 60 hours are approved by HISA for racetrack veterinarians. Member registration is $775 through December 2 and $875 afterward; non-members pay $1,195 or $1,295. Mandalay Bay is the headquarters hotel.

attributes.title: The Final Countdown: Primary Care Updates & AI for APPs
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: A two-day live virtual conference from NPACE on December 8 and 9, 2026, combining primary care updates with sessions on artificial intelligence for advanced practice providers. NPACE lists 10.0+ CE/CME credits, with the pharmacology share still to be announced. The registration page designates the activity for 12 AAPA Category 1 CME credits.

attributes.title: SABCS 2026
attributes.summary:
SABCS 2026 runs December 8 to 11, 2026, in San Antonio, Texas, with in-person and virtual registration. The program spans breast cancer biology, prevention, diagnosis, treatment and survivorship.

The in-person regular rate is $1,015 through November 2 and $1,065 from November 3; nurses pay $375 and residents or postdocs $265 in the advance period. Virtual rates are tiered by World Bank income group.

The symposium has offered AMA PRA Category 1 Credit in past years, but the 2026 CME details are still pending on the official site, so no credit is listed here.

attributes.title: Fitzgerald 4-Day CE Conference, Las Vegas
attributes.credits_text: AAPA Cat 1 · 24 AANP CE · 15 AANP Pharm
attributes.summary:
Fitzgerald's December conference in Las Vegas runs December 10 to 13, 2026, at the MGM Grand Hotel & Casino. Each of the four days is a stand-alone six-hour module: cardiology and 12-lead ECGs, dermatology, pharmacology and risk reduction, and primary care prescribing for obesity and men's health.

The full program carries 24 AANP contact hours, 15 of them pharmacology. PAs can earn AAPA Category 1 CME through NetCE. The early-bird price is $999 for all four days or $299 per day.

attributes.title: 68th ASH Annual Meeting and Exposition
attributes.summary:
The 68th ASH Annual Meeting and Exposition runs December 12 to 15, 2026, at the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans, with satellite symposia and scientific workshops on December 11. Attendance is possible in person or on ASH's virtual platform, and every registration includes on-demand access.

Advance rates, which ended October 21, 2026, were $1,000 for active members, $1,900 for non-members, $900 for allied health professionals and $175 for trainee members, with longer virtual access costing up to $200 more; late and on-site registration saves less, by up to $100. The hotel reservation deadline is November 11, 2026, and CME/MOC can be claimed through April 9, 2027. ASH did not state a credit total on the pages we checked.

attributes.title: Veterinary Leadership Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
AVMA's Veterinary Leadership Conference 2027 runs January 7 to 9, 2027, at the Sheraton Grand Chicago Riverwalk. The conference mixes CE sessions on leadership with AVMA governance meetings and networking for veterinarians from across the profession.

Attendance costs $400 and registration is open. VLC apparel ordered with registration must be bought by December 5 to arrive in time.

attributes.title: Eastern Food Allergy & Comorbidity Conference 2027
attributes.cme_provider: American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.summary:
A focused meeting on food allergy and related conditions at The Breakers, January 7 to 10, 2027. ACAAI offers up to 17 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits.

The clinician rate is $450 now that the early rate has closed, and the fee is waived for fellows in training. Only full registrants can book the room block, so register first. Refunds drop to 50% from December 8, 2026, and end on December 29.

attributes.title: January 2027 Equine Continuing Education Conference
attributes.organizer: Ohio State University Veterinary Medical Center
attributes.summary:
Ohio State split its old large animal day for 2027: this January session is equine only, and the farm animal program moves to June. CE is complimentary, sponsored by Zoetis Equine, and the page advertises six hours.

The listed schedule runs 8:00 a.m. to 1:10 p.m., which looks short for six hours, so confirm the total with the college if you need exact hours. Speakers and topics are still to come.

attributes.title: Beyond the Bedside: Together We Shape the Story
attributes.summary:
The Siouxland Chapter of AACN holds "Beyond the Bedside: Together We Shape the Story" on Monday, January 11, 2027, at Sanford USD Medical Center in Sioux Falls. Speakers from respiratory therapy, pharmacy, trauma, anesthesia, flight nursing and neurocritical care take part; one listed session covers ICU medication extravasation.

The chapter lists 4.0 CE credits through AACN. Registration is $30 for chapter members and $35 for non-members, $5 less until December 1, 2026.

attributes.title: 2027 AACN Doctoral Education Conference
attributes.organizer: American Association of Colleges of Nursing
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Colleges of Nursing holds its 2027 Doctoral Education Conference from January 12 to 14, 2027, at the Hotel del Coronado on Coronado Island, across the bay from San Diego. It is meant for deans, directors and faculty who teach in PhD and DNP programs and for nurses who lead research programs.

On January 11 there are a PhD pre-conference and a faculty practice pre-conference, the Research Leadership Network program follows on January 12, and a workshop on moving curricula to competency-based education with AI runs January 14 and 15. Attendees earn NCPD credit; AACN has not published the number of hours.

Early registration runs through December 12: $699 for AACN members, $899 for non-members and $350 for full-time students, rising to $799, $999 and $400. Room blocks at the Hotel del Coronado (from $409 plus a resort charge) and the Glorietta Bay Inn (from $199 plus a resort charge) close December 9 and 10, 2026.

attributes.title: 2027 HDA Convention
attributes.summary:
The Hawaii Dental Association's 2027 convention is set for January 13 to 15, 2027, at the Alohilani Resort in Honolulu. It is part of the HDA continuing education program for dentists.

Registration had not opened when we checked, and the program, fees and CE hours are not published yet. The HDA notes that CE requirements are set by the Hawaii Board of Dentistry, not by the association.

attributes.title: Abilities International Accessibility Conference Long Beach 2027
attributes.series: Abilities International Accessibility Conference Los Angeles
attributes.summary: This two-day conference on complex rehab and assistive technology runs January 14-15, 2027 at the Long Beach Convention Center, co-located with Abilities Expo Los Angeles. Three tracks cover assessment and provision, clinical skills workshops and adapted living. The organizer lists 10 hours of continuing education (IACET, CPTA and AOTA CEUs).

attributes.title: Central Ohio Chapter AACN Critical Care Symposium 2027
attributes.series: Central Ohio Chapter AACN Critical Care Symposium
attributes.venue: OhioHealth David P. Blom Administrative Campus
attributes.summary:
The Central Ohio Chapter of AACN holds its all-day Critical Care Symposium on Friday, January 15, 2027, at the OhioHealth David P. Blom Administrative Campus in Columbus. Check-in and the vendor expo open at 7 a.m., and the first session starts at 8.

The chapter lists 6.5 CE credits, with The Ohio State University as the accrediting body. One ticket covers the full day and the expo: $30 if bought by October 31, 2026, and $40 after that. Session topics and speakers are not published yet.

attributes.title: Spotlight: Primary Care 2027
attributes.venue: University of South Carolina School of Medicine Greenville
attributes.summary:
Spotlight: Primary Care 2027 runs January 15 and 16, 2027, at the University of South Carolina School of Medicine Greenville, with the option to attend virtually at the same price. January 15 is an optional ultrasound workshop ($600); the main program on January 16 costs $150 for physicians, $100 for advanced practice providers and $25 for other care team members, and is free for students and residents.

The activity is designated for up to 16.25 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and is aimed at family medicine physicians, NPs, PAs and primary care practice staff.

attributes.title: 2027 We Are Family (Medicine)
attributes.summary:
We Are Family (Medicine) is AAPA's online conference for PAs and NPs, running January 16 to 18, 2027. It focuses on clinical refreshers and practical updates for family medicine and general internal medicine, for clinicians at every experience level.

Registration is open according to AAPA's events page. CME amounts and fees were not listed on the page we checked.

attributes.title: Iowa Vestibular Symposium 2027
attributes.summary: The Iowa Vestibular Symposium runs January 16-17, 2027 at the DMU32 Health and Business Complex in Des Moines and is streamed live on Zoom. It brings physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy and other disciplines together on dizziness, concussion, BPPV, vestibular migraine and related disorders. Des Moines University lists 16 CE contact hours; clinicians pay $400 and full-time students $175.

attributes.title: HIC–Yale Masters of Medicine 2027: The Race Against Time
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Masters of Medicine meeting, presented by the Heart Institute of the Caribbean and Yale Cardiovascular Medicine, runs over a weekend at the AC Hotel Kingston in Jamaica. This edition is themed «The Race Against Time» and centres on dementia, longevity and the brain–heart connection, with tracks on cardiovascular science, menopause and human performance.

The Sunday scientific programme includes sessions on healthy ageing, hypertension across the lifespan, early Alzheimer's detection, a debate on intensive cardiovascular prevention after 75, and a cardiovascular point-of-care ultrasound workshop. Two forums on Sunday afternoon are free and open to the public; the Saturday evening gala is by invitation only and not part of registration.

CME credit is listed by the organizer as pending: no credit amount or accrediting body has been published yet. Physicians practising in Jamaica can apply for a preferential rate.

attributes.title: VMX 2027
attributes.summary:
VMX 2027 takes place January 16 to 20, 2027, in Orlando, Florida, at the OCCC. The 2027 theme is "Off the Grid". Learning tracks cover small animal, large animal, exotics, veterinary nurses and technicians, practice management and professional development, plus hands-on workshops, masterclasses and Meet the Professor luncheons that cost extra and need pre-registration.

NAVC lists more than 1,000 hours of CE across the five days and an expo hall with 800+ exhibitors. In-person registration for veterinary professionals costs $250 until October 31, 2026; prices rise on November 1. VMX Virtual ($295) runs from January 16 to March 21, 2027.

attributes.title: Sun, Sand & CE Cruise 2027
attributes.series: Sun, Sand & CE Cruise (WDA and Michigan Dental Association)
attributes.cme_provider: Wisconsin Dental Association / Michigan Dental Association
attributes.summary:
The Wisconsin Dental Association and the Michigan Dental Association run a CE cruise aboard the Harmony of the Seas from January 16 to 23, 2027, with stops in St. Maarten, Puerto Rico and CocoCay. Sessions are held in the mornings only, and attendees can bring their team or family.

The program offers up to 9 CE credits. CE registration is $359 for association member dentists (in-state or out-of-state), $459 for non-member dentists and $299 for staff. The departure port is not stated on the CE page.

attributes.title: Internal Medicine for Primary Care: Addiction/Gastro/Geri/ID
attributes.series: MER Internal Medicine for Primary Care
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ABIM MOC · 10.25 ANCC CH
attributes.summary:
This MER course runs January 17 to 21, 2027, at the Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort on Maui. Morning lectures cover addiction medicine, gastroenterology, geriatrics and infectious disease for primary care clinicians.

MER lists 20 credit hours, including 10.25 ANCC pharmacotherapeutic contact hours, and says the course covers 5 hours of the MATE Act training requirement. The early-bird rate ended November 18, 2026, and the registration fee is now $1,495; hotel rooms in the group block start at $619 per night.

attributes.title: Echo Hawaii 2027
attributes.summary:
Echo Hawaii is the American Society of Echocardiography's winter course at the Fairmont Orchid on the Kohala Coast of the Big Island. The 2027 edition runs January 18 to 21. ASE aims it at adult cardiologists and critical care physicians, and it also lists cardiovascular surgeons, anesthesiologists, internists, fellows and sonographers among the expected audience.

ASE designates the course for up to 23.5 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, with up to the same number of MOC or MOCA 2.0 points. The fee schedule has three steps. ASE-member physicians pay $1,099 through December 3, 2026, $1,199 through January 17, and $1,320 onsite. Nonmember physicians pay $1,545, $1,645 and $1,770. Fellows-in-training pay less, starting at $775 for members.

Hawaii residents can get 10 percent off full in-person registration, and U.S. military members can ask ASE for a discount code. Hotel details are on a separate ASE venue page.

attributes.title: 50th Annual Family Medicine Update
attributes.cme_provider: North Dakota Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.organizer: North Dakota Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
Fifty years in, this Monday-to-Thursday meeting mixes morning and afternoon lectures aimed at office-based primary care with time for the slopes. The academy says the program is reshaped each year from attendee comments.

Check the credit before you budget around it: the form lists 17.5 credits, while the conference page says about 17 prescribed hours were submitted and approval is still pending. The $650 rate also covers retired MDs and out-of-state residents. North Dakota residents and medical students attend free but still need to register. Written cancellation at least one month ahead gets a refund minus $50.

attributes.title: SSWR 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Society for Social Work and Research
attributes.organizer: Society for Social Work and Research
attributes.summary:
This is a research meeting first, so it suits social workers who want evidence on interventions and policy more than skills training. Up to 29 CE hours are possible, for a separate $30 nonrefundable fee that has to be paid before the sessions you want to claim.

At our check date NASW approval was still pending, so clinicians relying on these hours for a renewal should confirm first. The early rate ends December 1, 2026. Pre-conference sessions cost extra.

attributes.title: Internal Medicine for Primary Care: Cardio/Nephro/Pulm/Sports Med
attributes.series: MER Internal Medicine for Primary Care
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ABIM MOC · 6.75 ANCC CH
attributes.summary:
MER holds this primary care course January 21 to 24, 2027, at the Opal Key Resort & Marina in Key West, Florida. The lectures cover cardiology, nephrology, pulmonology and sports medicine.

The course carries 16 credit hours, of which 6.75 are ANCC pharmacotherapeutic contact hours. The early-bird fee is $1,195 until November 22, 2026, and rooms in the block start at $589 per night.

attributes.title: The Mass General Brigham Heart Failure & Shock Course 2027
attributes.series: Mass General Brigham Heart Failure & Shock Course
attributes.credits_text: 21.5 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 21.5 ABIM MOC · 20.75 ANCC CH
attributes.summary:
The Mass General Brigham Heart Failure & Shock Course runs January 21 to 23, 2027, at the Fairmont Copley in Boston and is also streamed live. It is meant for general and heart failure cardiologists, critical care physicians, cardiac surgeons, hospitalists, advanced practitioners and nurses.

The course offers up to 21.5 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, 21.5 ABIM MOC points and 20.75 ANCC contact hours, 12 of which count toward pharmacology. Physicians pay $499; nurses, PAs and most other professionals $399; residents and fellows $100.

attributes.title: Rocky Mountain Dental Convention 2027
attributes.summary:
The Rocky Mountain Dental Convention runs January 21 to 23, 2027, in Denver. It is organized by the Metro Denver Dental Society, an ADA CERP Recognized Provider that assigns CE hours course by course; AGD accepts the credits for Fellowship and Mastership.

Pricing rises in three steps: by October 30, 2026, after October 30, and after December 4, 2026. ADA member dentists pay $429, $449 or $469; hygienists $149, $159 or $169; MDDS members and expo-only visitors attend free. The member fees in our table are ADA member dentist rates. The venue name is not stated on the convention home page.

attributes.title: AAO Winter Conference 2027
attributes.series: AAO Winter Conference (American Association of Orthodontists)
attributes.venue: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa
attributes.summary:
The AAO Winter Conference 2027 runs January 22 to 24, 2027, at the JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa, under the theme "Next-Gen Clinical Excellence: Evidence-Based, Data-Driven, AI-Enabled". It is aimed at orthodontists and residents.

Both the in-person and the live virtual formats are eligible for 15.75 live CE credits, and registrants get a 30-day replay that expires February 23, 2027. The AAO page did not show the credit type or current fees when we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 Louisiana Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Louisiana Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.venue: LSU Center for Advanced Learning and Simulation (CALS Building)
attributes.summary:
The Louisiana Chapter of the American College of Physicians holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting on Friday, January 22, at the LSU Center for Advanced Learning and Simulation on Perdido Street in New Orleans. You can attend in person or online, and each option has its own registration link in the ACP store.

A separate resident and student meeting follows on Saturday, January 23, in the same building. The chapter page did not list credit hours or fees when we checked, so look at the registration listing for current prices.

attributes.title: 2027 LVMA Winter Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Louisiana VMA holds its 2027 Winter Meeting January 22 to 24, 2027 at the Hilton New Orleans Riverside. The winter meeting is the association's main CE event and includes an exhibit area.

Early-bird pricing ends after December 21, 2026. Pre-registration closes January 15, 2027, and on-site registration will also be available. Lecture notes are sent electronically to all registrants at no extra cost. Guest registration covers continental breakfasts, refreshment breaks and the auxiliary tour.

The event page does not list the fees or total CE hours. Check with the LVMA office before you register.

attributes.title: 3rd Annual OTAC OTA Symposium
attributes.summary: OTAC's third annual symposium for occupational therapy assistants runs online on Saturday, January 23, 2027, from 9:00 am to 2:30 pm Pacific. The schedule includes a keynote on returning to OT basics plus sessions on AI-assisted documentation, networking and advocacy, and burn rehabilitation.

attributes.title: 2027 Winter Rheumatology Symposium
attributes.summary:
A practical course for clinicians managing rheumatic and immune disease, held at Snowmass on January 24 to 28, 2027. The ACR designates up to 20 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and 20 ABIM MOC points; claim them by March 29, 2027.

December 11, 2026 is the date to watch. Both the hotel deadline and the general rate end that day. ACR members pay $1,373 until then and $1,665 afterward; nonmembers pay $1,690 and $1,999; fellows in training pay $1,055 and $1,331. In our fee table the late rate appears under the on-site tier.

attributes.title: SkiCE 2027: A Focus on Feline Medicine
attributes.summary:
SkiCE 2027 is the Colorado VMA's winter retreat at Kindred Resort in Keystone, Colorado, from January 24 to 27, 2027. This year's program is devoted to feline medicine and totals 12 CE hours.

There is a dedicated technician rate: $545 through the early-bird deadline of November 13, 2026, then $645. CVMA members pay $645/$745, members of other VMAs or AAHA $675/$775, and non-members $1,015/$1,115. Rooms in the CVMA block start at $459 per night and must be booked by December 28, 2026.

The page does not state RACE approval or a separate technician track; the same 12 hours are offered to all registrants.

attributes.title: WSAAI 64th Annual Scientific Session
attributes.venue: Four Seasons O'ahu at Ko Olina
attributes.cme_provider: American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.organizer: Western Society of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.summary:
Expect long days at this Hawaii meeting: on Tuesday the preliminary agenda runs into the late afternoon, so do not assume free afternoons. It runs January 24 to 28, 2027, and topics include non-IgE drug hypersensitivity and drug allergy diagnostics.

The activity is jointly provided with ACAAI for up to 21 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits. Registration is $450 for members, $600 for nonmembers and $225 for nurses and allied health staff. The resort room block has sold out, so ask the registration contact about nearby hotels before you book.

attributes.title: Advocating for Idaho: 2027 Health Policy Conference
attributes.series: Advocating for Idaho Health Policy Conference
attributes.summary:
This is the first year for this free one-day conference, held January 25, 2027, in the Capitol's Lincoln Auditorium in Boise. ANA-Idaho, Nurse Leaders of Idaho, Nurse Practitioners of Idaho and the Idaho Center for Nursing host it. Attendees earn NCPD contact hours, though the number is not published yet.

It is worth pairing with Nurses Day at the Capitol the next day, if you want to talk with legislators while the session is on. Registration carries no fee, but you pay for your own lunch and drinks.

attributes.title: 2027 AOTA Entrepreneurship Virtual Specialty Conference
attributes.summary: A two-day online AOTA conference on January 25-26, 2027 for occupational therapists and OTAs who run or plan a practice. Sessions cover community-based services, billing, credentialing and payer contracts, and building books and courses. AOTA lists up to 8 contact hours.

attributes.title: Updates in General Internal Medicine for Specialists 2027
attributes.series: Updates in General Internal Medicine for Specialists (Harvard Medical School)
attributes.credits_text: 56 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 38 AAFP · 56 AAPA Cat 1
attributes.summary:
Updates in General Internal Medicine for Specialists runs Monday to Friday, January 25 to 29, 2027, at the Fairmont Copley Plaza in Boston, with a live online option and recordings available for 11 months. The audience includes medical sub-specialists, surgeons, psychiatrists, OB/GYN clinicians, NPs, PAs and nurses who want a broad internal medicine update.

The course carries 56 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and 56 AAPA Category 1 CME credits, including 14 Massachusetts risk management credits. Early fees, valid until January 2, 2027, are $1,395 for physicians and $1,195 for NPs and PAs; the hotel block is available until December 30, 2026.

attributes.title: Nurse Leader Institute 2027
attributes.venue: LSU Health Sciences Center Medical Education & Innovation Center
attributes.cme_provider: LSU Health New Orleans School of Nursing (P0111)
attributes.summary:
A week-long commitment with a lot of hours attached: 36.5 contact hours over January 25 to 29, 2027, in Baton Rouge, through the LSU Health New Orleans School of Nursing continuing development program (P0111).

It suits a nurse moving toward a first leadership role in acute, long-term, home, public health or academic settings. Talk to your manager early, because five days away takes planning. The five-day program costs $1,000.

attributes.title: 44th PAAV Annual Winter CME Conference
attributes.cme_provider: University of Vermont Larner College of Medicine (jointly accredited)
attributes.summary:
The Physician Assistant Academy of Vermont holds its 44th winter CME conference January 25 to 27, 2027, at the Von Trapp Family Lodge & Resort in Stowe. The University of Vermont Larner College of Medicine, a jointly accredited provider, handles registration and accreditation.

PAAV says registration includes 20 hours of CME; the formal credit designation is not published yet. Early-bird fees, which end December 15, 2026, are $590 for active or associate members, $390 for life members, $140 for student members and $790 for nonmembers. Rooms cost $265 per night with no resort fee, booked through a link in the confirmation email. Cancellations with a refund (minus $125) must arrive before January 4, 2027.

The agenda is now posted on the conference page.

attributes.title: 2027 Crossroads Veterinary Conference
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites Hotel & Conference Center Noblesville
attributes.summary:
Crossroads 2027, the Indiana VMA's annual conference, takes place January 28 to 30, 2027, at the Embassy Suites hotel and conference center in Noblesville, north of Indianapolis. The association lists 21 CE hours and describes the meeting as its main event for veterinarians, technicians, practice managers and students.

RVTs, assistants and practice staff pay $265 with state VMA membership or $365 without it for a complete pass; professional (DVM) passes are $470 for members and $760 for non-members. These prices rise after January 7, 2027, and one-day options exist. The discounted room block ($172 per night) closes December 28, 2026.

The page does not state whether the hours are RACE-approved or how many of them fall in a technician track; that detail is not published yet.

attributes.title: ENA Leadership Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The Emergency Nurses Association holds its Leadership Conference 2027 on Thursday and Friday, January 28 and 29, 2027, at the Renaissance Schaumburg Convention Center Hotel in Schaumburg, Illinois, outside Chicago. It is a smaller, management-focused meeting, separate from ENA's large Emergency Nursing conference in the fall, and is aimed at charge nurses, managers, directors and educators in emergency departments.

The call for session proposals closed on October 5, 2026. Fees, the program and contact hours were not listed on the conference's official submission portal, which was the page we could check; ENA's own events page blocked automated access.

attributes.title: 135th Annual MVMA Convention
attributes.summary:
The Missouri Veterinary Medical Association holds its 135th Annual Convention January 28 to 31, 2027 in Columbia, Missouri. The convention is the state association's yearly meeting and gives Missouri veterinarians a chance to earn CE in their home state.

When we checked, exhibitor registration was open. The association said attendee registration and further details would follow in the fall.

The venue, program tracks, fees and CE hours were not posted yet. Check the convention site before you plan your hours for the renewal cycle.

attributes.title: MVMA 2027 Winter Meeting
attributes.summary:
Mixed practitioners do well here because the sessions are split by species: Tim Holt on bovine medicine, KT Steward on equine colic and wounds, and Melissa Guillory on small animal dental pathology and extractions. Mark Papich covers antibiotic selection and susceptibility testing.

Session blocks run 3 or 4 CE hours each. There is also a tour of the new Montana Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory. Registration opens in November; RACE status and fees are not stated yet.

attributes.title: PSSCA Conference 2027: Amplify Your Impact
attributes.series: Palmetto State School Counselor Association Conference
attributes.summary:
South Carolina's school counselors meet at the Palmetto State School Counselor Association conference from January 28 to 30, 2027, at the Embassy Suites Resort & Convention Center in Myrtle Beach. The theme is "Amplify Your Impact." A pre-conference on January 28 features Amy Baltimore on student belonging and Teshia Stovall Dula on trauma-informed discipline, and Kat Pastor gives the January 29 keynote on protecting educator mental health and avoiding burnout.

The main conference costs $164 for professional members, $94 for student or retiree members and $214 for non-members through the early deadline of November 30, 2026, rising by $20 after that; the pre-conference is priced separately. Advance registration closes January 25, 2027, and member rates require PSSCA membership valid through the end of the conference.

The hotel block is $168 per night plus resort fee and parking, with breakfast included, until December 28, 2026, which is also the last day for refunds. The conference page does not yet list continuing education or recertification hours, so school counselors who need NBCC or state renewal credit should check back as the page is completed.

attributes.title: 63rd STS Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 63rd STS Annual Meeting takes place January 28 to 31, 2027, at the San Diego Convention Center. It covers adult cardiac, general thoracic and congenital heart surgery.

Registration is open and STS advises registering by November 2, 2026 for the lower rate; the fee amounts and CME statement were not listed on the event page. Late-breaking abstracts are due December 1, 2026.

attributes.title: Yankee Dental Congress 2027
attributes.venue: Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center (MCEC)
attributes.summary:
Yankee Dental Congress 2027 takes place January 28 to 30, 2027, at the Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center in Boston. Registration covers all three days and the exhibit floor; many lectures and hands-on courses are ticketed separately, and some exhibit-floor CE is free with expo access.

The Massachusetts Dental Society is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider. Registration itself carries general attendance credit (5 for dentists, 4 for hygienists, 3 for assistants); course hours are added on top. Hygienists get a dedicated full-day "Hygiene Experience" on Friday, January 29.

Fees step up in three phases: First Call until October 30, 2026, General until December 28, 2026, and Final Call through onsite. An ADA member dentist pays $140, $170 or $200; a hygienist $85, $110 or $140.

attributes.title: TPA Winter Meeting 2027
attributes.summary:
The Tennessee Pharmacists Association holds its 2027 Winter Meeting January 29 to 31, 2027, at the Sonesta Nashville Airport. TPA calls it the association's most prominent yearly networking and education conference, and it is open to pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, student pharmacists, exhibitors and friends of pharmacy.

The meeting combines educational sessions and workshops that carry continuing education credit with regulatory updates and an exhibit hall. The number of CE hours, the program and fees are not published yet; TPA says registration usually opens in late fall or early winter.

Companies interested in exhibiting or sponsoring can contact TPA directly; a call for CE presenters is also open.

attributes.title: TSHA 71st Annual Convention & Exhibition 2027
attributes.summary: The Texas Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds its 71st Annual Convention & Exhibition on January 29-30, 2027, at the Kay Bailey Hutchison Convention Center in Dallas. For 2027 the meeting is shortened to two days, and recordings of eligible education sessions stay available to registrants for about two weeks afterwards for additional CE credit. Early full-conference rates run until December 15, 2026: $299 for members and $519 for non-members.

attributes.title: CPS 2027 Winter Meeting
attributes.venue: The Westin Riverfront Resort and Spa
attributes.cme_provider: University of Colorado Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences
attributes.summary:
The Colorado Pharmacists Society's 2027 Winter Meeting, themed Fresh Tracks in Pharmacy, runs January 30 to February 2, 2027, at The Westin Riverfront Resort and Spa in Avon, at the base of Beaver Creek. The program for pharmacists, students and technicians is scheduled around skiing and other winter activities, with an exhibit hall evening with industry vendors. Full-conference registration and day passes are available.

CPE is provided by the University of Colorado Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, an ACPE-accredited provider; CPS notes the conference is pending accreditation for 11 CE. Early-bird pricing ends November 2, 2026. Group rooms at the Westin start at $429 per night plus taxes and fees and must be booked by December 29, 2026.

attributes.title: Standard of Care Symposium 2027
attributes.summary:
The Iowa Pharmacy Association runs its Standard of Care Symposium 2027 on Saturday, January 30, 2027, at the West Des Moines Marriott. The one-day program is built around Iowa's standard-of-care approach to pharmacy regulation and is aimed at pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and student pharmacists; attendance is not limited to Iowa licensees.

IPA plans 6.5 hours (0.65 CEU) of live continuing pharmacy education, available to both pharmacists and technicians. Accreditation was still pending when we checked, so the final credit statement is not published yet.

Registration is split into member and non-member links on the IPA event page; the fee amounts were not shown on the page we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 West River Continuing Education Meeting
attributes.summary:
A one-day CE meeting in Rapid City, convenient for practitioners in western South Dakota. The 2027 meeting is on Saturday, January 30, 2027, from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. at the Clubhouse Hotel & Suites, on the theme "Feline and Canine Dermatology".

The association lists 8 hours of continuing education; the page does not state RACE approval. Advanced registration through January 15, 2027, costs $175 for members and veterinary technicians and $225 for non-members; late and on-site registration is $200 and $250. The meeting is not livestreamed, but a recording is made available to registered attendees afterwards. Rooms at the hotel are $129 plus tax per night, and attendees book their own.

attributes.title: 2027 TCORN Symposium: Perioperative Advocacy in Action
attributes.venue: Hilton Garden Inn Austin Convention Center
attributes.organizer: Texas Collaboration of periOperative Registered Nurses
attributes.summary:
OR nurses earn 5 contact hours on a Saturday, January 30, 2027, at the Hilton Garden Inn Austin Convention Center, or attend virtually. The credit comes through Terri Goodman & Associates, a California Board of Registered Nursing provider (CEP 16550), so nurses in other states should check that their board accepts it.

Nonmembers may find it cheaper to pay $25 to join and use the member rate. The member early price ends November 25, 2026.

attributes.title: 22nd Annual Professional School Counseling Conference
attributes.summary:
The Texas Counseling Association holds its 22nd Annual Professional School Counseling Conference from January 31 to February 2, 2027, at Kalahari Resorts & Conventions in Round Rock, just north of Austin. The 2027 theme is "Rise and Radiate," and the program combines keynotes with breakout sessions built for school counselors, from first-year staff to district leaders.

The conference brings together school counselors from districts across Texas for practical campus strategies, networking and time to recharge. TCA offers a customizable letter that attendees can share with a principal or district office to request approval to attend.

Early-bird registration costs $185 and is limited to TCA members, with an early-bird deadline of November 22, 2026; non-members see only the administrator rate online. Payment by card or by check with a PDF form is accepted, and refund requests are due by January 8, 2027. The conference page does not list the number of CE hours, so confirm credit details with TCA if you need them for an LPC or school counselor renewal.

attributes.title: 2027 ANA-Vermont Annual Conference and Advocacy Day
attributes.series: ANA-Vermont Annual Conference and Advocacy Day
attributes.venue: Capitol Plaza Hotel Montpelier, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
attributes.summary:
ANA-Vermont's 2027 Annual Conference and Advocacy Day takes place February 1 and 2, 2027, at the Capitol Plaza Hotel in Montpelier, across the street from the State House. The focus is advocacy, health policy and legislation affecting Vermont nurses.

The save-the-date lists 3.0 CE credits with approval pending. The agenda, speakers and registration fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: APsA 2027 National Meeting
attributes.credits_text: 36.5 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 36.5 AAPA Cat 1 · 36.5 ANCC CH · 36.5 ACPE · APA CE · ASWB ACE · NBCC
attributes.summary:
The American Psychoanalytic Association's 2027 National Meeting runs Tuesday, February 2 to Friday, February 5, 2027, at the Mayflower Hotel in Washington, DC, with administrative meetings on February 1. APsA is taking applications for the poster session. Dr. Nicolle Zapien will give the 2027 Ticho Memorial Award lecture at the meeting.

APsA is a jointly accredited provider. It offers CME for physicians, CE for psychologists through APA co-sponsorship, ASWB ACE credit for social workers and NBCC credit for counselors (ACEP No. 7556), and it holds New York State approvals for social workers, psychologists and psychoanalysts. Up to 36.5 CME/CE credits are offered for the 2027 meeting, including AMA PRA Category 1, AAPA Category 1 and ANCC contact hours; the CME/CE evaluation is due by March 5, 2027.

Registration opened November 10, 2026. APsA clinical members pay $500 through November 23, $550 through January 8, 2027, and $650 after that; the public professional rate is $700, $750 and $830, and students or residents pay $100, $125 and $150. A single day costs $425. Refunds carry a 20% administrative fee.

attributes.title: Capitol Challenge 2027
attributes.summary:
New Mexico nurses spend February 3, 2027, at the State Capitol in Santa Fe, working through current health legislation and the state budget, and practicing how to brief a legislator. If you have never lobbied, this is a structured way to start.

Hours have been submitted to the Colorado Nurses Association, an ANCC-accredited approver, but the approval and the hour count are not published yet. Registration closes January 22, 2027, with no refunds after that date.

attributes.title: APTA CSM 2027 Philadelphia
attributes.summary: APTA holds the 2027 Combined Sections Meeting February 4 to 6 at the Pennsylvania Convention Center in Philadelphia. In-person attendance can earn up to 1.35 CEUs (13.5 contact hours), plus up to 0.45 CEUs from three CSM On Demand sessions; full in-person registration includes On Demand access. Advance rates run to January 6, 2027: $615 for a PT section member, $855 for a non-member and $335 for a student, with higher full and on-site rates from January 7. PTA, life member and speaker rates are listed separately.

attributes.title: 2027 Annual FMHCA Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Florida Mental Health Counselors Association (NBCC ACEP #2058)
attributes.summary:
The Florida Mental Health Counselors Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference February 4 to 6, 2027, at the Orlando Marriott Lake Mary. There is a separate registration for those who want to attend online. FMHCA is the Florida chapter of AMHCA and works only for licensed mental health counselors in the state.

Early-bird pricing ended November 1, 2026. The public full rate is now $750 for three days, $500 for two days and $250 for one day (the early rates were $600, $400 and $200), with lower rates for presenters; the online registration lists the same full rates. Members and students see their discounted rates only after signing in, so those amounts are not public.

FMHCA is an NBCC-Approved Continuing Education Provider (#2058) and says the CE earned at the conference applies nationally. The total number of conference CE hours is not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 Gulf Coast Social Work Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Amedco LLC with Continuing Education Productions
attributes.summary:
The Gulf Coast Social Work Conference returns on February 4 and 5, 2027, at the IP Casino in Biloxi, Mississippi. Social workers can attend in person or join the live stream.

The program carries 13 CE hours for the two days, including 1.5 ethics, 3 cultural competency and 1 mandated reporting hour. Credit is provided through Amedco, a jointly accredited provider with ASWB ACE and APA approval, together with Continuing Education Productions; the page lists the state boards that accept the hours for social workers, counselors, MFTs, psychologists and addictions professionals.

Registration costs $295 for either format and is not refundable, though it can be transferred. The IP Casino group rate is $89.99 for the nights of February 3 and 4 and $169.99 for February 5, plus a $15 resort fee per night, and must be booked before January 19, 2027.

attributes.title: ICOI Winter Implant Symposium 2027
attributes.summary:
The ICOI Winter Implant Symposium is scheduled for February 4 to 6, 2027, in the Palm Springs area of California, with the hotel block at the Omni Rancho Las Palmas. Online registration and a registration form are available on the ICOI events page.

ICOI is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider and an AGD PACE provider. The program, fees and credit hours were not shown on the events page when we checked.

attributes.title: ILAA 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary: The Illinois Academy of Audiology holds its 2027 conference on Thursday and Friday, February 4-5, 2027, in Naperville, Illinois. The academy invited abstracts on prevention, assessment and treatment in audiology and on best practices in patient care. Venue, fees and CE amounts had not yet been posted.

attributes.title: 2027 SNMMI Mid-Winter Meeting
attributes.organizer: Society of Nuclear Medicine and Molecular Imaging
attributes.summary:
San Francisco hosts this smaller SNMMI meeting on February 4 to 6, 2027, with a Thursday image interpretation session on theranostics imaging. That session is labeled non-CE, so don't count it toward your hours. Other registration categories do include CE, though the credit total is not published yet and the full program is still to come.

Physician members pay $635 through January 5, 2027, then $785; nonmembers pay $1,570, then $1,960. Residents who are members attend free. The physician room block at the Hilton San Francisco Union Square is $229, available until January 7, 2027.

attributes.title: WSHA 2027 Annual Convention
attributes.organizer: Wisconsin Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Association
attributes.summary: The Wisconsin Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Association holds its 2027 Annual Convention on February 4-5, 2027, at the Ingleside Resort in Pewaukee under the theme "Educate, Evolve and Empower: Evidence in Action." The program has audiology, birth-to-6, medical and schools tracks, a Thursday pre-conference and Friday posters. Early-bird rates end December 1, 2026, and CEUs require the online learning assessment.

attributes.title: 2027 Workshop on Neonatal-Perinatal Practice Strategies
attributes.series: AAP Workshop on Neonatal-Perinatal Practice Strategies
attributes.summary:
Held at Loews Ventana Canyon in Tucson on February 5 to 7, 2027. A separate Neonatal Coding Seminar on the first day adds 4.75 CME credits for its morning portion, which may interest anyone who handles unit billing.

The AAP designates up to 17.75 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, with matching AAPA and NAPNAP hours. The American Board of Pediatrics approves 10 MOC Part 2 points if the post-assessment is finished by March 7, 2027.

January 8, 2027 ends both the early rate and the $259 hotel block; cancellation requests are due January 22. Fee amounts sit in a PDF we did not verify, so none are listed here.

attributes.title: 2027 Colorado Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Colorado Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Colorado Chapter of the American College of Physicians holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting on Friday and Saturday, February 5 and 6, 2027, at The Broadmoor in Colorado Springs. It can also be followed online through selected live keynote and education sessions.

The agenda covers updates in medicine, coronary CT and calcium scoring, vaccines, osteoporosis, menopause and lipid management, plus workshops and resident presentations. ACP designates the meeting for up to 10 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and 10 ABIM MOC points.

In-person registration is $375 for ACP members and $450 for non-member physicians through January 8, 2027, then $400 and $500. Resident and student members pay $35, then $40. Virtual attendance is $199 for members and $250 for non-member physicians, rising to $299 and $350. The Broadmoor room block is held until January 1, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 NASW-MN Winter Virtual Conference
attributes.summary:
Spread over three Fridays, February 5, 12 and 19, this suits practitioners who cannot give up a whole week. Past sessions were tagged by CE category, such as clinical, ethics, supervision, macro and cultural responsiveness, so you can pick by what your renewal still needs.

The 2026 edition offered up to 18 CEUs and later sold recordings for independent-study credit. The 2027 program, hours and fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 NCNA Psych Retreat
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Raleigh Crabtree
attributes.summary:
The North Carolina Nurses Association holds its 2027 Psych Retreat on February 5 and 6, 2027, at the Embassy Suites by Hilton Raleigh Crabtree. It covers current practice and policy in psychiatric-mental health nursing and is open to RNs, APRNs, point-of-care nurses and students; a short preconference on February 5 focuses on psychopharmacology.

NCNA, an ANCC-accredited provider, lists up to 12.0 contact hours, including up to 2.75 pharmacotherapeutic hours. Topics on the agenda include harm reduction, perinatal mood disorders, ECT, GLP-1 drugs in mental health and safer milieu management.

Early-bird rates run until December 18, 2026: $357 for members and $534 for guests for the full program. Regular rates are $447 and $671, and pre-registration ends January 29, 2027. The hotel block ($179–$189 a night) is held until January 15, 2027.

attributes.title: NJSSNA 2027 Annual Conference: Relentless School Nursing for Student Success
attributes.venue: Hilton East Brunswick Hotel & Executive Meeting Center
attributes.organizer: New Jersey State School Nurses Association
attributes.summary:
The New Jersey State School Nurses Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference on February 5 and 6, 2027, at the Hilton East Brunswick. It starts with a Friday-evening session on the legal landscape of school health and continues Saturday with a keynote, general sessions, breakouts, posters and an exhibit hall.

NJSSNA lists up to 7.0 contact hours: 1 for the Friday evening and up to 6 on Saturday, with poster viewing counting toward the total. The School Health Academy provides the hours through Northeastern University School of Nursing, an ANCC-accredited provider. Registration fees are not stated on the conference page. Saturday topics include individualized healthcare and emergency care plans, vaccine-preventable diseases, diabetes technology and behavioral health.

attributes.title: 2027 PPA Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Pennsylvania Pharmacists Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference from Friday, February 5 to Sunday, February 7, 2027, in Harrisburg. Registration is open for pharmacists, associates and technicians, with a separate student registration, and the conference includes an exhibit hall, a poster session, the student OTC competition and the association's awards.

PPA's schedule at a glance (as of November 17, 2026, subject to change) lists concurrent CE sessions on cholesterol and cardio-kidney-metabolic guidelines, the ADA diabetes standards, contraceptive access, a 2027 immunization update, UTI guidelines, anticoagulation and precepting, plus technician-focused sessions such as The Technician Awakens. DSMES and DPP master trainer workshops run alongside. Total CE hours and registration fees are not shown on the public pages yet.

Rooms in PPA's Hilton block must be booked by January 14, 2027 (group code PPA27).

attributes.title: Pri-Med South 2027
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · AAFP · AANP CE · AANP Pharm
attributes.summary:
Pri-Med South runs February 5 to 7, 2027, at the Broward County Convention Center in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The conference covers primary care, family medicine and internal medicine topics, and Pri-Med says the program also meets Florida's state-mandated education requirements.

Attendees can earn up to 23 CME/CE credits as AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and AANP contact hours, with AANP pharmacology credit depending on the sessions attended. The early-bird rate has sold out; the advance rate is $165 until February 5, 2027. Medical students and residents attend free but receive no credit.

attributes.title: Sleep Medicine Trends 2027
attributes.summary:
A weekend clinical update from the AASM in Henderson, Nevada, February 5 to 7, 2027, for sleep physicians who want new practice guidance without a full national meeting.

The academy describes CME credit and MOC points for this course, but we could not open that page directly. Check the credit total and fees with the AASM, since they are not confirmed here.

attributes.title: 2027 UVA Advanced Practice Conference (APOGEE)
attributes.summary:
UVA Health's 2027 Advanced Practice Conference, branded APOGEE, runs February 5 and 6, 2027, at the Omni Hotel in Charlottesville, Virginia. It is meant for NPs, PAs and other advanced practice clinicians in inpatient, outpatient and community settings.

Beyond clinical topics such as nicotine harm across the lifespan and care transitions for complex patients, much of the program deals with APP careers: hospital administration, research, leadership across health systems and teaching. The activity carries 12.75 ANCC contact hours and 12.75 AAPA Category 1 CME credits. Two-day registration is $275 until January 10, 2027 and $325 afterwards; registration closes January 31 and walk-ins are not accepted.

attributes.title: 2027 AANP Health Policy Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AANP Health Policy Conference runs February 7 to 9, 2027, at the Grand Hyatt Washington in Washington, D.C., with early packet pickup on the evening of February 6. It is aimed at nurse practitioners who want to understand federal health policy, from first-time advocates to experienced policy hands.

The program combines sessions, a keynote and an exhibit hall, and the last day is set aside for congressional visits on Capitol Hill. AANP lists most sessions at one contact hour and the congressional visits block at 2.5 contact hours; a total has not been published. Registration costs $700 for AANP members, $290 for student members and $950 for non-members.

attributes.title: 2027 AASCB Annual Conference: Doubling Down on a United Profession
attributes.series: AASCB Annual Conference (American Association of State Counseling Boards)
attributes.organizer: American Association of State Counseling Boards
attributes.summary:
The American Association of State Counseling Boards meets February 7 to 9, 2027, at The Palms in Las Vegas. The conference is the main yearly gathering for people who regulate professional counselors: state board members, executive directors and staff, along with educators and organizations that work with licensing boards.

The 2027 theme, "Doubling Down on a United Profession," focuses on the growing variation in licensure requirements, scope of practice and pathways to independent licensure across states, and on how those differences affect legal and legislative challenges to state licensing. Sessions combine expert presentations with structured discussion aimed at practical solutions between jurisdictions.

Registration runs through the AASCB event page, which showed limited spaces remaining when we checked; payment is required before attending. The Palms block rate is $129 per night plus tax and resort fee until January 14, 2027, with complimentary self and valet parking for attendees. The conference pages do not mention continuing education credit.

attributes.title: LDA Winter CE with Character 2027
attributes.summary:
The Louisiana Dental Association's Winter CE with Character meeting runs February 7 to 9, 2027, at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa at Walt Disney World. Courses run each morning from 7:30 to 11:00, leaving afternoons free, and the trip is open to dentists, hygienists, staff and families.

The program offers up to 10.5 clinical CE hours; the LDA page displays the AGD PACE mark. Fees depend on the registration date: LDA members pay $489 until December 10, $514 until January 4 and $539 after that; ADA members $589/$639/$664; non-members $699/$749/$774; hygienists and other staff $389/$439/$464.

attributes.title: UCSF Neuro and Musculoskeletal Imaging 2027 (RAD27022)
attributes.organizer: UCSF Office of Continuing Medical Education
attributes.summary:
UCSF's Neuro and Musculoskeletal Imaging course (RAD27022) runs from Sunday, February 7, to Friday, February 12, 2027, at the Fairmont Orchid in Kamuela, Hawaii. Neuroradiology lectures cover adult and pediatric emergencies, head and neck masses, headache, cranial nerves, neonatal brain injury, spinal anomalies and infections; the musculoskeletal part reviews the major joints, injuries, infection, muscle imaging and arthritis.

The course carries up to 25 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits. Physicians and other health professionals pay $1,495 before December 12, 2026, and $1,595 after; onsite registration is $1,645. Online registration closes February 5, 2027, at 5 p.m. Pacific.

attributes.title: 58th Annual Primary Care Review
attributes.summary:
OHSU's 58th Annual Primary Care Review runs February 8 to 12, 2027, at the Sentinel Hotel in Portland, Oregon. It is aimed at family physicians, internists, hospitalists, NPs, PAs and other primary care clinicians, who build their own schedule from 20 plenary talks and 48 breakout sessions.

Registration had not opened when we checked, and credits and fees were not yet listed.

attributes.title: 2027 MVMA Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Minnesota VMA holds its 2027 Annual Conference February 10 to 13, 2027, at the Hilton Minneapolis. The conference site lists more than 140 CE hours for veterinarians, veterinary technicians and assistants, practice managers and students.

Attendee registration is open. The three-day rate for MVMA members and non-Minnesota veterinarians is $390 through January 5, 2027, $425 from January 6 to 25 and $460 after that; Minnesota non-member veterinarians pay $715, $750 and $785, and technicians and staff $340, $375 and $410. DVM students register free until the late period. Two-day and one-day rates are also listed. The Hilton Minneapolis room rate is $135 plus taxes, with self-parking included.

attributes.title: NPACE 2027: February Virtual Webinar
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: A one-day live virtual webinar from NPACE on February 10, 2027, for nurse practitioners and other advanced practice providers. NPACE lists 8+ CE/CME credits for the day. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists the webinar at $125, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.

attributes.title: 41st SNRS Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Southern Nursing Research Society holds its 41st Annual Conference from Wednesday, February 10, to Friday, February 12, 2027, at The Courtland Grand Hotel in Atlanta, Georgia. Daily sessions run from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Eastern. The meeting brings together nurse scientists, faculty, doctoral students and clinical nurses who conduct or apply research, mostly from the southern states.

The program includes pre- and post-conference workshops, podium and poster sessions, symposia and a student poster session; all abstract calls closed by September 2026. Fees, the theme and contact hours were not shown on the SNRS event listing when we checked.

attributes.title: CASSW Annual Conference 2027: The Architecture of Care
attributes.venue: Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE)
attributes.cme_provider: National Association of Social Workers (CEU provider)
attributes.organizer: California Association of School Social Workers
attributes.summary:
The California Association of School Social Workers holds its 2027 conference, "The Architecture of Care: Anchoring Our Schools in Uncertain Times", on February 11 and 12, 2027, at the Los Angeles County Office of Education in Downey. Sessions run from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on both days.

NASW is listed as the CEU provider, with at least 10 CEUs across the two days. CEUs are free for CASSW members; non-members pay a separate CEU fee of $15 for one day or $25 for both days.

Registration is open. Non-members pay $350 for both days or $210 for one day. Direct and peripheral members pay $210 or $126, retired members $175 or $105, and student members $87.50 or $52.50. Group codes take 15% to 20% off larger orders.

attributes.title: CSNO 77th Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: California School Nurses Organization (California BRN provider CEP #04269)
attributes.summary:
The California School Nurses Organization holds its 77th Annual Conference from February 11 to 14, 2027, in Riverside, California, with pre-event workshops on February 10 and 11. The theme is "Growing Together Through Leadership and Innovation," and the program is built for credentialed school nurses and other nurses working in K-12 settings.

CSNO is an approved continuing education provider of the California Board of Registered Nursing (CEP #04269); the number of contact hours for this conference had not been posted. Registration opened October 5, 2026, and the early bird deadline is January 7, 2027. CSNO lists four conference hotels in Riverside but no single venue, and fees were not shown on the public page when we checked.

attributes.title: Iowa VMA Winter Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The Iowa Veterinary Medical Association holds its Winter Conference February 11 and 12, 2027 at the Prairie Meadows Convention Center in Altoona, just east of Des Moines.

Registration opens December 14, 2026. The early-bird discount ends January 28, 2027, and a late fee applies from the morning of February 11. The calendar entry gives no fees, CE hours or program yet.

The association also lists its Annual Meeting for September 23 and 24, 2027, so Iowa veterinarians have two state association meetings for live CE in 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 North Carolina Annual Scientific Session: The Art & Heart of Internal Medicine
attributes.series: ACP North Carolina Chapter Annual Scientific Session
attributes.summary:
The North Carolina Chapter of the American College of Physicians meets at the Friday Conference Center in Chapel Hill from February 12 to 14, 2027. This year's program is titled "The Art & Heart of Internal Medicine" and is aimed at internists, residents and students, with poster sessions for trainees and early-career physicians. The chapter says CME and MOC credit will be provided but had not posted totals.

Registration covers meals, sessions, materials and the Doctor's Dilemma dinner. Early rates through December 31, 2026, are $310 for ACP members and $475 for nonmember physicians, rising to $350 and $550 afterward. Nonmember allied health professionals pay $274 early, and residents and students pay $25. Cancellations before January 28 are refunded minus $25.

The Courtyard by Marriott Chapel Hill holds rooms at $209 a night until January 29, 2027.

attributes.title: Primary Care Conference Hawaii 2027
attributes.venue: The Westin Maui Resort and Spa, Ka'anapali
attributes.cme_provider: Creighton University Health Sciences Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: Creighton University Health Sciences Continuing Education
attributes.summary:
Creighton University's Primary Care Conference Hawaii runs Monday to Thursday, February 15 to 18, 2027, at The Westin Maui Resort and Spa in Ka'anapali. It is in-person only and open to physicians, PAs, NPs, pharmacists, nurses, dentists and trainees.

The program carries 13.25 CE hours from Creighton, which is jointly accredited for physician, pharmacy and nursing education. Registration is a flat $1,095 with no discounts, and a room block is held at the resort. Sessions run each morning from 7:45 a.m. to 11:50 a.m.; a day-by-day outline of topics and speakers is posted, and Creighton describes the detailed schedule as forthcoming.

attributes.title: Substance Use Disorders: A Comprehensive Review and Update 2027
attributes.series: Substance Use Disorders: A Comprehensive Review and Update
attributes.credits_text: 15.25 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 15.25 ANCC CH · 15.25 APA CE · 15.25 ASWB ACE
attributes.summary:
Three live days on Zoom, from neuroscience to recovery-oriented care, useful for clinicians who see substance use in a general caseload and want one structured update. Hours are the same for most licenses: 15.25 CE credits for psychologists, nurses and physicians, and social work credit through ASWB ACE.

Pricing splits by degree, not by membership, and the regular rate starts December 1, 2026. Refund requests are accepted through January 2, 2027, minus a $100 fee.

attributes.title: Pri-Med Washington, D.C. 2027
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · AANP CE · AANP Pharm
attributes.summary: Pri-Med's Washington, D.C. regional conference takes place February 16 and 17, 2027, at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center. Thirteen accredited primary care courses add up to 13 CME/CE credits, available as AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and AANP contact hours. The early-bird rate is $85 until October 30, 2026 and the advance rate $99.

attributes.title: 2027 Annual Leadership Symposium: Together at the Table
attributes.series: AACN Chapter at UCLA Annual Leadership Symposium
attributes.venue: The Center for Healthy Communities Los Angeles
attributes.summary:
Critical care nurses and managers in Southern California can use this single day, February 17, 2027, to work on leadership skills without traveling. The chapter lists 5.2 CNE credits, submitted for approval to AACN, so approval is still pending.

The member price requires active membership in both national AACN and this chapter; check that before you register. Early prices end December 31, 2026.

attributes.title: Language and Literacy: Preschool and School-Age Children (2027)
attributes.series: ASHA Online Conference: Language and Literacy
attributes.summary: ASHA runs this online conference for school-based SLPs from February 17 to March 1, 2027, combining on-demand sessions with live Zoom chats over a 13-day window. Sessions use case scenarios and decision frameworks for literacy support across grades and service models. ASHA lists up to 2.4 ASHA CEUs (24 professional development hours).

attributes.title: Hospital Medicine for NPs & PAs 2027
attributes.series: Mayo Clinic Hospital Medicine for NPs & PAs
attributes.credits_text: 18.5 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 18.5 AAPA Cat 1 · 18.5 ANCC CH
attributes.cme_provider: Mayo Clinic College of Medicine and Science
attributes.organizer: Mayo Clinic School of Continuous Professional Development
attributes.summary:
Mayo Clinic's Hospital Medicine for NPs & PAs runs February 17 to 20, 2027, at the Laguna Cliffs Resort & Spa in Dana Point, California. The course reviews current guidelines and treatment pathways for hospitalized patients, with objectives on ethical dilemmas, angina evaluation, renal disease in the hospital and thrombocytopenia. It is aimed at NPs, PAs, hospitalists, nurses and residents.

The in-person course is designated for 18.5 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, 18.5 AAPA Category 1 CME credits and 18.5 ANCC contact hours, and costs $799. Attendees can submit poster abstracts until January 4, 2027. The hotel block cutoff is January 26, 2027, or earlier if the block sells out.

attributes.title: NEO: The Conference for Neonatology 2027
attributes.summary:
Three days on newborn medicine at Caesars Palace, February 17 to 19, 2027. If you can only get away briefly, a one-day rate of $500 is listed. The full rate is $1,000 for physicians and $650 for APRNs, PAs, nurses, allied health staff, residents and fellows.

Pediatrix says attendees earn CME and CNE credit, but the credit total and accredited provider are not published yet on the pages we checked. The rate page shows no early-bird deadline.

attributes.title: 63rd Annual SCCA Conference
attributes.series: South Carolina Counseling Association Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The South Carolina Counseling Association holds its 63rd annual conference February 17 to 19, 2027, in Myrtle Beach. The meeting brings together licensed professional counselors, school counselors, counselor educators and students from across the state, with live in-person presentations.

SCCA is approved by NBCC as a continuing education provider (ACEP No. 2041), and sessions that do not qualify for NBCC credit are marked as such. The total number of clock hours was not published yet.

Registration opened on September 1, 2026. The venue, fees and hotel details were not published on the conference page when we checked; a separate registration path exists for school counselors.

attributes.title: 2027 TAMFT Annual Conference: Relational Courage
attributes.organizer: Texas Association for Marriage and Family Therapy
attributes.summary:
The 2027 program is built around difficult conversations, in the therapy room and between colleagues and supervisors. If conflict work with couples and families or a tense supervisory relationship is on your mind, that is the angle to look at when the session list appears.
