The early rate runs through December 18, 2026, and the group hotel rate at the Renaissance Austin Downtown ends January 21, 2027, so both decisions come before the program feels close. TAMFT's 2027 page does not yet list CE hours; its 2026 conference advertised more than 15, including ethics, cultural diversity and supervision. Texas LMFTs should wait for the 2027 hour count before planning a renewal around it.

attributes.title: 2027 Alaska Dental Society Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Alaska Dental Society holds its 2027 Annual Meeting on Hawaii's Big Island, February 18 and 19, 2027, at the Waikoloa Beach Marriott Resort & Spa. A welcome event is planned for February 17.

The program offers two days of CE sessions for dentists and their teams, with a sponsor and vendor marketplace and ADS business sessions. Course descriptions and speakers will be posted as they are finalized. The group hotel rate must be booked by January 26, 2027; registration fees and CE hours are not published on the page yet.

attributes.title: Fitzgerald 4-Day CE Conference, Scottsdale
attributes.credits_text: AAPA Cat 1 · 24 AANP CE · 20 AANP Pharm
attributes.summary:
Fitzgerald's Scottsdale conference runs February 18 to 21, 2027, at the Scottsdale Marriott at McDowell Mountains. The first two days are a pharmacology update, followed by a pain management bootcamp and a day on dermatology hot topics; each part can be booked separately.

The full conference carries 24 AANP contact hours, 20 of them pharmacology, and PAs can earn AAPA Category 1 CME through NetCE. The early-bird price for all four days is $999 (regular $1,097).

attributes.title: 2027 iaedp Foundation Annual Global Symposium
attributes.organizer: International Association of Eating Disorders Professionals Foundation
attributes.summary:
The iaedp Foundation holds its 2027 Annual Global Symposium February 18 to 20, 2027, at the Marriott Marquis Chicago. The theme is "From Evidence to Implementation: Closing the Research-Practice Gap." Optional workshops carry their own CE counts: the Body Project and two temperament-based and DBT workshops are 6 CEs each, and an evening panel is 1.5 CEs. A Level 2 temperament-based therapy training (18 CEs) follows at a separate venue.

US in-person rates are $750 for members and $975 for non-members through January 10, 2027. They rise to $900 and $1,225 until February 12, and to $950 and $1,275 on site. Students pay $500 to $675. Single-practitioner practices get lower rates, and international attendees pay by country zone.

Guest registrations include no CE. For the 2026 symposium the foundation offered social work CE through ASWB, plus ACCME and dietitian (CDR) credit. The full 2027 accreditation statement, including any APA or NBCC credit, is not on the 2027 page yet.

attributes.title: ISHA 67th Annual Convention 2027
attributes.summary: The Illinois Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds its 67th Annual Convention on February 18-19, 2027, at the Tinley Park Convention Center. ISHA lists up to 15 continuing education hours (1.50 ASHA CEUs) for the convention. Member pricing starts at $335 until December 21, 2026, and members of several neighboring state associations also qualify for member rates.

attributes.title: Keys to a Successful Transition into Advance Practice Nursing Conference 2027
attributes.series: Keys to a Successful Transition into Advanced Practice Nursing
attributes.venue: Lost Spur Golf and Event Center
attributes.summary:
A good fit in the last semester of an NP program or the first year of practice. In one day, February 18, 2027, in Eagan, it covers certification, job searches and CVs, interviews, billing and coding, and how the legislative process shapes prescriptive authority.

The page lists 5 contact hours, but the accrediting body is still marked to be determined, so verify that before you count them.

attributes.title: Midwest Veterinary Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Midwest Veterinary Conference, hosted by the Ohio Veterinary Medical Association, takes place live in Columbus, Ohio, on February 18 to 20, 2027, with the Greater Columbus Convention Center listed as the conference venue. A virtual edition follows, with on-demand access from March 3 to August 31, 2027.

The conference site describes three live days, more than 300 sessions across 25+ tracks and up to 18 hours of in-person CE. The virtual pass covers 87 recorded lectures in 14 tracks.

Registration is open. For all three days in person, OVMA members and out-of-state veterinarians pay $300 through January 19, 2027, then $375; Ohio veterinarians who are not members pay $475, then $550; technicians and staff pay $215, then $290. One- and two-day rates are lower, and a hybrid package adds the virtual conference for $125 more ($75 for technicians and staff). The virtual-only pass is $250 for members and out-of-state veterinarians, $425 for Ohio non-members and $175 for technicians and staff. OVMA student members attend free; other students pay $35, then $45.

attributes.title: 2027 NCCA Annual Conference: Strengthening the Core to Scale the Future
attributes.venue: Hotel Ballast, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
attributes.summary:
Plan ahead, because NCCA does not take registration on site: online sign-up closes February 13, 2027. Pre-conference sessions are sold separately, and the fee table separates new professionals and graduate students from full professionals, so check which line you qualify for.

The association's site offers a CE route for events, but the 2027 hour total is not published yet. Early-bird registration ends November 30, 2026, or when sold out; the page lists one set of rates (as of June 1, 2026) and no later price, so confirm the amount at checkout.

attributes.title: 35th Annual NNP Conference & Exhibition
attributes.summary:
The 35th Nebraska NP conference comes to Lincoln on February 18 and 19, 2027. Organizers describe more than 100 attendees from primary care, acute care, specialty practice, rural health and academia, so the program is aimed at mixed practice rather than a single setting.

Expect pharmacology updates, acute and chronic disease management and professional practice issues. The 2027 contact hours, pharmacology hours and attendee prices are not published yet. The room block at the Lincoln Marriott Cornhusker Hotel must be reserved by January 27, 2027. Look for those on the event page before you plan around renewal hours.

attributes.title: UDA Convention 2027
attributes.summary:
The Utah Dental Association's 2027 convention takes place February 18 and 19, 2027, at the Salt Palace Convention Center in Salt Lake City; registration opened October 1, 2026, and the convention program was posted on November 1. The UDA lists the convention among its CE opportunities.

CE credit follows the instructional hours actually attended, so a three-hour course counts as 3 CE credits. Only the hands-on courses need a separate sign-up; other lectures are first come, first served. One fee covers both days, and lower fees apply before January 1, 2027. The fee amounts appear only as images on the convention website, so they are not listed here; check the registration page for current prices.

attributes.title: 2027 Virginia Veterinary Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Virginia Veterinary Conference runs February 18 to 20, 2027, at the Hotel Roanoke & Conference Center in Roanoke, Virginia. The Virginia VMA advertises up to 15 CE hours across six conference tracks.

Attendee registration is due to open in winter 2026; fees are not published yet. The conference hotel offers a group rate starting at $174 per night.

attributes.title: 2027 AAAAI Annual Meeting
attributes.cme_provider: American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (AAAAI); pharmacy CE with Amedco LLC (Joint Accreditation)
attributes.organizer: American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AAAAI Annual Meeting runs February 19 to 22, 2027, at the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans. The program combines plenaries, a keynote, workshops with hands-on skills, demonstration stations and poster and oral abstract sessions; the basic-science conference Discovery 2027 runs alongside it on February 18 to 20.

In-person attendees can earn up to 38.25 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, and pharmacists up to 23.75 knowledge-based CPE contact hours; recorded content stays available for credit through December 31, 2027. Members pay $570 through January 6, 2027 ($720 after), non-member physicians $820 ($970 after), and non-member nurses, NPs and PAs $500 ($600 after). Plenary topics include seafood allergy, patient-centered food allergy care, biologic non-response and machine learning in diagnostics.

attributes.title: 2027 Maryland Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Maryland Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Maryland Chapter of the American College of Physicians holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting on Friday and Saturday, February 19 and 20, at Turf Valley Resort & Conference Center in Ellicott City, west of Baltimore.

On Saturday the chapter also runs the Richard B. Williams ACP Medical Student Conference, which includes a student abstract competition with posters. ACP said more details were coming when we checked. Fees, credit hours and lodging had not been posted, so check the chapter's news and meetings page before you plan.

attributes.title: 61st Annual AKPhA Convention & Tradeshow
attributes.summary:
The Alaska Pharmacy Association's 61st Annual Convention & Tradeshow runs Friday to Sunday, February 19 to 21, 2027, at the Hotel Captain Cook in downtown Anchorage. Over three days, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, student pharmacists and industry representatives from across Alaska meet for accredited CE sessions, a tradeshow, committee work and networking.

Registration opens in winter 2026. The CE hours, full CE schedule and fees have not been published yet; AKPhA says the digital program with the CE schedule will be available through the registration portal. A discounted room block is available at the Hotel Captain Cook.

attributes.title: 6th Annual KAPN Sunflower Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Kansas Advanced Practice Nurse Professional Development (KSBN Provider LT0349-0626)
attributes.organizer: The Kansas Advanced Practice Nurses Association
attributes.summary:
Kansas APRNs get something handy here: the program is planned to the Kansas State Board of Nursing standards for 11 contact hours, 3 of them pharmacology, and is aimed at APRN re-licensure. The provider number listed is LT0349-0626. It runs February 19 and 20, 2027, in Wichita.

Planned topics are unusually practical, including NP malpractice cases, outpatient antibiotic stewardship, heart failure, opioid use disorder and starting an APRN-owned practice. Friday morning offers three paid workshops, joint injection, suturing and business ownership; you can pick only one.

Early rates end November 29, 2026.

attributes.title: PAs By The Bay: Monterey 2027
attributes.summary:
CAPA's Northern California meeting returns to Monterey on February 19 and 20, 2027, at the Monterey Beach Hotel. Friday is a pre-conference of industry-supported, hands-on workshops; Saturday is a full day of accredited clinical lectures with a primary care focus. CAPA lists up to 7.0 Category 1 CME units.

Registration costs $200 for CAPA members, $600 for nonmembers and $65 for CAPA student members, with separate contact-only rates for nonmember students and retired members. The group hotel rate is $239 per night, with the destination fee waived, until January 19, 2027.

The program and speakers are not published yet.

attributes.title: "ALL Hands On Deck!" 2027 Critical-Care Symposium
attributes.venue: The Founders Inn and Spa, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
attributes.summary:
The Tidewater Chapter of AACN holds its first "ALL Hands On Deck!" Critical-Care Symposium on February 19 and 20, 2027, at The Founders Inn and Spa in Virginia Beach. Topics include ventilator liberation, the ICU Liberation (A–F) bundle, delirium, post-ICU syndrome, healthy unit culture and caregiver wellbeing, with a nursing track and a PT/OT track on day two.

The program lists 12.0 contact hours, including 1.0 pharmacology, submitted to AACN for approval. Early-bird two-day rates (until December 6, 2026) are $250 for chapter members and $300 for others, rising to $300 and $350 afterwards; single-day tickets start at $150. AACN president Tonka Williams and podcast host Kali Dayton are among the announced speakers.

attributes.title: AHNA Regional Conference: Augusta
attributes.summary:
A Saturday of hands-on self-care practice for nurses, on February 20, 2027, at Augusta University. Aromatherapy, energy healing, mindfulness, movement and resilience are the topics, with lunch included and 6 CE contact hours.

This one is more about nurse well-being than clinical updates, which may suit someone recovering from a heavy year. Registration through AHNA's online shop costs $90 for members and non-members alike.

attributes.title: 45th Annual Winter Refresher
attributes.cme_provider: New Mexico Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.organizer: New Mexico Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
AAFP has reviewed this single-day program for up to 7 Live Prescribed credits, a useful number if you need a quick top-up. The 2027 agenda covers pediatric sports concussion, obesity medicine beyond surgery, billing and coding, personality disorders in primary care, transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis and in-flight medical emergencies.

A $229 room rate holds until January 18, 2027. Registration costs $340 for AAFP member physicians, $470 for non-member physicians and $295 for NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists and retired physicians. Family medicine residents and medical students pay a $25 fee that is refunded after they attend.

attributes.title: 2027 OSPA Mid-Winter CE Seminar in Lane County
attributes.summary:
The Oregon State Pharmacy Association holds its 2027 Mid-Winter CE Seminar on February 20 and 21, 2027, at the Valley River Inn in Eugene, Oregon. OSPA offers ACPE-accredited continuing education and runs the seminar alongside its fall Annual Convention.

Online registration is open, but the session list, CE hours and prices were not shown on the event page we checked. Hotel room block information is promised for fall 2026.

attributes.title: Pediatric Potpourri 2027
attributes.organizer: The Houston Area Chapter of NAPNAP
attributes.summary: Houston-area pediatric NPs can pick up 7 CE credits on a single Saturday, February 20, 2027. The chapter lists the site at 14083 South Main Street. Registration link, prices and topic list are not published yet, so this is only a date to hold for now.

attributes.title: SE SCALI 2027: Collaborating for Student Success
attributes.series: Southeast School Counselor and Administrator Leadership Institute (SE SCALI)
attributes.summary:
The Southeast School Counselor and Administrator Leadership Institute runs February 21 and 22, 2027, at the Renaissance Orlando at SeaWorld. The institute is built for school counselors and the principals and district leaders they work with, and the 2027 theme is "Collaborating for Student Success." John Hodge gives the February 22 keynote, "Be the ONE!", and also leads a breakout on resilience.

Unlike the larger state association conferences, SE SCALI is a compact two-day format centered on extended workshop sessions, which are included in the registration price. The institute is organized by the National Center for Youth Issues, which also manages a number of state school counselor association conferences.

Registration is $200 through January 15, 2027, and $225 after that until the advance deadline of February 17. Refunds end January 21. The hotel block is $249 per night plus a $20 resort fee until February 1. The page does not list CE or NBCC hours, so counselors who need credit for a license should confirm with the organizer.

attributes.title: AGPA Connect 2027
attributes.summary:
AGPA Connect 2027 takes place February 22 to 27, 2027, at the Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel. It has three parts: a one-day Special Institute on February 22, a two-day experiential institute in small training groups on February 23 and 24, and a three-day conference from February 25 to 27.

Early-bird registration closed on October 30, 2026; regular registration is open. The fee amounts and the full session list are not public yet. Plenary speakers include Ramani Durvasula, Candis Smith, Jan Morris and Dennis Kivlighan Jr., and Resmaa Menakem will appear at a public education event. Cancellations are accepted until February 2, 2027, with a $50 charge.

AGPA is ACCME-accredited for physicians, APA-approved for psychologists and an ASWB ACE provider (#1064) for social workers. Its accreditation page also lists the state boards that accept these credits for counselors and MFTs. In 2026 psychologists could earn up to 39 hours, and AGPA did not offer ANCC nursing credit. The 2027 credit totals are not published yet.

attributes.title: CAPNI Annual Conference 2027
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Noblesville Indianapolis Conference Center
attributes.organizer: Coalition of Advanced Practice Registered Nurses of Indiana
attributes.summary:
CAPNI now lists its 2027 conference as Tuesday to Thursday, February 23 to 25, in Noblesville: badge pick-up and a welcome reception on Tuesday, with the educational sessions on Wednesday and Thursday. CAPNI is still filling in the agenda, and sessions include breakfast product theaters, so note which hours are CE and which are industry programs.

The page promises CE, but the number of contact hours is not published yet. The $467 member early-bird rate is tied to registering by October 31, 2026; the standard member price for November 1 to February 14 was not shown when we checked. The discounted hotel block is held until January 24, 2027.

attributes.title: NASP 2027 Annual Convention
attributes.venue: Charlotte Convention Center & The Westin Charlotte
attributes.summary:
The National Association of School Psychologists holds its 2027 Annual Convention February 23 to 26, 2027, at the Charlotte Convention Center and The Westin Charlotte. NASP lists more than 1,200 sessions. A Charlotte Express virtual package covers the general session, eight documented sessions and selected posters.

Full registration costs $279 for members, $114 for graduate students and $529 for non-members through November 18, 2026. Prices then rise to $299, $124 and $549 until January 6, 2027, and to $329, $134 and $569 after that and on site. Daily registration ($199 member, $310 non-member) opens after January 6. The virtual package costs $159 or $385 until January 6.

NASP is approved by the APA to sponsor CE for psychologists, but only Documented Sessions (1.25 hours each, $15–$25 extra) and Workshops (3 or 6 hours, $115–$175) carry NASP/APA-approved CPD. The virtual package offers up to 10.25 hours. Other sessions may count as Category A CPD toward NCSP renewal.

attributes.title: 2027 Law and Ethics in Counseling Conference
attributes.series: Law and Ethics in Counseling Conference
attributes.cme_provider: National Board for Certified Counselors (ACEP No. 800)
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Law and Ethics in Counseling Conference runs February 23 to 26, 2027, in New Orleans, Louisiana, and can also be attended live online over Zoom. It is hosted by the National Board for Certified Counselors (NBCC) together with the University of Holy Cross. Just before it, on February 22 and 23, the NBCC Foundation holds its in-person Bridging the Gap Symposium; registration is offered for either event or both.

NBCC is the CE provider (ACEP No. 800). In-person attendees can earn up to 13 NBCC clock hours and virtual attendees up to 19; only sessions marked as eligible carry credit. The symposium offers up to 6.5 hours, and session recordings, available from March 8 to April 11, 2027, add further hours.

The event hotel is the Sheraton New Orleans Hotel on Canal Street, with a group rate of $209 a night through January 25, 2027. Early-bird pricing ended November 15, 2026. Standard rates for the Law and Ethics conference are $415 in person and $275 live virtual for professionals, and $295 and $155 for students; one-day and half-day in-person tickets start at $219 for professionals and $150 for students. The full session list will follow closer to the event.

attributes.title: 2027 Chicago Dental Society Midwinter Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Chicago Dental Society holds its 2027 Midwinter Meeting February 25 to 27, 2027, at 2301 S. Indiana Avenue in Chicago, the McCormick Place West address. The meeting combines lectures, hands-on courses and a large exhibit hall, and CDS lists it under its Events & CE section with a "Claim CE" service for attendees.

Registration covers the exhibit hall and the right to sign up for CE courses, which are booked separately. CDS member dentists and students register free of charge. From November through January, ADA member dentists from outside CDS pay $179 and non-member dentists $879; hygienists, assistants, office staff and residents pay $79. In February and on site the rates rise to $199, $899 and $99.

Course-level CE hours are shown per course on the meeting's schedule, so no single total is listed here.

attributes.title: 2027 GANE Conference: Excellence and Innovation in Nursing Education
attributes.venue: Augusta Marriott at the Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The Georgia Association for Nursing Education meets February 25 to 27, 2027, at the Augusta Marriott at the Convention Center. Nurse educators from Georgia and other states share research and evidence-based teaching practice through invited talks, podium presentations, hands-on workshops and a poster competition, alongside the annual business meeting. NLN chief executive Beverly Malone is among the featured speakers.

The program carries 12.0 contact hours approved through the Georgia Nurses Association, an ANCC-accredited approver. Full-conference early-bird rates (until December 15, 2026) are $310 for members, $410 for non-members and $220 for students and retirees. Regular rates are $360, $460 and $250, and single-day tickets are available.

attributes.title: 57th Mid-South Conference 2027
attributes.venue: University Center, The University of Memphis
attributes.organizer: University of Memphis School of Communication Sciences and Disorders
attributes.summary: The 57th Mid-South Conference takes place on Thursday, February 25, 2027, on the third floor of the University Center at the University of Memphis. Sessions cover pediatric and adult speech-language pathology, audiology topics such as vestibular assessment and single-sided deafness, coding and reimbursement, plus student posters. The main conference is offered for 0.9 ASHA CEUs through the NSSLHA chapter at the University of Memphis.

attributes.title: 2027 WVSCA Conference
attributes.series: West Virginia School Counselor Association Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The West Virginia School Counselor Association meets on February 25 and 26, 2027, at the Morgantown Marriott at Waterfront Place in Morgantown. The two-day conference runs from 8:00 a.m. on the first day to 3:30 p.m. on the second, with sessions on best practices, evidence-based programming and advocacy for school counselors.

The association says CEUs are available for attendees, with certificates handled through the conference website. The conference pages do not state the number of hours or the approving body, so check with WVSCA if you need a specific credit type for a counseling license or a school certification.

WVSCA members pay $199 through December 18, 2026, and $259 after that; non-members pay $349 and student members $79. Presenters chosen through the call for proposals register at $129 with a code. The registration table runs through February 19, 2027, and the association accepts purchase orders from school districts.

attributes.title: 2027 Music City Veterinary Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Music City Veterinary Conference runs February 26 to 28, 2027, at the Embassy Suites hotel and conference center in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. The Tennessee VMA advertises more than 20 CE hours plus an exhibit hall, and the event is aimed at veterinarians, veterinary technicians, students and practice staff.

Technicians have their own registration rates: a full pass is $265 for TVMA members and $315 for non-members before February 6, 2027, rising by $50 afterwards; single-day passes are also offered. The conference hotel block is $162 per night until February 5, 2027.

The official page does not yet name a RACE program number or a per-attendee CE maximum, so check the session schedule and your state board's rules before counting hours.

attributes.title: 2027 Annual Meeting and Winter Refresher
attributes.summary:
Maryland's family medicine academy holds its 2027 Annual Meeting and Winter Refresher from Friday, February 26, to Sunday, February 28, at the Marriott Owings Mills Metro Centre outside Baltimore. Friday is a pre-conference day, the clinical refresher runs Saturday and Sunday, and a Key Study Assessment session on the care of children closes the program on Sunday afternoon.

Early-bird registration is open through December 20, 2026. The full Friday-to-Sunday bundle costs $375 for MDAFP members, $275 for new-physician members and $650 for non-members, and you can also buy single parts. Residents and students pay $75 for the bundle. The KSA session is priced separately.

The academy lists a $149 nightly room rate at the host hotel. Credit totals were not posted when we checked. Residents and students can submit poster abstracts until December 1.

attributes.title: MDHA Annual Session 2027
attributes.series: Mississippi Dental Hygienists' Association Annual Session
attributes.summary:
The Mississippi Dental Hygienists' Association holds its 2027 Annual Session on Friday, February 26, 2027, at the Old Capitol Inn in Jackson. The day offers continuing education, networking and updates on issues affecting dental hygiene in the state and nationally.

Registration is $150 for MDHA members, $175 for non-member hygienists, dentists and other dental auxiliaries, and $50 for dental hygiene students. The CE hours and speakers are not published yet.

attributes.title: Dental Hygiene Continuing Education Conference (Winter Weekend 2027)
attributes.organizer: Old Dominion University School of Dental Hygiene
attributes.summary:
Old Dominion University's School of Dental Hygiene runs its Winter Weekend continuing education conference February 26 to 28, 2027. The courses are delivered as live and recorded webinars, and the school says attendees can earn 15 hours over the weekend.

There is one in-person piece: an exhibit hall and reception on February 27, 2027 from 6:00 to 8:00 PM in the Priority Club. Registration costs $200 through January 4, 2027 and $250 from January 5. Registration stays open until February 12, 2027; later sign-ups may be accepted if space allows, with a late fee.

The page does not list the course topics or the approval body for the credit. Check with the school (officeofodusodh@odu.edu) whether the hours meet your state board's rules for live or interactive online CE.

attributes.title: 2027 SCOTA Annual Conference
attributes.summary: The South Carolina Occupational Therapy Association meets February 26-27, 2027 at the Columbia Metropolitan Convention Center. Registration offers full-conference and single-day (Friday or Saturday) options, with lower rates through December 31, 2026 and late rates until February 20, 2027.

attributes.title: AASV 58th Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 58th AASV Annual Meeting runs February 27 to March 2, 2027, at the Hilton Orlando Buena Vista Palace in Orlando, Florida. The meeting offers continuing education and networking for swine veterinarians; veterinarians and veterinary students may register, others must meet eligibility rules.

Registration opens in December 2026. AASV members pay $570 if they preregister by February 5, 2027, and $680 after; non-member veterinarians pay $1,050, and veterinary student members attend free. AASV does not seek RACE approval for its sessions, and the CE hours for 2027 have not been published yet. There is no virtual attendance option, although some talks are recorded for members.

attributes.title: 2027 Hawaii Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Hawaii Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Hawaii Chapter of the American College of Physicians packs its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting into a single Saturday, February 27, at the Honolulu Country Club. It suits internists who want a short local update without travel. Residents, medical students and allied health professionals can also register.

The day carries up to 6 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and up to 6 ABIM MOC medical knowledge points. ACP members pay $175 through February 1, 2027, and $195 after that. Retired members pay $100. Nonmember physicians and allied health professionals pay $235. ACP resident and student members attend free, while nonmember residents pay $175 and nonmember students $100.

attributes.title: MNSHA 2027 Hybrid Convention
attributes.summary: The Minnesota Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds a one-day hybrid convention on February 27, 2027, at the Eden Prairie Epicenter, with an online option. Rates until February 1, 2027 are $99 for members and $149 for non-members, rising to $125 and $175 afterwards. Student members pay $10.

attributes.title: NPACE 2027 Boston: Medical March Madness
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary:
NPACE's Boston conference runs Sunday, February 28 to Tuesday, March 2, 2027, at the InterContinental Boston on Atlantic Avenue, with sessions each afternoon from noon to 5:30 pm. The theme is offensive strategies for primary care, with content for advanced practice providers working in team-based care, including medication and drug-interaction updates.

NPACE lists 18+ CE/CME credits. It is an ANCC-accredited provider of nursing continuing professional development and says it will apply for AAPA Category 1 CME credit for PAs. Attendees who stay three or more nights at the conference hotel get $75 off full registration. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists full conference registration at $800, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.

attributes.title: WVC Vegas 2027
attributes.summary:
WVC Vegas 2027 runs Sunday to Wednesday, February 28 to March 3, 2027, at the Mandalay Bay Convention Center in Las Vegas. The organizer describes hundreds of hours of RACE-approved continuing education for veterinarians, veterinary technicians, practice managers and students.

Beyond lectures, the program mixes hands-on labs, workshops, education symposia, industry seminars and learning tracks; some of these formats cost extra. CE is also offered inside the exhibit hall. Discounted room rates are available at Mandalay Bay and nearby hotels through the official housing page. Registration is open: veterinarians currently pay $549 and veterinary technicians, practice managers and other discounted types $349, after earlier lower-priced tiers sold out; students and active military register free.

attributes.title: NACNS 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Clinical Nurse Specialists
attributes.summary:
The National Association of Clinical Nurse Specialists holds its 2027 Annual Conference from March 1 to 4, 2027, at the Loews Kansas City Hotel in downtown Kansas City, Missouri. The meeting is the main yearly gathering for clinical nurse specialists, who work across patient care, nursing practice and systems improvement.

The program draws on abstracts for presentations, pharmacology sessions and posters, with a separate student poster track; both calls have closed. The conference rate at the Loews starts at $289 plus tax and is available until February 5, 2027. Registration fees and the number of contact hours had not been posted on the conference page when we checked.

attributes.title: AAOS 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The AAOS 2027 Annual Meeting takes place March 3 to 6, 2027, in Las Vegas, Nevada, starting on a Wednesday. The American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons offers education, hands-on learning and an exhibit floor; one-hour instructional course lectures (ICLs) are included with registration.

AAOS designates the live meeting for a maximum of 14 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits; it does not offer nursing or allied health credit. Registration opens November 2, 2026, through Maritz; early-bird pricing ends December 6, 2026, and advance pricing and the cancellation deadline fall on January 24, 2027. Fee amounts and the venue were not stated on the official pages at the time of our check.

attributes.title: 35th DRS 2027 Annual Meeting (Virtual)
attributes.summary: The Dysphagia Research Society holds its 35th Annual Meeting online on March 4-5, 2027. The meeting is offered for up to 10 continuing education hours toward ASHA CEUs, plus CME credit; attendees must sign up for CE during registration. Early rates until January 21, 2027 are $255 for members and $355 for non-members, with lower trainee rates.

attributes.title: 2027 IPA Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Indiana Pharmacists Association holds its 2027 Annual Meeting on March 4 and 5, 2027, at the Ritz Charles Conference Center in Carmel, just north of Indianapolis. The meeting brings together pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and student pharmacists from across the state.

IPA is accredited by ACPE as a provider of continuing pharmacy education, and the meeting page states that CE credit is available for both pharmacists and technicians, with some sessions run by the association's Technician Council. Unless a session is marked otherwise, presentations carry CPE credit; attendees sign in, attend each activity and complete the online evaluation within a week.

The total number of contact hours and the registration fees were not published yet when we checked, and parts of the agenda were still marked as coming soon.

attributes.title: ISSTD 44th Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: International Society for the Study of Trauma and Dissociation
attributes.organizer: International Society for the Study of Trauma and Dissociation
attributes.summary:
ISSTD's 44th Annual Conference moves to a four-day format: a pre-conference day on March 4, 2027, followed by the main conference from March 5 to 7 at the Hilton Boston Park Plaza. The theme is "Beacons of Hope: Lighting the Way to Connection and Courage." Registration is open and the preliminary program is published.

For professional members the three-day rate is $589 until December 15, 2026, $689 until January 31, 2027 and $739 after that. Non-members pay $689, $789 and $839, and one-day and student options are cheaper. CE and CME credits cost extra and must be bought in advance.

ISSTD is approved by the APA to sponsor CE for psychologists and is an ASWB ACE provider (#1744) for social workers. CME for physicians is also offered. Credit requires live attendance for the full session, and evaluations close on May 30, 2027. The conference hotel rate is $249 per night.

attributes.title: NASW Montana and Idaho 2027 Conference: Strengthening our Foundation, Cultivating our Future
attributes.summary:
The Montana and Idaho chapters of NASW hold a joint conference, "Strengthening our Foundation, Cultivating our Future", March 4 to 6, 2027, at Delta Hotels Helena Colonial in Helena. It is in person only; Thursday is a Legislative Education and Action Day, followed by two days of sessions.

The registration page lists CE for LCSW, LMSW, LBSW, LCPC and LAC licensees: 2 hours for the Thursday pre-conference workshop, up to 6 on Friday and up to 5 on Saturday. The approving body is not named on the page.

Keynotes are given by Dr. Co Carew, an expressive arts therapist and social work professor, and Dr. Christopher Cutter of the Yale Child Study Center. Base ticket prices were not shown; full-event tickets bought before December 1, 2026 are $50 cheaper, and the hotel block at $169 a night runs until February 18, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 WSCA Conference
attributes.summary:
Aimed squarely at school counselors. Washington clock hours are granted to participants, and in-person registration also unlocks the on-demand content, which helps with sessions that overlap. Pre-conference sessions on March 3 cost extra.

The association offers a sample letter for getting district approval, handy if your school needs a justification before paying. Registration prices below exclude tax; the early rate ends December 18, 2026. The group room rate of $189 is available through February 9, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 ACG's Esophagus School & ACG/FGS Annual Spring Symposium
attributes.series: ACG Esophagus School & ACG/FGS Annual Spring Symposium
attributes.venue: Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort
attributes.summary:
This Naples weekend combines two programs from the American College of Gastroenterology. The Esophagus School fills Friday, March 5, 2027, and ACG notes it should suit community-based gastroenterologists. The Spring Symposium, run with the Florida Gastroenterological Society, follows in half-day sessions on Saturday and Sunday, March 6 and 7, so afternoons stay free.

The Esophagus School carries 7.25 AMA PRA Category 1 credits and the Symposium 9, each with matching ABIM MOC points. Fees are set separately for each part. For the Symposium, members pay $449 and non-member physicians $549 through February 11, and non-member NPs and PAs pay $349. The Esophagus School is cheaper, starting at $125 for members.

The group rate at the Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort is $389 a night plus tax and a $20 daily resort fee, bookable until February 11, 2027. Fees vary by membership level, so check the full table on the ACG page before registering.

attributes.title: Arkansas Summit for Antimicrobial Stewardship 2027
attributes.credits_text: 6.5 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 6.5 AAPA Cat 1 · 6.5 ANCC CH · 6.5 ACPE
attributes.cme_provider: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences
attributes.organizer: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences
attributes.summary:
A useful choice for anyone on a stewardship committee or prescribing in hospital: the day covers resistance trends, newer drugs, how long to treat and team-based prescribing. UAMS designates up to 6.5 AMA PRA Category 1 credits and 6.5 ANCC contact hours, plus 6.5 ACPE contact hours for pharmacists and 6.5 AAPA Category 1 CME credits for PAs.

The venue and fees are not published on the course page yet.

attributes.title: ARAPA 2027 CME Conference
attributes.series: Arkansas Academy of Physician Associates CME Conference
attributes.organizer: The Arkansas Academy of Physician Assistants
attributes.summary:
A compact two-day option for Arkansas PAs: March 5 and 6, 2027, at Chenal Country Club in Little Rock. The academy plans 12 AAPA Category 1 CME credits, but the activity is still awaiting review by the AAPA panel, so treat that number as provisional until it is designated.

The ticket covers both days, the Friday social event and online recordings afterward. Handouts are digital, so download them first. Full-conference registration is $350 for ARAPA members and $475 for nonmembers, or $297.50 and $403.75 at the early-bird rate through January 1, 2027. Single days cost $200 for members and $250 for nonmembers.

attributes.title: 2027 Evidence-Based School Counseling Conference
attributes.venue: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
attributes.organizer: Evidence Based School Counseling Conference Advisory Council
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Evidence-Based School Counseling Conference takes place at the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, with a research day on March 5 and the main conference on March 6 and 7, 2027. It focuses on research and data-driven practice for school counselors, district leaders and counselor educators.

The EBSCC Advisory Council is an NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider (ACEP No. 7478). Attendees earn NBCC clock hours for sessions they attend live and evaluate; the total number of hours was not published.

Registration opens December 11, 2026. The main conference costs $250 through January 31, 2027, and $325 after that; students pay $125. The research day is booked separately at $100, or $75 for students. Keynote speakers and the 2027 program were not published yet when we checked.

attributes.title: GSHA Annual Convention 2027
attributes.summary: The Georgia Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds its 2027 Annual Convention on Friday and Saturday, March 5-6, 2027, at the Gainesville Civic Center in Gainesville, Georgia. Early-bird registration runs until December 25, 2026, at $280 for members and $405 for non-members for the full convention. A hotel block is held at the nearby Courtyard by Marriott.

attributes.title: Internal Medicine for Primary Care: Cardio/Neck & Spine/Pulm
attributes.series: MER Internal Medicine for Primary Care
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ABIM MOC · 4.25 ANCC CH
attributes.summary:
This weekend MER course runs March 5 to 7, 2027, at Paris Las Vegas. It covers cardiology, neck and spine problems and pulmonology for primary care clinicians.

MER lists 12 credit hours, including 4.25 ANCC pharmacotherapeutic contact hours. The early-bird fee is $1,095 until January 4, 2027; hotel rooms start at $179 per night.

attributes.title: 2027 Oregon Veterinary Conference
attributes.venue: CH2M Hill Alumni Center, Oregon State University
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Oregon Veterinary Conference is scheduled for March 5 to 7, 2027, at the CH2M Hill Alumni Center on the Oregon State University campus in Corvallis. The Oregon VMA's speaker list is grouped into companion animal, lameness, food production and practice leadership topics, plus a separate Technicians & Assistants track.

The first technician-track speakers announced are Megan Brashear, CVT, VTS, and Liza Wysong, CVT, VTS. OVMA says sessions that meet Oregon's required CE topics (anesthesia/analgesia methods and antibiotic stewardship) will be flagged in the session descriptions.

Registration opens in January 2027; fees and total CE hours for 2027 are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 TVMA Annual Conference & Expo
attributes.venue: Woodlands Waterway Marriott Hotel & Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The 2027 TVMA Annual Conference & Expo of the Texas Veterinary Medical Association is listed for March 5 to 7, 2027, in The Woodlands, Texas. The association pitches it to veterinarians at every career stage.

The meeting is at the Woodlands Waterway Marriott Hotel & Convention Center, where the TVMA room block is $229 a night if booked by February 5, 2027. Early-bird registration through January 31, 2027 is $480 for TVMA member veterinarians and $580 for non-member DVMs; LVTs, CVAs and hospital staff pay $260 as members or $360 otherwise, and on-site registration adds $50. The CE hour total is not stated on the conference pages yet.

attributes.title: 25th Annual Spring Social Work Conference
attributes.cme_provider: University of Southern Indiana with NASW Indiana
attributes.summary:
A one-day, 25th-anniversary edition, close to home for social workers in southern Indiana and the tri-state area. The university also runs a licensing exam prep workshop alongside the conference series, so newer graduates may want to look at both.

The organizers mention CE hours, but the agenda, hour count, fees and campus location are listed as coming soon.

attributes.title: CRT 2027
attributes.summary:
CRT runs Saturday to Tuesday, March 6 to 9, 2027, at the Washington Hilton. The audience spans interventional and general cardiologists, cardiac and vascular surgeons, electrophysiologists, cath lab managers, nurses and technologists, so it can work as a team trip.

The Academy for Continued Healthcare Learning provides AMA PRA Category 1 Credit and ABIM MOC points. MOC submissions start April 1, 2027, and points must be claimed by December 31, 2027. Credit totals are not published yet because the agenda is still under review. Cancellation costs $250 through December 31, 2026, with no refund from January 1, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 GVTA Spring Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 GVTA Spring Conference is a one-day CE event for veterinary technicians on Saturday, March 6, 2027, from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm on the University of Georgia campus in Athens.

The listing promises CE credit and LEAP credit, with State Board approval. Georgia veterinary technicians can use it toward their renewal hours.

The listing is a save-the-date. The program, fees and hotel details are due later in the fall.

attributes.title: VVMA Winter Conference 2027
attributes.venue: Delta Hotels by Marriott South Burlington
attributes.summary:
Planned with small animal, bovine and equine programming, so a mixed practice can send everyone to one meeting. The Saturday luncheon includes DEA compliance CE, handy if you are tracking the DEA training requirement.

A post-conference evening at the ECHO museum follows on March 6. Speakers, hours and fees are not published yet; the association said details would follow.

attributes.title: MSCA Conference 2027: Igniting Minds, Inspiring Futures
attributes.summary:
The Maryland School Counselor Association holds its 2027 conference on Sunday and Monday, March 7 and 8, at the Hyatt Regency Chesapeake Bay resort in Cambridge, on Maryland's Eastern Shore. The theme is "Igniting Minds, Inspiring Futures: The Path to Infinite Possibilities," and Ashley Wright is listed as keynote speaker with "Passion, Purpose, Position" on March 8.

Alongside the main program, MSCA offers a Lauryn's Law training worth 15 MSDE certification hours for one credit, sold separately for $50. The conference page does not list NBCC or other counseling CE hours, so school counselors who also hold a counseling license should confirm credit details with the association.

Through January 15, 2027, the full conference costs $220 for professional and retiree members, $110 for student members and $280 for non-members; standard rates are $255, $120 and $315. One-day passes and the awards soiree are sold separately. Advance registration ends March 3, refunds end February 7, and the $139 hotel block is held until February 8, 2027.

attributes.title: Academy of Osseointegration 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Academy of Osseointegration holds its 2027 Annual Meeting March 10 to 13, 2027, in San Diego. The meeting focuses on implant dentistry and tissue replacement and draws both specialists and general dentists.

AO is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider and says CE credit will be offered; a day-by-day outline of sessions is posted, while the credit total and fees have not been published yet. Next meetings: Fort Lauderdale (March 9 to 11, 2028) and Las Vegas (March 8 to 10, 2029).

attributes.title: 2027 NASW DMV Joint Annual Conference
attributes.series: NASW DMV Joint Annual Conference (DC, Maryland and Virginia)
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Metro DC Chapter
attributes.summary:
For 2027 the Metro DC, Maryland and Virginia chapters of the National Association of Social Workers combine their annual meetings into one DMV Joint Annual Conference, held March 10 to 13, 2027, at the Kalahari Resort in Spotsylvania County, Virginia (mailing address Woodford, VA). The conference is fully hybrid: all presenters speak in person, and sessions are recorded for registrants who buy a package with on-demand viewing.

The chapters describe a typical audience of about 400 professional social workers, researchers and students, about three-quarters of them with ten or more years in the field. Sessions run 1.5 or 2 hours, and the call for proposals asked for advanced-level content on trauma, telehealth, ethics, race and social work, addiction, grief, technology, private practice and child and youth issues.

The call for proposals closed on October 21, 2026. Registration packages, fees and the total number of CE hours had not been posted when we checked. Presenters may earn up to 7 Category 2 CE hours for preparing and presenting a session; attendees should confirm the 2027 CE total and approvals for their license on the chapter pages once registration opens.

attributes.title: 2027 NASW-LA Annual Conference: Advocacy in Action: The Power of Social Work
attributes.venue: Crowne Plaza Baton Rouge Executive Center
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Louisiana Chapter
attributes.summary:
The Louisiana Chapter of NASW holds its 2027 annual conference March 10 to 12, 2027, at the Crowne Plaza Baton Rouge Executive Center, under the theme "Advocacy in Action: The Power of Social Work." The chapter describes it as a two-and-a-half-day event that usually draws more than 700 social workers, allied professionals and students, with an exhibit hall of more than 50 booths.

Registration details and the 2027 program are not published yet. For comparison, the chapter's 2026 brochure offered up to 20 contact hours for attending the full three-day conference, with sessions labelled clinical or general CEU. Check the 2027 brochure once it is released for the confirmed hours.

A room block at the Crowne Plaza is held at $118 per night plus tax until February 8, 2027, or until it fills (group code ASW).

attributes.title: SCSHP 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: South Carolina Society of Health-System Pharmacists
attributes.summary:
The South Carolina Society of Health-System Pharmacists holds its 2027 Annual Meeting March 10 to 12, 2027 at the Kiawah Island Golf Resort, south of Charleston.

The annual meeting is the society's main education event of the year for hospital and health-system pharmacists in South Carolina.

The event listing gives only the title, dates and venue. Fees, the agenda and ACPE hours were not posted when we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 ACA Conference & Expo
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ACA Conference & Expo runs March 11 to 13, 2027, at the Oregon Convention Center in Portland and marks the American Counseling Association's 75th anniversary. Optional Learning Institutes (member $99, student member $49, non-member $199) take place before the main program opens.

Full-conference fees step up on December 22, 2026 and again on March 9, 2027. Members pay $410 early, $525 regular and $630 late; non-members pay $675, $775 and $875. The $315–$475 tier covers student, new professional and retired members, and student non-members register by phone. ACA lists the conference for counselors seeking continuing education; the exact number of CE hours and the NBCC details are not published yet.

The headquarters hotel is the Hyatt Regency Portland at $269 per night until February 15, 2027. Refund requests close on March 4, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 ANIA Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Anthony J. Jannetti, Inc. (ANCC-accredited provider), jointly with ANIA
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ANIA Annual Conference runs March 11 to 13, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency in San Francisco (Embarcadero). It covers clinical informatics, EHR optimization and digital health topics for nurses.

Registration is open. In-person main conference registration costs $695 for ANIA members and $795 for non-members through February 11, 2027, and $795 and $895 after that and on site. A full-conference virtual package with live broadcasts of general and selected breakout sessions costs $695 or $795 and is listed with 15 ANCC contact hours; one-day in-person rates and separately priced pre-conference workshops on March 11 are also offered. Contact hours are provided through Anthony J. Jannetti, Inc., an ANCC-accredited provider. The Hyatt Regency block rate is $235 per night plus tax until February 9, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 ASDA Annual Scientific Session
attributes.summary:
The Arkansas State Dental Association's Annual Scientific Session runs March 11 to 13, 2027, at the North Little Rock Convention Center. It is the association's largest CE event of the year and also hosts the ASDA General Assembly and the installation of new officers.

The ASDA lists about 16 CE hours on offer. Registration is listed at $330 for members and $630 for non-members.

attributes.title: ArkSHA Convention 2027
attributes.venue: UAMS (University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences)
attributes.summary: The Arkansas Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds its 2027 convention on March 11-12, 2027, at UAMS in Little Rock under the theme "Igniting Innovation, Inspiring Change." Registration opens January 5, 2027, and sponsorship and call-for-proposals pages are already open.

attributes.title: HTRS 2027 Scientific Symposium
attributes.summary:
A narrow meeting on bleeding and clotting disorders, March 11 to 13, 2027, at the Loews Philadelphia Hotel. It suits hematologists who treat hemophilia and thrombosis and also follow the research.

The society's site has a continuing medical education section, but the 2027 credit statement and fees are not published yet on the pages we could read. Confirm credit before relying on this meeting for license hours.

attributes.title: Internal Medicine for Primary Care: Allergy & Immuno/ENT/Geri/Rheum
attributes.series: MER Internal Medicine for Primary Care
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ABIM MOC · 7.5 ANCC CH
attributes.summary:
MER's San Juan course runs March 11 to 14, 2027, at the Royal Sonesta San Juan in Puerto Rico. Topics are allergy and immunology, ENT, geriatrics and rheumatology for primary care.

The course carries 16 credit hours, including 7.5 ANCC pharmacotherapeutic contact hours. The early-bird fee is $1,295 until January 10, 2027, and rooms start at $349 per night.

attributes.title: 57th Annual Winter Refresher Course
attributes.cme_provider: Medical College of Wisconsin and WAFP (held jointly)
attributes.summary:
Early-bird rates opened November 2, 2026, but the academy has not said when they end, so do not assume a cutoff. Member physicians, MCW staff and preceptors pay $370, nonmembers $595, and NPs, PAs and psychologists $420. Each workshop adds $50.

Expect up to 250 attendees and a program built by family physicians. The session schedule is promised for November 2026; the credit total is not stated yet, only that continuing education credit is offered. Residents and students can submit posters until January 15, 2027.

attributes.title: APPSN 2027: New Horizons, Brighter Future
attributes.organizer: The Association of Pennsylvania Professional School Nurses
attributes.summary:
Pennsylvania school nurses gather in State College from March 12 to 14, 2027. The draft agenda prices most sessions at 1.5 CE credits each, including a School Health Update and breakout blocks, with Janice Selekman among the featured speakers.

The attendee fee and total credit count are not published yet. A separate school-based health care conference runs at the same hotel just before it, which may suit nurses interested in that model.

attributes.title: GSHP Spring Meeting 2027
attributes.summary:
The Georgia Society of Health-System Pharmacists holds its 2027 Spring Meeting March 12 to 14, 2027 at the Marriott Savannah Riverfront. GSHP lists three meetings a year (spring, summer and fall) for hospital and health-system pharmacists in Georgia.

The future-meetings page lists only dates and venues. The program, ACPE hours and fees had not been posted when we checked.

The summer meeting follows on July 9 to 11, 2027 at the Omni Amelia Island Resort.

attributes.title: 2027 NMCA Annual Counseling Conference: Counseling with Confidence
attributes.series: New Mexico Counseling Association Annual Counseling Conference
attributes.summary:
The New Mexico Counseling Association's 2027 Annual Counseling Conference, themed "Counseling with Confidence: Guiding Growth in the Southwest", takes place March 12 and 13, 2027, at the Clyde Hotel in Albuquerque.

NMCA lists the continuing education as approved by NBCC. The conference page says attendees can earn up to 16 CE credits, with 3 more from a free virtual pre-conference, though one line on the page shows a garbled total, so confirm the final count with NMCA.

Registration runs through February 15, 2027, or until the event sells out. The page lists two inconsistent early-bird price sets, so we have not reproduced fees here; check the registration page for current prices.

attributes.title: Women's Information in Cardiovascular Disease (WICD) Symposium
attributes.series: Women's Information in Cardiovascular Disease Symposium
attributes.summary:
The main draw is the content on atypical presentations and sex-specific risk factors, which matters in primary care as much as in cardiology clinic. Fees are minimal: $25 for physicians and APPs, $20 for nurses, free for trainees.

UNMC confirms AMA PRA Category 1 credit and ANCC contact hours but lists no totals on the page. Cancel by February 26, 2027 if plans change.

attributes.title: 2027 AANN Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AANN Annual Conference takes place March 13 to 16, 2027, at The Westin Seattle. Pre-conference sessions are on March 13 and the main program starts March 14. It is an in-person meeting, with recorded sessions available afterwards.

AANN says attendees can earn up to 15 CE contact hours, including pharmacology hours. AANN lists registration as opening in November 2026 and has published the rates: members pay $590 before February 24, 2027, and $690 after; nonmembers $820 and $920; students $300 and $400. Daily member registration is $315 or $415, and the Saturday pre-conference sessions cost $75 to $200 extra. Groups of five or more from one facility get 10% off the member rate.

attributes.title: 2027 ADEA Annual Session & Exhibition
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ADEA Annual Session & Exhibition takes place March 13 to 16, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency Chicago. Its theme is "Vision Elevated, Impact Amplified." The American Dental Education Association runs the meeting for the people who teach and train the dental workforce.

ADEA invites faculty, administrators, staff, researchers, clinicians, students, residents, fellows and community partners. For dentists and hygienists who teach, it is the main national meeting on curriculum, assessment and academic leadership in dentistry.

The about page does not list fees or a CE credit statement yet. Questions about the meeting go to meetings@adea.org.

attributes.title: "Across the Water": Empowering School Nurses for Healthier Students
attributes.organizer: Maryland Association of School Health Nurses
attributes.summary:
The Maryland Association of School Health Nurses meets on Saturday, March 13, 2027, at the Chesapeake Bay Beach Club in Stevensville on Kent Island. Topics include advocacy in school nursing, POTS and related disorders, eating disorders, seizure disorders and juvenile arthritis.

The activity has been submitted to the Maryland Nurses Association, an ANCC-accredited approver, and the event page lists 6.0 contact hours. Registration is open: through February 15, 2027, members pay $210 and non-members $250, rising to $235 and $275 afterwards; nursing students, retirees, LPNs and health assistants pay $135, then $150. Cancellations are refunded minus a $50 fee until February 15. Reduced room rates are listed at the Holiday Inn Express on Kent Island ($119) and at Hyatt Place Kent Narrows ($169, book by February 13).

attributes.title: SHAV 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary: The Speech-Language-Hearing Association of Virginia holds a one-day 2027 Annual Conference on Saturday, March 13, 2027, at the Shenandoah University campus in Winchester. The program focuses on pediatric speech and language services and is aimed at school-based clinicians, early intervention specialists and graduate students. Speakers and 2027 rates had not been posted yet.

attributes.title: 2027 Sports and Musculoskeletal Medicine Symposium
attributes.series: UW Sports and Musculoskeletal Medicine Symposium
attributes.organizer: UW Medicine Department of Rehabilitation Medicine
attributes.summary: UW Medicine Rehabilitation Medicine holds its 2027 Sports and Musculoskeletal Medicine Symposium on March 13-14, 2027 at UW Tower in Seattle. The 2027 program centres on spine conditions in athletes and active people and is aimed at physicians, physical therapists, athletic trainers and performance coaches.

attributes.title: 2027 Critical Care Congress
attributes.summary:
The Society of Critical Care Medicine's 2027 Critical Care Congress takes place March 14 to 16, 2027, at the San Diego Convention Center. SCCM describes it as the largest multiprofessional critical care event.

SCCM advertises savings of up to $473 for registering by December 18; full fee tables, CME totals and housing were not shown on the page we checked.

attributes.title: CANP 2027 Annual Educational Conference
attributes.summary:
The California Association for Nurse Practitioners holds its 2027 Annual Educational Conference March 15 to 18, 2027, at the Disneyland Hotel in Anaheim. It brings together nurse practitioners and other clinicians from across California.

CANP has a discounted room block at the Disneyland Hotel at $359 per night plus tax. Registration fees and contact hours were not shown on the conference page when we checked.

attributes.title: Women's Health and Menopause 2027
attributes.series: Women's Health and Menopause (Harvard Medical School)
attributes.credits_text: 62 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 62 ABIM MOC · 62 AAPA Cat 1
attributes.summary:
Women's Health and Menopause runs March 15 to 19, 2027, at the Fairmont Copley Plaza in Boston and can also be attended live online. It is designed for internists, family physicians, OB/GYN, urogynecology and urology clinicians, NPs, PAs, nurses and trainees.

The course carries up to 62 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, 62 AAPA Category 1 CME credits and 62 ABIM MOC points, including 13.5 Massachusetts risk management credits. Early fees until February 15, 2027 are $1,595 for physicians and $1,395 for NPs and PAs; the hotel rate is held until February 22, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 NASW-SD Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The chapter is an approved CE provider with the South Dakota Board of Social Work Examiners, which removes the usual doubt about acceptance for in-state licensees.

For 2027 the chapter is still in planning and has given only the dates and the Denny Sanford center as the site. Hours, fees and program are not published. Anyone interested in helping plan it can contact the chapter directly.

attributes.title: 2027 Annual Assembly of Hospice and Palliative Care
attributes.series: Annual Assembly of Hospice and Palliative Care
attributes.cme_provider: Hospice and Palliative Nurses Association (nursing CE)
attributes.organizer: American Academy of Hospice and Palliative Medicine
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Annual Assembly of Hospice and Palliative Care is held March 17 to 20, 2027, at the David L. Lawrence Convention Center in Pittsburgh. It is presented jointly by AAHPM and the Hospice and Palliative Nurses Association, and draws more than 2,500 hospice and palliative care clinicians. It is an in-person meeting; an Assembly On-Call package sells the recordings.

Registration is open. Physician members of AAHPM or HPNA pay $1,030 through January 13, 2027 ($1,293 after), non-member physicians $1,545 ($1,931); member nurses pay $767 ($968) and non-member nurses $998 ($1,220). One-day and on-call options are cheaper. HPNA is the ANCC-accredited provider of nursing contact hours; the number of CME credits and contact hours for 2027 is not published yet. Credit claims close June 30, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 Annual Conference of the American Psychology-Law Society
attributes.summary:
The American Psychology-Law Society, Division 41 of the American Psychological Association, meets in Louisville, Kentucky, from March 18 to 20, 2027, at the Louisville Marriott Downtown. Optional preconference workshops run the day before, on Wednesday, March 17. The main program follows the society's usual pattern: a welcome reception Thursday evening, a Friday morning plenary with paper, symposium and poster sessions, and Saturday sessions with a data blitz and closing events.

The meeting draws forensic and clinical psychologists, researchers, attorneys and graduate students working on topics such as competency and risk assessment, eyewitness memory, jury decision-making and correctional mental health. The call for proposals closed on October 15, 2026, and the detailed schedule is due in early 2027.

Online registration opens in early 2027. The society lists rates based on 2026, which may change: full members pay $345 before January 31 and $380 after, non-members $490 and $575, and student members $90 and $125, with separate rates for early-career members, non-member students and the workshops. The conference page does not state continuing education credit, so psychologists who need CE should confirm with the society before registering.

attributes.title: 2027 CAPS Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Christian Association for Psychological Studies meets March 18 to 20, 2027, at the Omni Dallas Hotel. The program has pre- and post-conference workshops, more than 100 breakout sessions, poster sessions and special interest group meetings, with an opening gala and a plenary luncheon included in general registration.

Mark McMinn gives the Thursday evening plenary, "Bookends and Pathways: Grace in the Therapy Room". CAPS lists continuing education among the conference features, but the accrediting bodies and hour totals were not published yet when we checked.

Fees were not published on the conference page; pre- and post-conference workshops are registered and paid separately.

attributes.title: CSHA Convergence 2027
attributes.summary: The California Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds Convergence 2027 on March 18-21, 2027, at the Long Beach Convention Center. Hotel blocks are arranged at several area properties, including the Hilton Long Beach, and CSHA says registration and schedule details will be announced later. The 2028 meeting is planned for Sacramento.

attributes.title: 2027 Thomas P. Hinman Dental Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Hinman Dental Meeting is March 18 to 20, 2027, at the Georgia World Congress Center in Atlanta. Registration opens November 10, 2026. The meeting is an AGD PACE recognized provider and awards one hour of credit per lecture hour unless a course states otherwise.

Fees depend on role: a dentist pays $250 through February 18, 2027 and $295 after; hygienists, assistants and office staff pay $90 and $110. Reduced rates apply to dentists in their first or second year of practice and to military dentists. Free categories (students, residents, retired dentists) do not earn CE.

Full refunds are possible until noon EST on March 8, 2027. Hands-on workshops are not refundable. Total CE hours for the meeting have not been published.

attributes.title: MSHA 2027 Virtual Conference
attributes.summary: The Michigan Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference online on March 18-19, 2027. Registration opened November 13, 2026 and closes March 5, 2027, and each attendee needs an individual registration to receive attendance verification. ASHA CEUs and Michigan SCECH credit require the conference continuing education form by March 31, 2027.

attributes.title: NCAMFT 2027 Annual Conference: Alone Together
attributes.series: NCAMFT Annual Conference (North Carolina Association for Marriage and Family Therapy)
attributes.organizer: North Carolina Association for Marriage and Family Therapy
attributes.summary:
The North Carolina Association for Marriage and Family Therapy holds its 2027 annual conference from March 18 to 20, 2027, in Raleigh, with an online option that includes live and recorded sessions. The theme is "Alone Together: Rediscovering Belonging and Connection," a fitting topic for relational therapists working with isolation, loneliness and disconnection in couples and families.

The conference is the state's main yearly gathering for licensed marriage and family therapists, associates and students, and the hybrid format lets clinicians from across North Carolina attend without travel. The association also runs online CE programs and keeps a directory of approved supervisors.

So far NCAMFT has published only the dates, theme, city and format. The venue, fees and number of CE hours had not been posted when we checked in November 2026. LMFTs who need hours for renewal should watch the conference page for the CE statement before registering.

attributes.title: PALTmed27 Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: Post-Acute and Long-Term Care Medical Association
attributes.summary:
Nursing home medical directors and post-acute clinicians meet in Albuquerque on March 18 to 20, 2027. The prospectus counts medical directors among the main attendee groups, so peers here face similar facility problems.

The prospectus separates accredited sessions from industry sessions that carry no CME or CEU credit, so check each session before counting hours. Registration is open, and the meeting can be attended in Albuquerque or online through the Virtual Learning Experience at the same rates; both include conference recordings through April 30, 2027. Physician members pay $740 through January 15, 2027, $845 through March 10 and $970 after that; physician non-members pay $1,050, $1,155 and $1,275. Interdisciplinary professionals pay $485 to $585 as members and $555 to $660 as non-members, and one-day rates are $485 and $305. Registrations are non-refundable but can be switched between in-person and virtual. Credit totals are not published on the registration page.

attributes.title: Psychotherapy Networker Symposium 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Psychotherapy Networker Symposium takes place March 18 to 21, 2027, at the Omni Shoreham Hotel in Washington, DC, with a four-day virtual pass for those who cannot travel.

At the time of our check the in-person pass was offered at $829.99 instead of the listed $1,399.99, and the virtual pass at $299.99 instead of $499.99; the organizer advertises a full refund on cancellation. CE is included in the registration price.

The organizer's CE page says the 2027 Symposium is designed for counselors, social workers, psychologists, marriage and family therapists and addiction counselors, and that it anticipates offering credit in the states it lists. The exact number of CE hours per profession is not published yet, so check your state on the organizer's CE page.

attributes.title: 2027 Capital Region Dental Convention: SDDS MidWinter in Bloom
attributes.summary:
This two-day Sacramento convention offers 13 hours of CE on March 18 and 19, 2027. California licensees get a practical bonus: courses are labeled Core or 20% to match Dental Board of California renewal categories, so you can see how a course counts before you sit down.

The lowest rate ended November 9, 2026. Through February 28, 2027, an ADA member dentist pays $485 for both days, against $950 for a non-ADA member, and prices rise again on March 1. Written cancellations by February 19, 2027 get a refund minus $25, and the same date is the hotel cutoff for the $259 Sheraton Grand rate.

Hygienists teach several sessions, and the auxiliary rate sits well below the dentist price. One hands-on adhesive course costs $89 extra and is for dentists only.

attributes.title: SSO 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
Surgical oncologists meet in Washington, DC, on March 18 to 20, 2027. It is useful for general surgeons with a cancer-heavy practice as well as fellowship-trained specialists.

SSO offered CME for its 2026 meeting, but the 2027 credit total, venue and fees are not published yet on the society page we could read. The 2027 event site blocked our check, so confirm those details there before booking.

attributes.title: 75th Annual Scientific Assembly
attributes.organizer: West Virginia Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
The West Virginia Academy of Family Physicians marks its 75th Annual Scientific Assembly from March 18 to 20, 2027, at Oglebay Resort in Wheeling. It is the academy's main yearly CME meeting for family physicians in the state.

Attendee registration already has its own page on the academy site, and a call for poster abstracts was open when we checked. WVAFP had not posted fees, credit totals or a hotel rate yet, so check back before you budget for the trip.

attributes.title: 2027 AAD Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AAD Annual Meeting takes place March 19 to 23, 2027, in San Francisco, California. Alongside the scientific sessions it includes an exhibit hall, affiliate group meetings and a practice-management day called The Business of Dermatology.

Registration is open. Early-bird fees apply until noon Central time on February 17, 2027: $1,135 for physician members, $2,635 for non-member physicians and $340 for residents and fellows. Standard fees after that are $1,365, $3,170 and $445. The meeting is in person only, with no virtual attendance option. The academy states the meeting is approved for AMA PRA Category 1 Credit, but the total was not listed on the pages we checked; the venue has not been named there either.

attributes.title: APhA2027 Annual Meeting & Exposition
attributes.summary:
APhA2027, the American Pharmacists Association's annual meeting, runs March 19 to 22, 2027, at the Charlotte Convention Center in Charlotte, North Carolina, with The Westin Charlotte as headquarters hotel. APhA marks it as its 175th anniversary meeting. Education sessions run Friday and Monday, the exposition with presentation theaters opens Friday evening and runs Saturday and Sunday, and the APhA House of Delegates meets at the start and end of the meeting.

Attendees earn continuing pharmacy education credit for the education sessions, but APhA has not published the total number of CE hours or ACPE activity numbers yet. Early-bird rates run until February 12, 2027: $830 for members and $1,215 for nonmembers for the full meeting, with lower rates for new practitioners, students, pharmacy technicians and retirees and one-day passes from $390. Technicians have their own registration rates, but the official pages do not yet state technician CE hours.

Friday's keynote is Salim Ismail and Sunday's is Sekou Andrews. The 2028 meeting is planned for Seattle (March 17 to 20, 2028).

attributes.title: APTA South Carolina 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary: APTA South Carolina holds its 2027 Annual Conference on March 19-20, 2027 at the Lexington Medical Center main campus in West Columbia. Sponsor and exhibitor registration is open, and the chapter says further details are coming.

attributes.title: 3rd Annual Cherry Blossom Allergy Conference
attributes.cme_provider: American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.organizer: American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.summary:
A weekend format starting Friday evening, March 19, and ending at midday on March 21, 2027, so most allergists can attend with little time out of clinic. ACAAI designates up to 8.5 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits.

Registration is $275, and students, residents and fellows in training attend free. The hotel rate is $409 a night, with reservations due February 26, 2027. Refund requests are accepted through March 5 less a $75 fee.

attributes.title: NCCN 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The NCCN 2027 Annual Conference runs March 19 to 21, 2027, at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront. A nursing program and an oncology fellows program take place on March 18.

Registration is open, with the best rates available through December 14, 2026, and virtual attendance is offered for those who cannot come to San Diego. NCCN says CE and MOC credit will be available for the oncology team; the credit totals are not on the conference page, and the fee table sits on the registration site, so we list no amounts.

attributes.title: 2027 NDHA Annual Session
attributes.summary:
The Nebraska Dental Hygienists' Association holds its 2027 Annual Session on Friday, March 19, 2027, in Bellevue, Nebraska. The one-day program is for practicing hygienists, educators and students and includes vendor breaks, student presentations and the NDHA induction ceremony.

The posted agenda lists CE for each block: myofunctional therapy updates (1.5), the mouth-body connection and case acceptance (1.5), unusual clinical cases (1.0), the membership meeting (1.0), caries arrest and repair (1.5), the vendor and student session (0.5) and advanced operator positioning (1.0), which adds up to 8.0 CE for the full day. A Courtyard room block is offered at $114; registration fees are on the registration form.

attributes.title: NHIA 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
NHIA 2027 takes place March 19 to 23, 2027, at the Gaylord Pacific Resort & Convention Center in the San Diego area. It is the main yearly meeting for home and alternate-site infusion: pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, infusion nurses, dietitians and the executives who run infusion pharmacies. Preconference seminars cover the foundations of home infusion, sterile compounding, parenteral nutrition (new for 2027) and an executive track, and there is a separate sterile compounding clinic.

NHIA says the recorded conference sessions are worth more than 30 CE hours for pharmacists, technicians, nurses and dietitians; the exact live CE total and ACPE activity numbers are not published yet. General conference registration is $930 for members and $1,195 for nonmembers through January 6, 2027, rising to $1,270 and $1,575 from February 18. Students and residents with NHIA student membership register free until March 12.

The group hotel rate at the Gaylord starts at $349 per night and is available until February 23, 2027 or until the block sells out; booking details come with the registration confirmation.

attributes.title: PAOS Ortho in the West 2027
attributes.summary:
PAs in Orthopaedic Surgery (PAOS) lists Ortho in the West for March 19 to 21, 2027, in Scottsdale, Arizona, under its live CME and conferences. The course is aimed at PAs and NPs who treat a broad range of adult and pediatric orthopaedic conditions, covering evaluation and both surgical and non-surgical management.

Registration opens December 1, 2026. The venue, CME hours and fees have not been published yet.

attributes.title: SGO 2027 Annual Meeting on Gynecologic Cancer
attributes.series: SGO Annual Meeting on Gynecologic Cancer
attributes.summary:
Gynecologic oncologists meet at the Phoenix Convention Center on March 19 to 22, 2027. The science centers on clinical trials and new therapeutics. Candidates for the certifying exam can add early-morning board roundtables, and Friday masterclasses on coding, high-stakes procedures and communication carry separate small fees.

The registration page notes that guest badges carry no CE credit, which implies credit for other categories, but the credit total is not published yet. Most fees appear only in an image we could not verify, so we list none. Refunds less $100 are available through March 5, 2027.
