A virtual registration is also offered: general sessions and plenaries are live streamed and other sessions are posted within 24 hours, and in-person registrations can be switched to virtual until March 12, 2027.

attributes.title: 63rd Annual Conference & Alumni Weekend
attributes.series: UGA College of Veterinary Medicine Annual Conference & Alumni Weekend
attributes.venue: UGA Center for Continuing Education and Hotel
attributes.organizer: University of Georgia College of Veterinary Medicine
attributes.summary:
The University of Georgia College of Veterinary Medicine holds its 63rd Annual Conference & Alumni Weekend March 19 and 20, 2027 at the UGA Center for Continuing Education and Hotel in Athens, Georgia. The weekend combines continuing education for veterinarians with class reunions and college events.

Registration opens in early December 2026. The group hotel rate covers March 18 to 21 and must be booked by February 16, 2027.

The event page does not list the fees, CE hours or RACE approval yet. Graduates are asked to update their contact details with the college so they receive the program.

attributes.title: INSPAN 2027 Spring Education
attributes.venue: Ascension St. Vincent William K. Nasser, MD, Healthcare Education and Simulation Center
attributes.summary:
Perianesthesia nurses can earn 7 contact hours for very little money on March 20, 2027, in Indianapolis. Oddly, attending in person is the cheaper choice at $40, with breakfast and lunch included, while virtual costs $55.

Hours are awarded once you complete the survey at the end, and undergraduate nursing students attend free.

attributes.title: SIR 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Society of Interventional Radiology holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting from Saturday, March 20, through Wednesday, March 24, at the Los Angeles Convention Center. SIR pitches the meeting to the whole career range in interventional radiology, from trainees and early-career physicians to senior operators.

Registration runs through the separate sirmeeting.org site. SIR's event page did not list fees, credit totals or hotel details when we checked, so confirm those there before you book travel.

attributes.title: 2027 Charter Oak Conference
attributes.summary:
ConnAPA's Charter Oak Conference returns to Water's Edge Resort and Spa in Westbrook, Connecticut, March 21 to 23, 2027. The academy describes it as a CME conference with educational sessions, hands-on workshops, networking and an exhibit hall for PAs from across the state.

The CME credit count, fees, hotel rate, speakers and registration link are not published yet; ConnAPA says details will follow in the coming months.

attributes.title: 48th National Conference on Pediatric Health Care
attributes.series: NAPNAP National Conference on Pediatric Health Care
attributes.organizer: National Association of Pediatric Nurse Practitioners
attributes.summary:
NAPNAP's 48th National Conference on Pediatric Health Care takes place March 21 to 24, 2027, at the SAFE Credit Union Convention Center in Sacramento, California, with a pre-conference day on March 20. NAPNAP describes more than 70 sessions plus intensive workshops for pediatric nurse practitioners.

The early registration rate runs until January 29, 2027. On-demand access to recorded content is offered after the meeting, and a separate California advocacy lunch with legislator visits is planned for March 24. Contact hours for 2027 have not been published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 SNRC Nursing Research Workshop & Conference
attributes.venue: Seattle Children's Sand Point Learning Center
attributes.summary:
If you are starting an evidence-based practice project or need to present one, this meeting on March 22 and 23, 2027, in Seattle mixes workshops with poster and podium sessions. The organizers show 6 contact hours and also mark CE hours as still to be determined, so the final count may change.

Contact hours are offered whether you attend one day or both. The one-day price shown is for Monday.

attributes.title: 2027 Red Rock CME/CE Conference for PAs
attributes.series: Red Rock CME/CE Conference for PAs
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Red Rock CME/CE Conference, run by the Utah Academy of Physician Assistants with the Nevada academy, moves north to the Utah Valley Convention Center in Provo for March 29 to 31, 2027. It is live only, with no virtual option, and open to PAs, NPs, PA and NP students and other clinicians.

Early-bird pricing runs through November 25, 2026: $350 for UAPA members and $440 for nonmember PAs (membership included), rising to $400 and $490. Students pay $75 and one-day passes cost $225 or $300. The Hyatt Place Provo offers $154 per night with breakfast.

The academy expects about 18.5 credits and will submit the program to AAPA once the agenda is final in November; one line on the same page still says 20.0, so check the final number. Speakers are not announced yet.

attributes.title: SEMPA 360 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
SEMPA 360 2027, the annual conference of the Society of Emergency Medicine PAs, takes place in Nashville, Tennessee. SEMPA's save-the-date gives March 30 to April 3, 2027, while its event calendar lists March 30 to April 2 at the Omni Hotel; pre-conference workshops start March 30.

Full registration is $690 for SEMPA members and eligible military, $990 for non-members and $450 for PA student members. Optional hands-on workshops run by USACS cost extra: critical procedures ($350), ultrasound ($350), airway ($325) and slit lamp ($250), each with limited seats.

SEMPA awards CME credit for SEMPA 360, claimed through its CME site after the conference evaluation. The credit type and number of hours for 2027 have not been published yet.

attributes.title: SHEA Spring 2027
attributes.credits_text: 58 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 58 ABIM MOC · 58 ANCC CH · 20 ACPE
attributes.cme_provider: Society for Healthcare Epidemiology of America
attributes.organizer: Society for Healthcare Epidemiology of America
attributes.summary:
SHEA Spring 2027 runs March 30 to April 2, 2027, in Washington, D.C., with the Omni Shoreham Hotel as the conference hotel. Topics include healthcare epidemiology, infection prevention and antibiotic stewardship.

SHEA is jointly accredited and offers up to 58 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and 58 ANCC contact hours, including a pre-meeting workshop. Pharmacists can earn up to 20 live CPE hours from the stewardship course and selected sessions.

The group hotel rate is $289 a night until February 26, 2027. Early registration through February 2, 2027 is $1,030 for SHEA members and $1,430 for non-members, rising to $1,230 and $1,530 until March 8 and to $1,330 and $1,630 on site. Fellows, students and trainees pay $599 to $799.

attributes.title: SHM Converge 2027
attributes.summary:
SHM Converge 2027 runs March 30 to April 2, 2027, at Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino in Las Vegas; March 30 is for pre-courses and the main conference begins March 31. The meeting is in person only, but most sessions are recorded and the full package includes on-demand access through 2030.

Abstracts are accepted through November 23, 2026, and early-bird pricing (a $200 saving) ends January 27, 2027. The On Demand-only package is listed at $525 for members and $685 for nonmembers; the in-person rates are shown only inside the registration system, and CME credit details and the 2027 schedule were not yet published.

attributes.title: AACD 2027
attributes.venue: Signia by Hilton Diplomat Beach Resort
attributes.summary:
AACD 2027, the scientific session of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry, runs March 31 to April 3, 2027 at the Signia by Hilton Diplomat Beach Resort in Hollywood, Florida. The program centers on esthetic and restorative dentistry and mixes general sessions, hands-on workshops and exhibitor events.

Attendance is limited to AACD members: the conference site states that you must be an AACD member to register. Course selection opens in two waves, on November 30, 2026 for PRIME (early) registrants and on December 7, 2026 for everyone else. Tuition covers breakfasts Thursday through Saturday, lunches on Thursday and Friday, the welcome reception and exhibitor socials.

The organizer had not yet posted fees or the CE credit statement when we checked. Confirm credit hours and the cancellation policy on the official site before you book travel.

attributes.title: CAPCSD 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: Council of Academic Programs in Communication Sciences and Disorders
attributes.summary: The Council of Academic Programs in Communication Sciences and Disorders holds its 2027 Annual Conference from March 31 to April 3, 2027, at the Atlanta Marriott Marquis. The meeting serves faculty and leaders of SLP and audiology academic and clinical programs. Early-bird registration runs January 5 to February 19, 2027, at $650 for members and $800 for non-members.

attributes.title: ENRS 39th Annual Scientific Sessions
attributes.summary:
The Eastern Nursing Research Society holds its 39th Annual Scientific Sessions from March 31 to April 2, 2027, at the Loews Philadelphia Hotel. The theme is "Forging Bridges: Connecting to Advance Nursing Science in a Changing Research Landscape." The meeting serves nurse scientists, faculty, doctoral students and research-minded clinicians, largely from the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

The keynote speaker listed on the conference site is Angela Frederick Amar, PhD, RN, dean of NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing. Registration is open on the conference website. Full-conference early-bird rates, valid until February 11, 2027, are $545 for members, $655 for non-members and $350 for student members; from February 12 to March 6 they rise to $655, $765 and $450. One-day rates for Thursday or Friday are also listed. Refunds less a $75 fee are available for cancellations received by March 5, 2027. The Loews room block starts at $269 per night plus taxes until March 8, 2027. Contact hours were not shown on the pages we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 ENT for the PA-C
attributes.series: ENT for the PA-C Annual CME Conference
attributes.organizer: Society of Physician Assistants in Otorhinolaryngology/Head & Neck Surgery
attributes.summary:
SPAO-HNS, the society for PAs in otolaryngology and head and neck surgery, holds ENT for the PA-C in New Orleans from March 31 to April 4, 2027: two optional hands-on workshop days followed by three lecture days. The conference venue hotel is the Hilton New Orleans Riverside, with a group rate of $272 a night until March 9, 2027.

The society will submit the program for AAPA Category 1 CME; the number of credits is not published. Early-bird registration through January 24, 2027 is $825 for members and $925 for nonmembers, then $1,000 and $1,100. Students pay $525 and each workshop costs $175 early or $195 later. Registrations after March 14, 2027 carry a $100 fee.

SPAO-HNS notes that NPs can often claim AAPA credit but should check with their certifying body.

attributes.title: HOPA Annual Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 HOPA Annual Conference of the Hematology/Oncology Pharmacy Association takes place March 31 to April 2, 2027, in St. Louis, Missouri. It brings together hematology/oncology pharmacists, residents and other members of the cancer care team for three days of education, research posters and networking.

The meeting is at the America's Center Convention Complex, and HOPA says it will offer 30.5 CE credits, including 8.0 BCOP credits. The event website with the schedule is live; early-bird registration and housing open in early December 2026. Early-bird fees are $599 for full and associate members and $850 for non-members, rising to $799 and $1,075 after January 22, 2027; residents, fellows and technicians pay less, and student members attend free. Trainee research abstracts are due January 3, 2027.

attributes.title: 40th International Seating Symposium (ISS 2027)
attributes.organizer: University of Pittsburgh School of Health and Rehabilitation Sciences
attributes.summary: The 40th International Seating Symposium returns in person to the David L. Lawrence Convention Center in Pittsburgh on March 31-April 2, 2027, with pre-conference sessions on March 30. CEUs are issued by the University of Pittsburgh as an AOTA Approved Provider and are accepted for Pennsylvania PTs and PTAs, RESNA ATP and NRRTS credentials.

attributes.title: MNRS 51st Annual Research Conference
attributes.venue: Amway Grand Plaza by Hilton & DeVos Place Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The Midwest Nursing Research Society holds its 51st Annual Research Conference from March 31 to April 3, 2027, at the Amway Grand Plaza by Hilton and DeVos Place Convention Center in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The theme is "Bridging Healthcare Access through Nursing Scholarship, Partnership, Policy, and Practice." Nurse researchers, faculty, PhD and DNP students and clinical nurse scientists from the Midwest make up most of the audience.

Registration is open. Cancellations before February 12, 2027, are refunded minus a $50 service fee, and registrations can be transferred to a colleague. Registered attendees can book the Amway Grand Plaza at $204 per night plus taxes until February 26, 2027. Late-breaking abstracts open December 8, 2026. Fee amounts and contact hours were not shown in text on the conference page when we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 NJLN Convention and Pre-Convention
attributes.summary:
The New Jersey League for Nursing holds its 2027 Convention and Pre-Convention on Wednesday, March 31, and Thursday, April 1, 2027, at Harrah's Resort in Atlantic City. The theme is "The Art & Science of Nursing: Where Knowledge, Compassion, and Leadership Converge."

The first day opens with a full-day Pre-Convention Nurse Educator Program for faculty, clinical nurse educators and nursing education students, followed by an evening keynote. The main convention on April 1 is aimed at nurses and healthcare leaders at every career stage, from New Jersey and neighboring states.

NJLN says attendees can earn contact hours but has not posted the number or the fees; registration was marked as opening soon when we checked, and registrations are non-refundable. Hotel rates at Harrah's apply to reservations made by March 9.

attributes.title: OMA Annual 2027
attributes.summary:
Physicians preparing for the American Board of Obesity Medicine exam should note the review course on March 31 and April 1, 2027 (up to 12.5 CME, $565 for members and $765 for nonmembers at early rates). It precedes the main conference in Orlando on April 2 to 4, which offers up to 17.5 CME/CE.

Early conference rates through February 19, 2027 are $795 for members, $1,115 for nonmembers and $505 for clinicians in training. Costs go up the next day, but the later amounts are not published yet. Some courses may be capped. The page does not state the accreditation type or name a venue.

attributes.title: 2027 Partners in Treatment: Scottsdale
attributes.summary:
Cheap for clinicians, with a $99 pass. It is also a referral-network event, with 140+ vendors expected, so plan to meet treatment programs as much as to attend talks. Up to 11.5 CE credits apply when pre-conference workshops are added.

Accreditation is not final: the organizer says it intends to offer APA credits and/or NBCC hours, with confirmation to be posted. Hold off on counting these hours until that appears. Hotel rooms at We-Ko-Pa are $209 a night and have sold out in past years.

attributes.title: 2027 SPA Convention & Workshops
attributes.series: SPA Annual Convention & Workshops (Society for Personality Assessment)
attributes.summary:
The Society for Personality Assessment holds its 2027 Annual Workshops and Convention March 31 to April 4, 2027, in Long Beach, California. The meeting brings together clinicians, researchers, educators and students who work in personality and psychological assessment, with pre-convention workshops followed by the main convention.

SPA is approved by the American Psychological Association to sponsor continuing education for psychologists, and is also a New York State Board for Psychology approved CE provider. The program, speakers, CE hours and registration fees for 2027 are not published yet; SPA says registration opens in the fall.

The convention page names The Westin Long Beach as the hotel, with room block details still to come. The call for proposals and sponsorship packages are already available on the convention page.

attributes.title: 2027 ABVP Symposium
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ABVP Symposium takes place April 1 to 4, 2027, at the Marriott Marquis Chicago. The American Board of Veterinary Practitioners runs it as a species-focused clinical meeting; registration categories include general veterinarians, ABVP diplomates and candidates, residents, students and a veterinary technician rate.

ABVP says the 2027 scientific program will be released in November 2026 and the early-bird deadline will be announced later; the rates currently shown are 2026 figures marked as subject to change, so we do not list them. The hotel rate is $279 per night until March 8, 2027.

The page links a New York State CE approval; total CE hours and RACE status for 2027 are not published yet.

attributes.title: ADAA 2027 Conference
attributes.organizer: Anxiety and Depression Association of America
attributes.summary:
Membership changes the math here: ADAA tells members they get a reduced rate and complimentary CE, usually 18 or more credits per conference, while credit is issued through Amedco. Anyone attending for treatment updates on anxiety and depression should price both routes.

ADAA labels the event CE-eligible and says Amedco is approved by APA for psychologists. Its CE page mentions ASWB and NBCC for its programs, but a 2027 breakdown by license is not published. Registration rates are listed as coming soon.

attributes.title: ANPA 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.series: Arkansas Nurse Practitioner Association Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
Arkansas NPs meet at the Statehouse Convention Center in Little Rock from Thursday afternoon, April 1, through Saturday, April 3, 2027. The extra Thursday preconference is the part to look at if you prescribe in midlife care: it covers menopause hormone therapy, with an evening reception after it.

Every full and Friday-Saturday ticket includes the recorded sessions afterward, which helps if you must leave early. ANPA says contact-hour totals, pharmacology hours and accreditation details are not published yet, so check them before you count this toward a renewal. Workshops cost extra and have limited space. The fees shown are for Friday and Saturday; adding the Thursday preconference raises each by $100.

attributes.title: 2027 Mid-Atlantic States Conference for Bovine Practitioners
attributes.series: Mid-Atlantic States Conference for Bovine Practitioners
attributes.summary:
The whole program is about cattle practice, so food animal veterinarians can spend both days on their own caseload. MDVMA promises networking and CE hours.

Registration runs from November 30, 2026 to March 29, 2027. Speakers, CE hours and fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: Pacific Northwest Dental Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
PNDC 2027 is scheduled for April 1 to 3, 2027, at the Summit building of the Seattle Convention Center. WSDA says attendees can earn more than 20 dental CE credits in three days, and all lectures are included in registration; hands-on workshops cost extra.

Registration is open. WSDA member dentists pay $430 through the February 12, 2027, early-bird deadline and $530 after; recent graduate members pay $280 or $380, and WSDA ADA Life Members attend free. Washington State non-member dentists pay $2,178 early and $2,278 after. Team pricing is listed on the registration site. Future dates are already set for April 20 to 22, 2028.

attributes.title: RMPA 2027 Convention
attributes.summary:
A regional meeting with a teaching and student flavor, which makes it a good fit for faculty and supervisors: the Thursday opens with a teaching conference. RMPA is approved by APA to sponsor CE for psychologists, though it has not said how many hours 2027 will carry.

The practical date is March 3, 2027, when the early rate ends and $25 is added. Submissions close December 1, 2026.

attributes.title: 4th Annual UNMC Transplant Symposium
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Omaha La Vista Hotel and Conference Center
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ANCC CH · ACPE
attributes.summary:
The 2027 theme follows the patient from referral through long-term graft care, which helps referring clinicians as much as transplant teams: expect sessions on when to refer, frailty and nutrition, waitlist decisions and infections after transplant.

Non-UNMC physicians and other providers pay $300; outside nurses, case managers, dietitians and social workers pay $100. UNMC lists the credit types but no hour totals yet, and dietitian credit is still pending. Registration closes March 25, 2027.

attributes.title: Spring 2027 Acute and Critical Care Neuro Symposium
attributes.series: Acute and Critical Care Neuro Symposium
attributes.summary:
A full day on neuro care for bedside nurses, built around DaiWai Olson, PhD, RN, whose research looks at how nursing care affects outcomes after acquired brain injury. It takes place April 1, 2027, in Oxnard, with 6 CE credits listed.

The approving body and registration fee are not published yet.

attributes.title: VECCS Spring Symposium 2027, Napa Valley
attributes.organizer: Veterinary Emergency and Critical Care Society
attributes.summary:
The VECCS Spring Symposium in Napa Valley runs April 1 to 4, 2027, at the Napa Valley Marriott Hotel & Spa and offers 18 CE hours in veterinary emergency and critical care. The event is open to VECCS members only.

Veterinarians pay $700 through January 7, 2027, and $800 afterwards; technicians, interns, residents, practice managers and students pay $550, then $650. Rooms start at $299 per night; attendees who stay outside the room block may be charged an extra $500 if the block does not fill. A second 2027 Spring Symposium takes place in Costa Rica.

attributes.title: 2027 WVLPCA Annual Spring Conference
attributes.cme_provider: West Virginia Licensed Professional Counselors Association
attributes.organizer: West Virginia Licensed Professional Counselors Association
attributes.summary:
Built with West Virginia renewals in mind: up to 16 CEUs over two days, with sessions on ethics, veterans and the ALPS requirement. Attending virtually saves $91 on the full conference, and single-day tickets suit anyone short only a few hours.

The association is an NBCC approved provider, ACEP No. 6267.  Speakers are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 APTA NE Annual Conference
attributes.summary: The Nebraska chapter meets April 2-3, 2027 at the Truhlsen Events Center on the UNMC campus in Omaha, starting with a Friday evening kickoff reception and awards. Saturday brings sessions attendees choose on site, plus the chapter business meeting. The chapter lists up to 6 contact hours for attending all three sessions.

attributes.title: APTA Wisconsin Spring Conference 2027
attributes.summary: APTA Wisconsin lists its Spring Conference for April 2, 2027, from 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM Central, at the Memorial Union on the UW-Madison campus. It is the chapter's one-day spring education event for physical therapists and PTAs.

attributes.title: ASCRS 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: American Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgery
attributes.summary:
The ASCRS 2027 Annual Meeting takes place April 2 to 5, 2027, in San Diego, with separate programs for anterior segment surgeons, practice administrators (ASOA) and technicians and nurses. Registration is open, and the early-bird rate ends Friday, January 22, 2027.

Fee amounts and the overall CME statement were not shown on the meeting pages we checked. ASCRS says the new Middle Segment Surgery Day on Friday, April 2, carries up to 6.5 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits.

attributes.title: Fetch Nashville Veterinary Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
Fetch Nashville 2027 is a two-day dvm360 conference on April 2 and 3, 2027, at the Music City Center in downtown Nashville. The organizer describes small-classroom learning with RACE-approved CE credits and an exhibition hall, aimed at the whole practice team.

General registration prices and the total number of CE hours have not been published yet. A separate VSS Priority Pass for practice decision-makers requires a refundable deposit tied to scheduled vendor meetings.

attributes.title: Joint ICHP & MSHP Spring Meeting 2027
attributes.summary:
The Illinois Council of Health-System Pharmacists and the Missouri Society of Health-System Pharmacists hold a joint Spring Meeting on April 2 and 3, 2027, at the Sheraton Westport Chalet in St. Louis.

ICHP states that it is accredited by ACPE as a provider of continuing pharmacy education for both pharmacists and pharmacy technicians. The number of contact hours, the program and registration fees were not published yet when we checked; the organizers were still collecting presentation proposals.

Hotel and travel details will be added by the organizers later.

attributes.title: Annual MEAPA CME Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The Maine Academy of Physician Associates holds its annual CME conference April 2 and 3, 2027, at the AC Hotel Portland Downtown/Waterfront. Both days combine CME lectures with an exhibit hall.

The listing shows 12.0 CME credits, while the description says the academy is planning for at least 10, so treat the final number as not yet confirmed. Two-day registration is $400 for members and $525 for nonmembers through March 1, 2027, then $480 and $630; one-day and student rates are also offered.

Speakers and the agenda are not published yet.

attributes.title: SWPA 2027
attributes.summary:
The Southwestern Psychological Association meets from April 2 to 4, 2027, at the Royal Sonesta in Houston, Texas. Like the other regional psychological associations, SWPA runs a research-centered program of talks, posters, symposia and workshops, and it hosts four affiliate groups at the convention: SAMR, SWToP, Psi Chi and SCBNA.

SWPA folds membership dues into the registration fee, so every registrant becomes a member. Professionals who want continuing education credit register in a separate category, Professional Member Seeking CE Credits, at $250 through January 24, 2027, $275 through March 14 and $300 on site. The association's pages do not list the number of CE hours or the approving body, so licensed psychologists should confirm that the credit meets their board's rules.

The standard professional rate is $150 early, $175 online and $200 on site, and student members pay $80, $100 or $130. The call for submissions closes November 23, 2026. SWPA asks attendees to book at the Royal Sonesta to help meet its room commitment, and the hotel offers discounted self-parking for attendees.

attributes.title: WSU Veterinary Spring Conference 2027
attributes.venue: WSU College of Veterinary Medicine (Veterinary Teaching Hospital and Bustad Hall)
attributes.organizer: Washington State University College of Veterinary Medicine
attributes.summary:
Washington State University's College of Veterinary Medicine holds its Spring Conference April 2 to 4, 2027 on the Pullman campus. Friday evening, April 2, is optional and features the Bustad Lecture at 5:30 p.m.; the main CE program runs over the weekend.

There are large animal, small animal and technician tracks, and the college invites veterinarians, technicians and assistants. Sessions are held in the Veterinary Teaching Hospital, Bustad Hall and the Animal Disease Biotechnology Facility. Some labs are limited to one group and to 22 to 24 seats, so they need advance registration. The page lists 12 CE credits.

The page still showed 2026 prices ($325 early for veterinarians, $200 early for technicians), so expect 2027 fees to be posted later. Questions go to CVME@vetmed.wsu.edu.

attributes.title: SCVS 54th Annual Symposium
attributes.summary:
Vascular surgeons gather at the Diplomat in Hollywood, Florida, on April 3 to 7, 2027. Separate tracks exist for fellows and chief residents, incoming fellows and young surgeons, so trainees should look at those applications early.

Two dates fall together on March 1, 2027: the early-bird deadline and the $359 room-block cutoff. Past symposia issued CME certificates through a Cine-Med claim link. The 2027 credit total and fee amounts are not published yet on the pages we could read.

attributes.title: AAPP 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Annual Meeting of the American Association of Psychiatric Pharmacists (AAPP, formerly CPNP) runs April 4 to 7, 2027, at The Galt House Hotel in Louisville, Kentucky, with a virtual option that streams sessions live. It is aimed at psychiatric pharmacists and other clinicians who treat patients with psychiatric and neurologic disorders.

AAPP, an ACPE-accredited provider, says the meeting will offer 20+ contact hours of knowledge- and application-based CE, plus 10 hours of dually accredited ACPE and BCPP recertification content through the separately sold Clinical Application Series. The posted schedule includes sessions on difficult-to-treat panic disorder, behavioral symptoms of dementia, mood stabilizers, antipsychotic pharmacogenomics, substance-related psychosis, involuntary commitment and new medications.

AAPP lists anticipated rates: in-person registration is $799 for members and $1,065 for nonmembers until March 4, 2027, then $920 and $1,190. The Galt House group rate is $239 per night until March 11, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 ANPD Aspire Convention
attributes.summary:
The Association for Nursing Professional Development holds its 2027 Aspire Convention from April 4 to 8, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency New Orleans. The five-day program is aimed at nurses who run orientation, onboarding, competency and continuing education programs in hospitals and health systems.

The main convention carries 19.75 ANCC-accredited NCPD contact hours. Optional pre-convention workshops on Monday, April 5, add 3 contact hours each, and a two-day NPD certification preparation course adds 14 contact hours.

Full registration is $750 for members and $1,030 for non-members, with one rate regardless of when you register; a single day costs $400, and groups of three or more pay less. The hotel block at $279 per night closes March 12, 2027, the same day as the last date for a refund.

attributes.title: HIMSS27 Global Health Conference & Exhibition
attributes.summary:
Physician informaticists and CMIOs may find HIMSS27 useful mainly for its preconference day on Monday, April 5, 2027, which costs extra, and the sessions running April 6 to 8 at McCormick Place in Chicago.

HIMSS lists the program as eligible for ACCME credit, and also for nursing and pharmacy credit, with totals still to be determined. Most of the event is an exhibition, so check that the sessions you pick are accredited. Fees are not published yet on the pages we checked.

attributes.title: MASCA Conference 2027: Navigating the Waves of Innovation
attributes.summary:
The Massachusetts School Counselors Association meets on April 5 and 6, 2027, at the Renaissance Framingham Hotel & Conference Center, west of Boston. The theme is "Navigating the Waves of Innovation," and Terri Tchorzynski gives the April 6 keynote, "Courageous Redesign: Designing Proactive Systems for Stronger Student Outcomes." A pre-conference is offered on the first day, and the main conference can also be followed virtually.

In-person registration costs $225 for professional members, $115 for student members and $285 for non-members through January 31, 2027, then $249, $140 and $305 until the advance deadline of April 1. Virtual access is cheaper ($130 to $145 for members, $200 to $215 for non-members), and retiree members get a reduced rate. The pre-conference is priced separately.

The hotel block is $175 per night until March 5, 2027. The conference page does not list PDPs, NBCC hours or other continuing education credit, so Massachusetts school counselors who need PDPs for license renewal should confirm with MASCA before registering.

attributes.title: NPACE 2027 Hilton Head: Sun, Sea and Science
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: NPACE's spring conference on Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, runs April 5 to 7, 2027, at the Sonesta Resort. Under the subtitle Practical Updates in Patient Care it offers clinical updates for nurse practitioners and other advanced practice providers, with 18+ CE/CME credits listed by NPACE. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists full conference registration at $1,050; staying three or more nights at the conference hotel takes $100 off, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.

attributes.title: Together for Children 2027
attributes.venue: The Wilderness Resort, Glacier Canyon Conference Center
attributes.summary:
A multidisciplinary meeting where child welfare, health care and mental health staff sit in the same room, helpful for clinicians whose trauma cases cross into protective services. Review panels look at applicability to continuing education when choosing sessions.

The organizer says CE hours will be posted as accrediting bodies approve them, so which licenses are covered is not published yet. Fees are also still to come.

attributes.title: PharmaCon27
attributes.venue: Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort
attributes.summary:
GAPNA's PharmaCon27 takes place April 6 to 10, 2027, at the Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort in Honolulu. The conference is built around pharmacology for nurse practitioners and clinical nurse specialists caring for older adults in primary and specialty settings.

Attendees can earn up to 18 ANCC contact hours, all of which count as pharmacology. Full registration costs $329 for members and $459 for nonmembers through February 9, 2027 (postmark), then $409 and $539; the on-demand package has the same early rates and a one-day in-person pass is $102 or $180. The discounted hotel rate is available through March 4, 2027, and written refund requests are accepted until February 23, 2027.

attributes.title: SAGES 2027
attributes.organizer: Society of American Gastrointestinal and Endoscopic Surgeons
attributes.summary:
SAGES 2027 runs April 6 to 9, 2027, at the Rio Hotel in Las Vegas, starting on a Tuesday. The 2028 meeting is planned for Charlotte, North Carolina.

The dedicated 2027 meeting site was not reachable for us, so fees, registration and the CME statement are not listed here yet.

attributes.title: 2027 WIN Conference: 60th Annual Communicating Nursing Research Conference
attributes.summary:
The Western Institute of Nursing holds its 60th Annual Communicating Nursing Research Conference from Tuesday, April 6, to Friday, April 9, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Bellevue on Seattle's Eastside. The anniversary theme is "Celebrating 60 Years of Excellence in Nursing Research, Practice, and Education." Nurse researchers, educators, clinicians and students from the western states present studies and posters.

Registration opens in December 2026. WIN lists anticipated fees of $550 for individual members, $735 for non-members and $380 for member students, new graduates and retirees, with $50 off for registrations received by February 15, 2027; late and onsite rates from March 29 are about $100 higher. The hotel block at $219 per night closes March 15, 2027. The number of contact hours was not stated on the conference page.

attributes.title: AAA Annual Convention 2027
attributes.summary: The American Academy of Audiology holds AAA 2027 April 7 to 10, 2027, at America's Center Convention Complex in St. Louis; registration opened to members on November 10, 2026 and to everyone on December 2. An audiologist professional member pays $565 until February 24, 2027, $615 in the advanced period and $715 on site; student members pay $80 to $100. Registration includes educational sessions, the expo and poster hall, and CEUs. Non-member rates are on a separate page.

attributes.title: AHNS Annual Meeting at COSM 2027
attributes.summary:
Head and neck surgeons meet in Seattle on April 7 and 8, 2027, with pre-courses on April 6. The meeting is part of the larger Combined Otolaryngology Spring Meetings, which runs through April 11 and brings other ENT societies to the same place, so you can extend the trip.

The Sheraton Grand Seattle is the second listed site. Past AHNS meetings at COSM were designated for AMA PRA Category 1 Credit, but the 2027 credit total, fees and registration link are not published yet.

attributes.title: NCADN Council 2027 Spring Conference
attributes.venue: Holiday Inn Resort Lumina on Wrightsville Beach
attributes.organizer: The North Carolina Associate Degree Nursing Council
attributes.summary:
Nursing faculty from North Carolina's associate degree programs meet April 7 to 9, 2027, at Wrightsville Beach for 5 CE credits. Conference fee and NCADN membership are sold together, so check whether your program already pays for membership.

The early price runs through February 15, 2027, and walking in costs more.

attributes.title: 2027 PPA Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Pediatric Pharmacy Association meets April 7 to 10, 2027 in Indianapolis, Indiana. The annual meeting is the association's main in-person education event for pharmacists who work in pediatric care.

When we checked, PPA was collecting session proposals for the 2027 meeting, with deadlines on September 15 and December 1. The venue, fees, ACPE hours and registration details had not been posted.

PPA also runs a virtual fall program. Check the annual meeting page for the full 2027 schedule once it is released.

attributes.title: SEPA 73rd Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Southeastern Psychological Association holds its 73rd Annual Meeting from April 7 to 10, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Greenville in Greenville, South Carolina. SEPA is one of the regional psychological associations, and its meeting mixes research talks, posters and invited addresses with a continuing education track for practicing psychologists.

SEPA is approved by the American Psychological Association to sponsor continuing education for psychologists. CE is sold separately from registration through the Raymond D. Fowler Continuing Education Program: workshops run from one to six hours ($30 for one hour up to $120 for six hours), and selected invited addresses carry one hour of credit for $30. How many hours you earn depends on the sessions you book.

Professional members pay $115 in advance registration through March 3, 2027, and $170 on site; non-member professionals pay $185 in advance and $235 on site. Students pay $95 (member) or $165 (non-member) in advance. Member dues must be current as of September 1, 2026, to get the member rate.

attributes.title: Spear Summit 2027
attributes.summary:
Spear Education lists 14 CE credits for its Orlando summit on April 7 to 10, 2027. Spear's PACE approval covers FAGD and MAGD credit through March 31, 2028, which is useful if you are working toward either award.

This is a meeting from a private education company, so expect it to sit alongside Spear's paid courses and membership. Spear aims it at general dentists, specialists and dental teams but does not mention hygienists by name, so hygienists should confirm credit acceptance with their board first.

Prices and the venue are not published yet. Spear says early registration locks in lower rates.

attributes.title: AOTA INSPIRE 2027 Annual Conference & Expo
attributes.summary: AOTA INSPIRE 2027 takes place April 8 to 10, 2027, in Boston, with the Westin Boston Seaport as headquarters hotel. Full conference registration for an OT member is $527 until February 1, 2027, and $599 after; OTA members pay $466/$529, student members $365/$415 and non-members $840. Daily passes are also sold. Attendees track sessions on a contact hour form and claim their own contact hours after the conference.

attributes.title: ArSHA 2027 Convention
attributes.summary: The Arizona Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds its 2027 Convention on April 8-10, 2027, at the DoubleTree by Hilton Phoenix Mesa. The theme is "Connecting the Dots: One Purpose, Many Paths," and the convention includes the annual membership meeting. The group hotel rate of $174 is available until March 19, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 NASW-MI Conference: Woven Together
attributes.summary:
Fourteen-plus CEs in two days makes this a sizeable part of a Michigan renewal, and the theme, Evolving Practice, Uniting Every Space, suggests a mix of clinical and macro content. One-day registration keeps it affordable for those near Grand Rapids.

Online registration closes March 26, 2027, and refund requests made at least two weeks ahead lose $100. Hotel rooms at the Sheraton are $139 a night through March 24.

attributes.title: New Orleans Dental Conference & LDA Annual Session 2027
attributes.series: New Orleans Dental Conference & LDA Annual Session
attributes.summary:
Attendees can earn up to 18 hours of CE across April 8 to 10, 2027, and the New Orleans Dental Association is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider. Louisiana dentists may also want to note that the meeting doubles as the state association's annual session.

Hygienists should check the "Of Interest To" line on each course, because not every session is marked for them. In the current draft, Mason's courses on April 9 and Arteaga's on April 10 are, while Goodacre's and Seibert's are not. The organizer says the course page is still in progress, so this can change.

Registration fees and the venue are not published yet for 2027.

attributes.title: OPA Annual Conference & Trade Show 2027
attributes.summary:
The Ohio Pharmacists Association's 2027 Annual Conference & Trade Show is set for April 8 to 10, 2027, in Columbus, Ohio, on a Thursday-to-Saturday schedule. OPA says pharmacists and pharmacy technicians can earn continuing pharmacy education credit, and vendors exhibit products and services in the trade show.

Registration and event details are due in January 2027. The venue, number of CE hours and fees have not been published yet; the 2026 conference was held at the Hilton Columbus at Easton.

attributes.title: 2027 VSHP Spring Seminar
attributes.summary:
The Virginia Society of Health-System Pharmacists holds its 2027 Spring Seminar April 8 to 10, 2027 at Kalahari Resorts & Conventions in Spotsylvania County, Virginia. The society has already set the same venue for the 2028 spring seminar.

VSHP runs two seminars a year. The fall seminar is held at Kingsmill Resort in Williamsburg, and the 2027 fall edition is November 4 to 6. The spring meeting gives health-system pharmacists in Virginia a second chance during the year to earn live CE.

The future-dates page does not include CE details. Check the society's site for the program and ACPE hours once they are posted.

attributes.title: 2027 WNA APRN Pharmacology & Clinical Update
attributes.venue: Oneida Casino Hotel (formerly Radisson Hotel and Conference Center)
attributes.summary:
WNA has set the 2027 APRN update for April 8 to 10 at the Oneida Casino Hotel in Green Bay, moving from last year's Wisconsin Dells site. The 2027 hours and prices are not published yet. For a sense of scale only, the 2026 edition offered up to 17.5 contact hours, with pharmacology hours marked session by session.

That session-level marking matters: WNA leaves it to you to confirm that a session meets your own pharmacology requirement. WNA is approved as a provider through the Montana Nurses Association, an ANCC-accredited approver.

attributes.title: 2027 AANS Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AANS Annual Scientific Meeting, themed "Navigating the Impossible," runs April 9 to 12, 2027, in San Diego. Registration and housing booking are open on the meeting site; abstract submission closed on October 4, 2026.

Early-bird rates run through January 7, 2027: $1,099 for AANS member physicians and $499 for member allied and advanced-practice team members. Advance rates ($1,299 and $599) apply through March 4, 2027, which is also the housing deadline, and late rates start March 5. Non-member neurosurgeons pay $2,299 at every stage.

AANS has not yet posted a 2027 CME credit statement, and the pages we read do not name the meeting venue.

attributes.title: 2027 CACVT Spring Conference
attributes.organizer: Colorado Association of Certified Veterinary Technicians
attributes.summary:
The Colorado Association of Certified Veterinary Technicians holds its 2027 Spring Conference April 9 to 11, 2027, at the Omni Interlocken Hotel in Broomfield, between Denver and Boulder. CACVT describes it as a weekend of continuing education and networking for the veterinary technician community; registration is required.

Registration, the program and hotel details are not published yet, and the CE hour total and RACE status have not been announced.

attributes.title: 2027 NDA Annual Session
attributes.summary:
Nebraska's dental association holds its next annual session on a single day, April 9, 2027, at the Embassy Suites in La Vista, just south of Omaha. A one-day format means most Nebraska practices can attend with little time away from the office.

The association calls this its signature CE event for dental professionals in the state. Courses, credit hours, fees and team rates are not published yet, so check back before you book. Whether hygienists are covered is also not stated.

attributes.title: OSLHA Convention 2027
attributes.summary: The Ohio Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds its 2027 Convention on April 9-10, 2027, at the Quest Conference Center in Westerville, near Columbus. The program mixes 60- and 90-minute courses, quick talks and poster sessions, and attendees can earn up to 1.2 ASHA CEUs. Early two-day rates until February 14, 2027 are $240 for members and $350 for non-members.

attributes.title: 37th Annual Trends in Critical Care & Leadership
attributes.summary:
At $65 with breakfast and lunch included, this one-day symposium on April 9, 2027, near Cincinnati is one of the less expensive ways for ICU nurses to catch up. Paramedics are welcome too, since the program also carries EMS CE.

Nursing contact hours come through Bon Secours Mercy Health, approved through the Virginia Nurses Association, an ANCC-accredited approver. The page says credit will be announced when approved, so the hour total is not published yet.

attributes.title: ACC.27 Together With WCC
attributes.summary:
ACC.27 is the American College of Cardiology's 2027 Annual Scientific Session, held jointly with the World Heart Federation's World Congress of Cardiology. It runs April 10 to 12, 2027, at the George R. Brown Convention Center in Houston, Texas.

There are in-person packages (standard and PLUS) and a virtual @Home option, with three price tiers for in-person registration: early bird until December 2, advance until February 24 and regular until April 12. The hotel block closes on Thursday, March 18, 2027. ACC has not yet published the number of CME credits on the pages we checked.

attributes.title: AORN Global Surgical Conference & Expo 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AORN Global Surgical Conference & Expo takes place April 10 to 13, 2027, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It is the national meeting of perioperative nurses, combining accredited education sessions with a large surgical products exhibit hall.

AORN describes the program as offering accredited learning, but the number of contact hours, registration fees and the convention venue have not been published yet. A student program with complimentary access is planned. We will add credits and prices once AORN releases them.

attributes.title: Psych Congress NP Institute 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Psych Congress NP Institute is listed for April 10 to 13, 2027, in Boston. HMP Global aims it at psychiatric nurse practitioners and NPs interested in psychiatry.

The venue, credit hours and fees had not been published on the Psych Congress events page when we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 Annual SoCal ARN Chapter Conference
attributes.cme_provider: California Board of Registered Nursing Provider 007495
attributes.organizer: Southern California Chapter of the Association of Rehabilitation Nurses
attributes.summary:
Rehabilitation nurses in Southern California can earn 6 CEU credits on April 10, 2027, in Buena Park, under the theme of augmenting care and accelerating recovery. The provider is approved by the California Board of Registered Nursing (Provider 007495).

A group rate applies to three or more people from one facility, nonmembers included, so it makes sense to register together. Early prices shift starting December 20, 2026; the later prices are not shown yet.

attributes.title: Aortic Symposium 2027
attributes.venue: UW Health Eastpark Medical Center, Learning Center
attributes.credits_text: 6 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 6 AAPA Cat 1 · 6 ANCC CH
attributes.organizer: University of Wisconsin-Madison Interprofessional Continuing Education Partnership
attributes.summary:
If you occasionally find an aneurysm on imaging and wonder what happens next, this course is aimed at you: surveillance intervals, genetic testing and when open or endovascular repair makes sense. Six credits for $100 is good value for physicians; PAs and nurse practitioners pay $50, and nurses, residents, fellows and students pay $25.

It also carries 6.00 MOC points through the American Board of Surgery. The $99 hotel block at Cambria Madison East runs until March 9, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 Nurse Practitioner Spring Symposium
attributes.summary:
NCNA's 2027 Nurse Practitioner Spring Symposium takes place April 11 to 13, 2027, at the Wilmington Convention Center on the North Carolina coast. The 2028 edition is already set for April 2 to 4, 2028, at the Sheraton Imperial Hotel in Durham.

NCNA is an ANCC-accredited provider and lists the CNE amount as to be determined. The agenda, pharmacology hours, fees and hotel block are not published yet.

attributes.title: AONL 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
AONL 2027, the annual conference of the American Organization for Nursing Leadership, takes place April 12 to 15, 2027, in Phoenix, Arizona. The audience is nurse leaders, from front-line managers to chief nursing officers.

AONL advertises more than 40 hours of continuing education, depending on which sessions are attended; it is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development. Registration is open. The full conference is listed at $1,325 for AONL members and $1,650 for non-members, with early-bird pricing through February 26, 2027; AONL does not say what the rate will be after that date. Single-day registration starts at $625 and a digital pass (keynote livestream plus recordings) at $399. The venue has not been named on the conference pages yet.

attributes.title: NASW-FL 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Florida Chapter
attributes.summary:
The Florida Chapter of NASW holds its 2027 annual conference April 12 to 14, 2027, at the Florida Hotel and Conference Center in Orlando. The chapter says the meeting draws more than 400 social workers and mental health professionals from Florida and beyond.

The call for proposals asked for the workshops Florida social workers need for license renewal (domestic violence, ethics and telehealth, laws and rules update, and clinical supervision update), plus tracks on clinical innovations, emerging issues, policy and advocacy, and a student showcase. Final CE hours, the program and registration fees are not published yet; the chapter says registration opens in 2027.

The conference hotel offers a $140 group rate with a cutoff of March 26, 2027.

attributes.title: NatCon 2027
attributes.venue: New Orleans Ernest N. Morial Convention Center
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ANCC CH · APA CE · NBCC
attributes.summary:
NatCon 2027 is the annual conference of the National Council for Mental Wellbeing. It runs April 12 to 14, 2027, at the New Orleans Ernest N. Morial Convention Center. People attending a preconference or the Mental Health First Aid Summit start earlier in the week. The organizer expects more than 5,000 attendees and 500 speakers.

Registration has three price stages. Early rates run until January 12, 2027: $975 for 100% association members, $1,025 for members and $1,275 for non-members. Advance rates of $1,075, $1,125 and $1,375 apply until February 26. Standard rates are $1,175, $1,225 and $1,475. The pricing page prints the early cutoff as January 12, 2026, which looks like a typo, because the same page says rates rise on January 13.

The National Council says it is applying for credit through ACCME, ANCC, APA, NASW, NBCC, NAADAC and the New York State social work and mental health counselor boards. The approvals and credit totals are not confirmed yet. Hotels are booked through the official onPeak block after registration.

attributes.title: AMCP 2027
attributes.summary:
AMCP 2027, the annual meeting of the Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy, runs April 13 to 16, 2027, at Moscone West in San Francisco. The audience is managed care pharmacy: pharmacists and leaders at health plans and PBMs, biopharmaceutical companies, integrated delivery networks, consultants, actuaries and researchers. AMCP expects more than 4,000 attendees.

The program centers on coverage, cost and formulary decisions, real-world evidence, precision medicine and population health, and AMCP says attendees earn CE. The number of CE hours, ACPE details and registration fees have not been published yet. AMCP members save up to $400 on registration, and booking in the AMCP hotel block gives a further $100 off (student members excluded).

attributes.title: SSWAA 2027 National School Social Work Conference
attributes.series: SSWAA National School Social Work Conference
attributes.cme_provider: School Social Work Association of America (ASWB ACE #1789)
attributes.organizer: School Social Work Association of America
attributes.summary:
The School Social Work Association of America holds its 2027 National Conference April 13 to 16, 2027, at the Loews Ventana Canyon Resort in Tucson, Arizona. Attendance is capped at 750, and SSWAA expects the conference to sell out.

Early-bird registration ends October 31, 2026, and is payable by card only. Purchase orders are accepted from November 1. Pre-registration closes on March 13, 2027, after which registration is on site if space allows. The fee amounts are not shown in text on the conference page.

SSWAA is an ASWB ACE provider (#1789), and attendees earn social work CE for the sessions they attend. SSWAA has selected the presenters, but the full agenda, the keynote speakers and the total CE hours are not published yet.

attributes.title: AAE27 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
AAE27, the American Association of Endodontists' annual meeting, is set for April 14 to 17, 2027, in San Antonio. The AAE is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider.

The venue, fees and CE total for 2027 have not been posted yet. Members pay reduced rates, and exhibitor badges do not include CE. Later meetings are planned for Toronto (2028) and Seattle (2029).

attributes.title: 2027 NASW West Virginia Hybrid Spring Social Work Conference
attributes.series: NASW West Virginia Spring Social Work Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, West Virginia Chapter
attributes.summary:
The West Virginia Chapter of NASW runs its 2027 spring conference Wednesday through Friday, April 14 to 16, 2027, at the Charleston Coliseum & Convention Center, with a hybrid option for those who cannot travel. The chapter has run this meeting each spring as its main CE conference for social workers in the state; the 2025 edition was billed as the Spring CE Conference for Social Workers.

The 2027 program, CE hour total and fee amounts are not published yet. Early-bird registration is open through December 31, 2026, and session proposals are accepted until November 15, 2026.

Exhibitors and sponsors register separately, with an early discount code listed on the chapter page.

attributes.title: 2027 NONPF 53rd Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: National Organization of Nurse Practitioner Faculties
attributes.summary:
NONPF's 53rd Annual Conference is set for April 14 to 18, 2027, in New Orleans. It is aimed at nurse practitioner educators and covers curriculum and competency-based assessment, AI and simulation in teaching, clinical placements and preceptors, faculty development, student success and DNP education.

The venue, fees and contact hours were not in the material we could read; we will add them once NONPF publishes them.

attributes.title: 52nd Annual ONS Congress
attributes.summary:
The 52nd Annual ONS Congress runs April 14 to 18, 2027, at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, DC. Over five days the Oncology Nursing Society offers clinical sessions, a learning hall and industry events for oncology nurses.

Registration opens in November 2026. Members pay $685 and nonmembers $1,095 when they register by February 25, 2027; regular rates are $835 and $1,335. Full-time RN students and retired RNs aged 65 or older have reduced rates ($345 early for students, $480 early for retirees), and one-day passes are sold for Thursday through Saturday ($480 member, $770 nonmember) and for Sunday.

Refunds are full, less a $100 fee, until February 25, 2027, and 50% until March 19, 2027. Housing is booked through Maritz, the official housing provider; the Marriott Marquis and the Westin Washington, DC Downtown are the headquarters hotels. The number of contact hours has not been published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 AALNC Annual Forum
attributes.venue: Hyatt Regency San Francisco Downtown SOMA
attributes.cme_provider: American Association of Legal Nurse Consultants
attributes.organizer: American Association of Legal Nurse Consultants
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AALNC Annual Forum for legal nurse consultants takes place April 16 and 17, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency San Francisco Downtown SOMA, with a Pre-Forum day on April 15. AALNC says session details will be posted closer to the event.

AALNC is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development. Contact hours require attending each session in full and completing session and event evaluations; the total number of hours is not published yet.

Early-bird pricing runs through November 30: $950 for members and $1,235 for nonmembers (the nonmember rate includes membership). Standard rates are $995 and $1,280, the Pre-Forum costs $225, and registration closes March 22, 2027.

attributes.title: AAS 54th Annual Scientific & Technology Conference
attributes.series: American Auditory Society Annual Scientific & Technology Conference
attributes.summary: The American Auditory Society holds its 54th Annual Scientific & Technology Conference on April 15-17, 2027, at the Kimpton Miralina Resort & Villas in Scottsdale, Arizona. The meeting focuses on translational hearing and balance research for audiologists, scientists and clinicians. Abstract submissions are due January 1, 2027.

attributes.title: ACP Internal Medicine Meeting 2027
attributes.summary:
The ACP Internal Medicine Meeting 2027 runs April 15 to 17, 2027, at the Los Angeles Convention Center, with pre-meeting focused topic sessions starting April 13. It is the American College of Physicians' main yearly education event for internists and subspecialists, with ticketed hands-on clinical skills workshops.

Standard access costs ACP members $899 through January 31, 2027, and $999 after; resident members pay $399 or $439, and non-members $1,579. Premium access, with a year of recordings, costs more ($1,779 early for members, $2,795 for non-members). The hotel discount deadline is March 18, 2027; the headquarters hotel is the JW Marriott at LA Live. ACP says the CME credits and MOC points for 2027 will be posted about a month before the meeting.

attributes.title: 2027 LAMFT Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: Louisiana Association for Marriage and Family Therapy
attributes.summary:
LAMFT says the 2027 meeting will lean on connection within the state's MFT community, so expect networking to get real time alongside education. It is a useful stop for Louisiana clinicians who want to meet supervisors and colleagues in one place.

Speakers, sessions, fees and CE hours are not published yet. The association runs its own CEU program, and its past conferences offered roughly 18 to 20 hours, but treat that as history until the 2027 number appears. The site's heading still says 2026 while the date line reads April 15 to 17, 2027.

attributes.title: NBASLH 49th Annual Convention
attributes.organizer: National Black Association for Speech-Language and Hearing
attributes.summary: The National Black Association for Speech-Language and Hearing holds its 49th Annual Convention on April 15-17, 2027, in Cincinnati, Ohio. NBASLH describes it as the largest annual educational meeting for African American audiologists, speech-language pathologists and scientists, with a focus on cultural and linguistic diversity. Venue and fees had not yet been posted.

attributes.title: NJSHA 2027 Annual Convention
attributes.summary: The New Jersey Speech-Language-Hearing Association holds its 2027 Annual Convention on April 15-16, 2027, at the APA Hotel in Iselin, just off the Garden State Parkway. The association is collecting presentation and student poster proposals. Rooms are offered at $165 per night until March 24, 2027 or until the block fills.

attributes.title: 2027 Oklahoma Veterinary Conference
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Norman Hotel & Conference Center
attributes.summary:
The Oklahoma VMA's next Oklahoma Veterinary Conference is set for April 15 to 17, 2027, in Norman, Oklahoma. The save-the-date lists 21 CE hours and names veterinarians, technicians, practice managers and veterinary students as the audience.

The meeting is at the Embassy Suites by Hilton Norman Hotel & Conference Center, where the group room rate is $130 a night. Registration is open: a complete conference pass costs $430 for OVMA member veterinarians and $700 for non-members, $255 for OVTA member technicians ($280 for non-members) and $220 for practice staff of OVMA members; veterinary and technician students attend free. OVMA notes that early-bird pricing is reflected on the registration form. Any RACE approval is not published yet.

attributes.title: PCNA 2027 Cardiovascular Nursing Symposium
attributes.summary:
PCNA's 33rd Cardiovascular Nursing Symposium is scheduled for April 15 to 17, 2027, in Austin, Texas. The meeting focuses on preventing and managing cardiovascular disease and includes presentations of nursing research, innovation projects and graduate capstones.

The call for abstracts closes December 4, 2026, and authors are notified by January 29, 2027. The venue, fees and contact hours have not been published yet.

attributes.title: APTA Minnesota Annual Conference 2027
attributes.series: APTA Minnesota Annual Conference (Minnesota in Motion)
attributes.venue: DoubleTree by Hilton Minneapolis - Park Place
attributes.summary: APTA Minnesota holds its Minnesota in Motion weekend on April 16-17, 2027 at the DoubleTree by Hilton Minneapolis - Park Place. The chapter describes it as the largest gathering of physical therapy professionals in the state, with a Friday workshop, a Saturday conference, an exhibit hall and continuing education sessions.

attributes.title: 2027 MPA Annual Convention & Exposition
attributes.series: Michigan Pharmacists Association Annual Convention & Exposition
attributes.summary:
The Michigan Pharmacists Association holds its 2027 Annual Convention & Exposition (ACE) in person from April 16 to 18, 2027, at the Lansing Center in downtown Lansing. MPA plans the program for pharmacists, residents, pharmacy technicians and student pharmacists from all practice settings, and the convention usually draws more than 700 people.

Continuing education is one of the stated goals of the meeting, alongside an exhibit hall, networking, a poster session and the association's awards. Session proposals are being reviewed until mid-December 2026, so the program, CE hours and registration fees are not published yet. MPA is reserving a room block at the DoubleTree next to the Lansing Center.

attributes.title: Spring 2027 UNPD Conference
attributes.organizer: Utah Association for Nursing Professional Development
attributes.summary:
UNPD's Spring 2027 conference is set for Friday, April 16, 2027, at Intermountain Medical Center in Murray, near Salt Lake City. It is listed with 5.0 contact hours through University of Utah Health.

Registration is open: UNPD members pay $45 through March 7, 2027, and $65 after; non-members pay $75 or $95, and students $40 to $90. The theme, topics and speakers are not published yet.

attributes.title: Professional Development & Practice Summit 2027
attributes.summary:
The American Nurses Credentialing Center, a subsidiary of the American Nurses Association, holds its Professional Development & Practice Summit from April 17 to 20, 2027, in San Antonio, Texas. The summit is built for people who run accredited programs: nursing continuing professional development providers, practice transition and nurse residency programs, advanced practice provider fellowships and Joint Accreditation providers.

Registration includes more than 15 ANCC contact hours. Advance pricing is $959 for ANA members and $999 for other attendees while the limited advance allotment lasts; the standard rates are $999 and $1,049. The conference room block covers the San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter and the Marriott Riverwalk, which stand next to each other, and closes March 25, 2027.

attributes.title: APTA Missouri 2027 Spring Conference
attributes.summary: The Missouri chapter holds its 2027 Spring Conference on April 17, 2027 at a new location, the 1st Phorm headquarters in Fenton. The chapter expects about 200 physical therapists, PTAs and students, with exhibits, lunch and research posters during the midday break.

attributes.title: MiOTA 2027 Spring Virtual Conference
attributes.summary: The Michigan Occupational Therapy Association holds its spring conference online on April 17, 2027, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. MiOTA has posted the date as a save-the-date notice; program details are to follow.

attributes.title: 2027 UMC SUNA Spring Conference
attributes.series: Upper Midwest Chapter SUNA Spring Conference
attributes.summary:
Urology nurses from around the upper Midwest can earn 4 CEU credits in a Saturday morning, April 17, 2027, in Eagan. The chapter names the California Board of Nursing for the credit, so nurses licensed elsewhere should confirm acceptance.

The $125 price also covers an optional dinner symposium on Friday evening at the same hotel.

attributes.title: 2027 ANNA National Symposium
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ANNA National Symposium for nephrology nurses is held April 18 to 21, 2027, at the Rosen Shingle Creek Hotel in Orlando, Florida. ANNA runs it as a hybrid meeting, so sessions can also be followed by livestream.

The event listing gives April 18 to 21, while the poster call on the same page says April 17 to 21, which may reflect pre-symposium activities. ANNA lists 17.0 ANCC contact hours for the symposium, and full registrants can redeem up to 17.0 more for on-demand sessions. Early-bird rates end February 1, 2027, and in-person pre-registration closes April 5; fee amounts were not shown on the pages we checked, though ANNA says members save $125. The hotel rate is $249 per night until March 22, 2027, and ANNA asks attendees to book rooms only through its own reservation link.

attributes.title: 2027 Mountain Veterinary Conference
attributes.venue: Harrah's Cherokee Casino Resort and Cherokee Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Mountain Veterinary Conference runs April 18 to 21, 2027, at Harrah's Cherokee Casino Resort and the Cherokee Convention Center in western North Carolina. The organizer promises more than 20 hours of live CE lectures.

Registration has a separate category for technicians, receptionists and support staff. The 2027 prices are still marked as to be announced, with an early-registration discount for sign-ups before March 1, 2027; brochure, hotel booking and online registration are listed as coming soon.

The page does not yet name the speakers, state board approvals or RACE status for 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 Wisconsin Association of School Nurses Conference
attributes.series: Wisconsin Association of School Nurses Conference
attributes.summary:
Wisconsin school nurses return to Monona Terrace in Madison on April 19 to 21, 2027. It is jointly provided with the Wisconsin Nurses Association, which has served as the contact-hour provider for this program.

The 2027 theme, hours and registration prices are not published yet. On the 2026 edition, certificates depended on finishing the online evaluation by a set date, so keep an eye on that deadline once it is announced.

attributes.title: Midwest Dental Assembly 2027
attributes.summary:
The Indiana Dental Association's Midwest Dental Assembly 2027 takes place April 21 to 24, 2027, in downtown Indianapolis. The meeting combines CE sessions, a vendor marketplace and social events for dentists and their teams.

The 2027 meeting is hosted at the Indianapolis Marriott Downtown, across from the Indiana Convention Center. Registration costs $400 for IDA member dentists and $600 for non-member dentists; hygienists, assistants and other team members pay $150. The hotel rate is $219 per night if booked by March 20, 2027. CE courses run on Thursday and Friday; the total number of CE hours is not published yet. The IDA is an ADA CERP recognized provider.

attributes.title: Setting The Pace 2027
attributes.series: NYS ENA Setting the Pace Conference
attributes.organizer: New York State Council Emergency Nurses Association
attributes.summary:
The New York State Council of the Emergency Nurses Association holds Setting The Pace 2027, its annual emergency nursing conference, from April 21 to 23, 2027, at the Holiday Inn in Saratoga Springs, New York. The main conference day with the exhibit hall is Thursday, April 22, from 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

The council says more information will follow. Attendees book rooms directly with the Holiday Inn at 232 Broadway. Fees, the agenda and the number of contact hours were not posted when we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 MTAPA CME Conference
attributes.summary:
The Montana Academy of Physician Assistants meets April 22 to 24, 2027, at the University Center on the University of Montana campus in Missoula. It is a live, in-person meeting open to PAs, NPs, physicians and other clinicians.

MTAPA lists 16.0 credits, to be submitted to AAPA once the agenda is final. Early-bird pricing through January 16, 2027 is $400 for members and $500 for nonmember PAs and NPs (with a year of membership), then $450 and $550. Students pay $50 to $85 and one-day passes are $180 to $200. A courtesy room block at the Holiday Inn Downtown Missoula is $149 per night (code MT7).

Speakers and the agenda are not published yet, and registration has not opened.

attributes.title: NASW-MD Ethics Symposium 2027
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Maryland Chapter
attributes.summary:
The Maryland Chapter of the National Association of Social Workers holds its Ethics Symposium, titled Rooted in Justice, on Thursday, April 22, 2027, as a virtual event on Zoom from 8:00 a.m. to 4:14 p.m. Registration is open, and the chapter lists 6 Category I CEUs in ethics; the agenda and fees were not shown on the pages we could read.

A one-day ethics program held online lets social workers cover ethics hours from home or the office. NASW Maryland labels its programs by Maryland CE category, and members receive free or discounted CE at chapter events.

Because the symposium is online, social workers licensed in other states can attend too, but they should confirm that their own board accepts the chapter's CE approval before counting the hours.

attributes.title: 2027 PSW Educational Conference
attributes.summary:
The Pharmacy Society of Wisconsin holds its 2027 Educational Conference April 22 and 23, 2027 at the Monona Terrace Convention Center in Madison. It runs alongside the Wisconsin Pharmacy Residency Conference, where residents give platform presentations.

The meeting includes general sessions, a poster session open to all attendees, and networking for residency directors, preceptors and residents. Session proposals were due January 1, 2027 and poster abstracts by January 19, 2027.

The page lists no fees or ACPE hours yet. PSW is the state's pharmacy society, so watch its calendar for registration.

attributes.title: 2027 Southeast Veterinary Conference
attributes.summary:
SCAV has moved this meeting to new dates and a new site for 2027, so do not rely on older listings for Myrtle Beach. It is pitched at the whole veterinary team, which makes it easy to bring technicians along.

Our source is the association's own announcement graphic; it says registration opens in November. CE hours, fees and the program are not published yet.

attributes.title: SPN 37th Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Society of Pediatric Nurses holds its 37th Annual Conference from Thursday, April 22, to Saturday, April 24, 2027, in San Diego, California. The meeting brings together nurses who care for children and families in hospitals, clinics and community settings.

The theme announced on the conference page is "Anchored by Purpose, Powered by Community." The call for abstracts closed on October 16, 2026. SPN says registration will open soon; the venue, fees and the number of nursing contact hours had not been posted when we checked.

attributes.title: Star of the North Meeting 2027
attributes.summary:
Star of the North 2027 takes place April 22 to 24, 2027, at the Saint Paul RiverCentre. Registration and the hotel block open January 5, 2027; the early-bird deadline is March 5, the hotel reservation deadline April 2 and the cancellation deadline April 9.

Registration is free for MDA member dentists. Out-of-state ADA members pay $100 and non-member dentists $200; hygienists, assistants, therapists and other team members pay $40. Individual courses carry separate tuition.

The program offers fundamental CE (clinical topics, infection control, recordkeeping, ethics, medical emergencies and similar) plus elective CE. All eligible attendees also receive 3.0 elective CEs for attending and visiting the exhibit hall. The Minnesota Dental Association is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider.

attributes.title: TNP 2027 Pharmacology Conference + AI / PMH Pre Conference
attributes.venue: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Spa
attributes.summary:
Texas Nurse Practitioners holds its 2027 Pharmacology Conference at the Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Spa in San Antonio. The TNP calendar lists it for April 22 to 24, but parts of the conference page still mention mid-April check-in, so confirm the dates with TNP before booking travel. Thursday is a pre-conference day with a choice of psychiatric and mental health or artificial intelligence tracks.

TNP says the full program offers up to 15 hours of CE and is planned to cover the Texas requirements for pharmacology, ethics and geriatrics. The full Thursday-to-Saturday package costs $505 for members and $705 for nonmembers through April 15, then $50 more. Single days and two-day packages are also sold. The page also mentions a $50 discount for registrations received by January 31.

The room rate is $249 a night with the resort fee waived, available through March 31, 2027.

attributes.title: DDNA 35th Annual Education Conference
attributes.summary:
The Developmental Disabilities Nurses Association holds its 35th Annual Education Conference from April 23 to 26, 2027, at the Loews Kansas City Hotel in downtown Kansas City, Missouri. It serves nurses who care for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities in group homes, state programs, schools, clinics and community agencies.

Attendees who go to all sessions and complete the evaluations can earn more than 20 nursing CE hours, with extra hours at some sponsored sessions. DDNA's certification exam is also given at the conference: the application deadline is February 22, 2027, and exam registration for approved applicants closes March 25, 2027.

Registration fees were listed as coming soon when we checked. The hotel booking link is provided after you finish conference registration.

attributes.title: MAFP Spring Conference 2027
attributes.venue: Sheraton Flowood The Refuge Hotel & Conference Center
attributes.summary:
The Mississippi Academy of Family Physicians lists its 2027 Spring Conference for April 23 to 25 at the Sheraton Flowood The Refuge Hotel & Conference Center, just east of Jackson. A separate Spring Fling for students and residents runs at the same hotel on April 24 and 25.

The academy describes the usual format as a Saturday of CME sessions and exhibits followed by a Sunday-morning block that ends around lunch. For 2027 only the dates and venue were posted when we checked. Credits, fees and the hotel block were still to come, so confirm with MAFP before you register.

attributes.title: 2027 Annual Nursing Education Conference: Ready by Design
attributes.venue: University of Maryland School of Nursing
attributes.organizer: University of Maryland School of Nursing
attributes.summary:
The Institute for Educators at the University of Maryland School of Nursing hosts its 2027 Annual Nursing Education Conference on April 23, 2027, at the school's building on West Lombard Street in Baltimore. The title is "Ready by Design: Building Strong Foundations Through Nursing Education," and the day centers on three themes: communication, clinical judgment and professionalism.

An early sunrise session starts at 7:30 a.m., and the main program runs from 8:45 a.m. to 3:45 p.m. The audience is academic faculty and clinical nurse educators. Fees and contact hours were not listed on the conference page when we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 Updates in Rheumatology
attributes.summary:
At $125 for 5 AMA PRA Category 1 credits or 5 ANCC contact hours, this is low-cost credit, and fellows, residents and students attend free. The Zoom option suits rural Nebraska clinicians who cannot lose a day to travel.

Faculty come from Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, the University of Toronto and UCLA. Register before April 16, 2027: after that, entry depends on space. Card payments add a $3 fee.

attributes.title: APTA KS 2027 Spring Conference
attributes.venue: Rhatigan Student Center, Wichita State University
attributes.summary: APTA Kansas holds its 2027 Spring Conference on April 24-25, 2027 at the Rhatigan Student Center on the Wichita State University campus. It is the chapter's spring education meeting for physical therapists and PTAs in Kansas.

attributes.title: 33rd Annual AAEM Scientific Assembly (AAEM27)
attributes.summary:
