AAEM27, the 33rd Scientific Assembly of the American Academy of Emergency Medicine, takes place Sunday, April 25, through Thursday, April 29, 2027, at the San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter on the River Walk. Add-on courses fill April 25 and the morning of April 26, and the main program starts with opening remarks around midday on April 26.

Registration is open. Early-bird rates run through January 11, 2027: $400 for physician members and $950 for physician non-members. Regular rates of $500 and $1,075 apply through April 18, then late rates of $600 and $1,200. Resident and student members pay $125, which AAEM treats as a deposit and refunds after they attend. The hotel booking deadline is April 2, 2027, and the full schedule is due in January. AAEM had not listed credit hours when we checked. Plan around the add-on days if you want one of the pre-conference courses, since they run before the general sessions.

attributes.title: Asembia's AXS27 Summit
attributes.summary:
Asembia's AXS27 Summit, the company's yearly specialty pharmacy meeting, runs April 25 to 29, 2027 at the Wynn and Encore hotels on the Las Vegas Strip. Registration was open when we checked.

The audience is broad: specialty pharmacies, manufacturers, health systems, PBMs, health plans and technology vendors. Pharmacists in specialty, health-system or limited-distribution practice make up a key part of the audience.

The home page did not show fees or an ACPE credit statement. Before you count on CE hours, check which sessions carry credit.

attributes.title: AAACN 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: American Academy of Ambulatory Care Nursing (AAACN)
attributes.organizer: American Academy of Ambulatory Care Nursing
attributes.summary:
The 52nd AAACN Annual Conference for ambulatory care nurses runs April 27 to 30, 2027, at the New Orleans Marriott. The four-day schedule includes a pre-conference workshop, and there is no live stream; recordings are sold as a PostCon Online Access package.

In-person attendees can earn up to 20 ANCC contact hours, the on-demand package up to 15. Members pay $715 through February 26, 2027, and $815 after; non-members pay $795 or $895. The conference hotel rate of $259 a night is available through March 29, 2027. Future conferences are set for Honolulu (2028), Philadelphia (2029) and Louisville (2030).

attributes.title: 2027 Collaborative Perspectives on Addiction Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Society of Addiction Psychology, Division 50 of the American Psychological Association, holds its 2027 Collaborative Perspectives on Addiction meeting from Wednesday, April 28, to Saturday, May 1, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency La Jolla in San Diego. The theme, "Bridging Science and Practice: 15 Years of Interdisciplinary Addiction Research," marks the meeting's fifteenth year.

CPA is a mid-sized meeting where addiction researchers, clinicians and trainees share symposia and posters on substance use, treatment and recovery. New for 2027 is a preconference workshop on April 28. Proposals for symposia and posters get priority consideration if submitted by December 1, 2026, and late-breaking posters will be considered in January 2027.

The society says continuing education credits are a large part of CPA and will be offered for all accepted symposia, with credits handled through the CE GO platform. The number of hours and the approving body had not been posted when we checked, so psychologists and counselors should confirm credit details before registering.

Registration prices depend on career stage and Division 50 membership. Members pay $385 at the early price and $435 at the late price, non-members $460 or $510, and student members $210 or $260; early-career and single-day tickets are also sold. The page does not say when the early price ends. Continuing education credits and the preconference workshop cost extra.

attributes.title: 41st Annual Great Lakes Pharmacy Resident Conference
attributes.summary:
Residents from seven Great Lakes states gather at Purdue University on April 28 to 30, 2027, and the organizers report more than 900 attendees, about 600 residents and 300 preceptors. For a preceptor, it is a chance to earn pharmacy CE while hearing what residents across the region are working on.

The point most likely to catch people out is the claim window. You have only 14 days to finish the program evaluation at CESally.com, and evaluations are due May 11, 2027. Miss that and the ACPE credit is gone.

Residents must submit an abstract and CV by February 1, and early registration ends March 31. Fee amounts and credit hours are not published yet, and the schedule is not final.

attributes.title: MNPA Spring 2027 Conference
attributes.summary: MNPA has posted a save-the-date for its spring meeting at the Samoset Resort on the Maine coast, April 28 to 30, 2027. Program, contact hours and fees are not published yet. The most recent fall meeting carried AANP-approved hours with pharmacology, so check whether the spring one does the same before you plan around it.

attributes.title: Pri-Med West 2027
attributes.credits_text: 23 AMA PRA Cat 1 · AAFP · 23 AANP CE · 5 AANP Pharm
attributes.summary:
Pri-Med West runs April 28 to 30, 2027, at the Anaheim Convention Center in California. It is a three-day primary care update with lectures and an exhibit hall for primary care, family medicine and internal medicine clinicians.

The conference offers up to 23 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, 23 AANP contact hours including 5 pharmacology hours, AAFP Prescribed credit and California BRN contact hours for nurses. Registration is $129 at the early-bird rate until February 5, 2027 and $165 afterwards.

attributes.title: IDEAS27
attributes.summary:
IDEAS27, the Iowa Dental Association's annual session, runs April 29 to May 1, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Coralville; the exhibit hall is open April 29 and 30.

The meeting is open to dentists, dental hygienists, dental assistants, office staff, graduate students and dental students, who can earn CE from invited speakers. The 2027 course list, fees and credit totals are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 IONL Spring Pre-Conference: AONL Advocacy in Action
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Plainfield Indianapolis Airport
attributes.summary:
Nurse managers who are asked to speak to policymakers can practice that on April 29, 2027, near the Indianapolis airport. It uses AONL's skills-based advocacy training and lists 6 CE credits, with AONL as the ANCC-accredited provider.

Fees are not published yet on this page.

attributes.title: 2027 MEDA National Conference
attributes.venue: Renaissance Framingham Hotel and Conference Center
attributes.summary:
One of the few national meetings where eating disorder care is the whole agenda, and it welcomes people with lived experience next to clinicians, so sessions tend to mix clinical and recovery views. The call for proposals asked about GLP-1 medications and eating disorders in midlife, a useful hint at the program's direction.

MEDA says continuing education is part of the conference, but credit types, hours and fees for 2027 are not published. Dietitians and others should watch for the board list when registration opens.

attributes.title: Music City Dental Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The Music City Dental Conference, presented by the Tennessee Dental Association, returns April 29 to May 1, 2027, at the Embassy Suites Nashville Downtown. It is Tennessee's largest dental meeting and is aimed at the entire dental team, with a scientific program and an exhibit hall.

The 2027 course list covers dental materials and technology, posterior composites, infection control (OSHA and CDC), xerostomia, antibiotic stewardship, risk management, pediatric oral lesions and responsible prescribing. Registration had not opened when we checked, and fees have not been announced.

The TDA is an ADA CERP provider (May 2024 to June 2028).

attributes.title: Oregon Dental Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Oregon Dental Conference runs April 29 to May 1, 2027, at the Oregon Convention Center in downtown Portland. The ODA says more details will follow; the course list, fees and CE totals are not published yet.

The Oregon Dental Association is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider and issues CE certificates after the conference through its website.

attributes.title: RESNA 2027 at Abilities International
attributes.organizer: Rehabilitation Engineering and Assistive Technology Society of North America
attributes.summary: RESNA's 2027 conference is held within the New York Metro Abilities International Accessibility Conference at the New Jersey Convention & Expo Center in Edison on April 29-30, 2027. It includes sessions, workshops, scientific papers and the Student Design Challenge, and is aimed at clinicians including occupational and physical therapists and assistive technology professionals. IACET CEUs are offered for eligible sessions.

attributes.title: 107th WPA Convention
attributes.cme_provider: Western Psychological Association and Pacific University Oregon, Department of Clinical Psychology
attributes.summary:
The Western Psychological Association holds its 107th convention in Pasadena, California, from April 29 to May 2, 2027. A separate WPA Conference on Teaching takes place the day before, on Wednesday, April 28. The convention draws researchers, faculty, students and practicing psychologists from the western states.

Continuing education is co-sponsored by WPA and the Department of Clinical Psychology at Pacific University Oregon. WPA anticipates around 30 CE-eligible sessions, with the full list posted in the online program and app about two weeks before the meeting. CE costs $100 on top of registration and can be added before, during or for about two weeks after the convention; attendance is tracked with sign-in and sign-out sheets, and certificates are e-mailed after a short survey for each session.

Early-bird registration through March 31, 2027, is $145 for professional members, $225 for non-member professionals and $95 for students. After that the rates rise to $195, $275 and $145. The Conference on Teaching costs members $50 early and $100 after March 31.

attributes.title: 2027 ASPAN National Conference
attributes.summary:
ASPAN's 46th National Conference for perianesthesia nurses is scheduled for April 30 to May 3, 2027, in New Orleans, Louisiana. Sessions cover preoperative, PACU and ambulatory surgery nursing, pediatrics and research.

Online registration opens in December 2026. The venue, contact hours and fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: CAMFT Annual Conference 2027
attributes.cme_provider: California Association of Marriage and Family Therapists
attributes.organizer: California Association of Marriage and Family Therapists
attributes.summary:
CAMFT is recognized by the California Board of Behavioral Sciences as a CE provider for LMFTs, LEPs, LPCCs and LCSWs, which makes this meeting simple to map to a California renewal. Earlier editions offered about 20 hours over two days, so one trip can cover a good share of a cycle.

The save-the-date gives the dates, the Hilton San Francisco Union Square as the venue and the theme "Advancing the Art & Science of Psychotherapy." The program and 2027 fees are not published; CAMFT is collecting names for early-rate notices on its save-the-date page, and early access has opened months ahead in past years.

attributes.title: 2027 DSDS Annual Session: Medical Emergencies in the Dental Office
attributes.series: Delaware State Dental Society Annual Session
attributes.summary:
The Delaware State Dental Society's 2027 Annual Session is a full-day course on April 30, 2027, at Delaware Park Casino, preceded by the business meeting and president's reception on April 29 at the Hilton Wilmington/Christiana. The topic is managing medical emergencies in the dental office: a morning lecture and afternoon team exercises, with AGD participation credit.

The session carries 6.0 CE credits. Fees before/after April 20 are $335/$385 for DSDS/ADA members, $455/$495 for non-ADA members and $195/$225 for staff; the registration deadline is April 27.

attributes.title: 2027 IPA Spring Conference: Cognitive Processing Therapy for PTSD
attributes.summary:
The Iowa Psychological Association's 2027 Spring Conference, held April 30 and May 1, 2027, at the Graduate by Hilton in Iowa City, is a single two-day intensive training in Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT) for PTSD. It covers CPT theory and evidence, then works step by step through the protocol, with video demonstrations, role-plays and practice in handling comorbidity and varied trauma histories. You must attend both days and bring the CPT manual (Resick et al., 2nd edition).

IPA lists 14 CEs for the workshop. The presenter is Carin M. Lefkowitz, Psy.D., of the Consortium for Defense Psychology at the Uniformed Services University.

Registration is $462 for IPA members, $385 for lifetime and early-career members, $231 for retired members, $149 for student members and $577.50 for non-members. Registration closes April 20, 2027, and the hotel room block must be booked by March 29, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 NASW Chapters Spring Virtual Conference
attributes.summary:
A joint program from the Illinois, Missouri and Wisconsin chapters, so the hours are planned around those states' rules. In the fall 2026 edition, topics included hard-to-find requirement areas like implicit bias, Alzheimer's disease and suicide prevention, up to 8 CEUs.

The chapter conference page is the only official information so far: the dates are set, the call for presenters has closed, and session times and total CEUs are still to come. Fees and the final list of qualifying professions are not published; earlier editions priced NASW members well below non-members.

attributes.title: 2027 New England School Nurse Conference: Anchored in Hope
attributes.cme_provider: University of Vermont Larner College of Medicine Continuing Education
attributes.summary:
The 2027 New England School Nurse Conference, "Anchored in Hope: Charting a Course for Healthier Schools," runs from Friday evening, April 30, to midday Sunday, May 2, 2027, at the Newport Marriott Hotel & Spa in Rhode Island. The event rotates among the school nurse associations of Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island and Vermont.

The organizers list 9.0 CE credits, with continuing education from the University of Vermont Larner College of Medicine. Registration is open with an early-bird rate; regular registration ends December 31, 2026. Fee amounts are not shown on the event page. The host hotel block is $319 a night, with an overflow block at the Wyndham Newport.

attributes.title: NJAFP 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: New Jersey Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
The New Jersey Academy of Family Physicians has set its 2027 Annual Meeting for Friday, April 30, through Sunday, May 2, at the Tropicana Boardwalk Resort and Casino in Atlantic City. It is the academy's main yearly gathering for family doctors in the state.

When we checked, the academy had posted only a save-the-date notice with the dates and venue. Program, credit hours, fees and room rates were not out yet. The NJAFP events page is where registration should appear once it opens.

attributes.title: 2027 ODA Annual Meeting & Conference
attributes.summary:
The Oklahoma Dental Association holds its 2027 Annual Meeting April 30 to May 1, 2027, at the Southern Hills Marriott in Tulsa. Online registration opens January 7, 2027; the early-bird deadline is February 28 and online registration closes April 20.

Published attendee prices are $300 for ODA/ADA members, $150 for new members who graduated in 2022 or later, $620 for non-member dentists, $185 for dental hygienists and $95 to $125 for assistants and office staff. Dental students attend free.

The ODA is a locally approved AGD PACE program provider (provider ID 219266) for FAGD/MAGD credit. ODA says the meeting offers more than 30 hours of PACE-approved continuing education; how many hours one attendee can earn is not stated.

attributes.title: PAS 2027
attributes.summary:
PAS 2027 meets April 30 to May 3, 2027, in Minneapolis. Registration and hotel booking open in November 2026, and early registration ends March 16, 2027.

The abstract call closes November 2, 2026. Fees, the venue and the CME statement are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 AAN Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AAN Annual Meeting runs May 1 to 5, 2027, in Washington, DC, and is also offered live online. CME is provided by the American Academy of Neurology Institute, which is ACCME-accredited.

Registration is open. Full registration (in person plus online access) costs neurologist members $920 through February 4, 2027, $1,020 through April 1 and $1,220 after that; nonmembers pay $1,490, $1,650 or $1,970. Intern and junior members pay $350 to $455, students and senior members $30 to $120. Online-only registration starts at $590 for physician members and $950 for nonmembers at the early rate.

Sessions are at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center; the headquarters hotel is the Marriott Marquis Washington, DC, and the AAN hotel block must be booked by April 1, 2027. The total number of CME credits is not listed yet.

attributes.title: AATS 107th Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 107th AATS meeting runs May 1 to 4, 2027, at the Los Angeles Convention Center. It suits cardiac, thoracic and congenital surgeons who want new data and surgical technique in one program.

AATS is ACCME-accredited and offers AMA PRA Category 1 Credit. Completing the activity also counts toward the CME requirement of American Board of Surgery Continuous Certification, which helps diplomates in the certification cycle. The credit total, fees and registration link are not published yet on the pages we checked.

attributes.title: APA 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The American Psychiatric Association's 2027 Annual Meeting is set for May 1 to 5, 2027, in New York City, as announced in APA's own Psychiatric News at the close of the 2026 meeting.

The venue, CME credits, fees and program have not been confirmed on a page we could read; the main meeting site (psychiatry.org) blocked automated checks, so these details will be added after a manual review.

attributes.title: APTA Wyoming 2027 Spring Conference
attributes.summary: The Wyoming chapter's 2027 Spring Conference takes place May 1-2, 2027 in Laramie with presenter Tony Bare. The chapter lists 15 CEUs, and early-bird pricing runs until March 31, 2027. APTA Wyoming courses count as Category A education for state license renewal.

attributes.title: INS 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Infusion Nurses Society holds its 2027 Annual Meeting May 1 to 4, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Dallas in Texas. The meeting covers infusion therapy and vascular access practice.

INS has not yet published contact hours, fees or deadlines for 2027. Later meetings are planned at the Hilton Orlando (April 2028) and Planet Hollywood in Las Vegas (2029).

attributes.title: NAON 47th Annual Congress
attributes.summary:
NAON's 47th Annual Congress for orthopaedic nurses is scheduled for May 1 to 3, 2027, in Orlando, Florida.

The congress is held at the Rosen Centre Hotel on International Drive, where NAON's group rate is $190 per night. NAON, an ANCC-accredited provider, says attendees can earn up to 20 CNE contact hours onsite and more than 43 in total with on-demand access, which full-conference registration includes.

NAON has posted its rates, with registration itself opening soon: full conference is $775 for members and $999 for nonmembers through January 4, 2027, then $835 and $1,099 until March 4, and $895 and $1,199 after that. Student and retired members pay $540 to $660, and single-day passes start at $425 for members.

attributes.title: 2027 STFM Annual Spring Conference
attributes.organizer: Society of Teachers of Family Medicine
attributes.summary:
The 2027 STFM Annual Spring Conference runs May 1 to 5, 2027, at the Sheraton Grand Chicago Riverwalk and is part of the society's 60th-anniversary year. STFM expects more than 1,500 family medicine educators.

Registration opens in December 2026 and the group room rate is $305 a night. Fees and the CME statement are not published yet.

attributes.title: ARRS 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
Radiologists can attend in Denver or online, May 2 to 5, 2027. Meeting rooms and guest rooms share one building, which cuts travel time between sessions, and a thoracic imaging workshop is offered alongside the main schedule.

The activity is designated for a maximum of 150 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits. That high figure is a ceiling, and few people could earn it during the live days alone. The hotel block is $299 until April 7, 2027. Registration is open, and you can switch between in-person and virtual at no cost. ARRS members pay $629 through February 5, 2027, $733 through April 7 and $943 after that; nonmembers pay $1,679, $1,785 or $1,993, and trainee, associate and emeritus members $299, $399 or $599. The late rate is offered for in-person registration only. The thoracic imaging workshop costs an extra $150 for members and $200 for nonmembers.

attributes.title: NTI 2027
attributes.series: AACN National Teaching Institute & Critical Care Exposition (NTI)
attributes.summary:
NTI 2027, the American Association of Critical-Care Nurses' annual teaching institute, runs May 2 to 5, 2027, in Indianapolis. Sessions are held at the Indiana Convention Center and the neighboring JW Marriott Indianapolis, and AACN expects an exhibit hall of more than 300 companies.

AACN says attendees can earn more than 40 continuing education contact hours; the per-session breakdown and pharmacology hours have not been published yet. Registration opens in early December 2026. Full-conference rates are $775 for members and $990 for nonmembers from December 1 to February 1, $915 and $1,130 from February 2 to April 5, and $985 and $1,200 from April 6 to May 5. AACN has already named Boston as a future NTI host city.

attributes.title: Psychedelic Science 2027
attributes.summary:
Read the ticket tiers carefully if CE is the goal: only the Practitioner pass can buy the CE/CME add-on, and only selected sessions count, with the list appearing in the event app. Cheaper passes will not earn credit.

MAPS has not yet named the 2027 CE sponsor or credit total; its FAQ refers to APA and ACCME approved sponsors, and earlier meetings also carried ASWB ACE. Social workers should confirm before paying. Prices step up as ticket releases sell out.

attributes.title: United 2027 Trauma Conference
attributes.summary:
United 2027 is a joint trauma conference of the Society of Trauma Nurses, the American Trauma Society and the Trauma Center Association of America. It runs May 3 to 7, 2027, in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, and is aimed at trauma nurses, trauma program managers and coordinators, injury prevention staff and others who run trauma systems.

The abstract window for oral and poster presentations ran from September 8 to October 23, 2026. The venue, registration fees and the number of nursing contact hours had not been announced on the Society of Trauma Nurses site when we checked.

attributes.title: 8th Annual Ocean City Conference 2027
attributes.venue: Hilton Garden Inn Ocean City Oceanfront
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Maryland Chapter
attributes.summary:
The Maryland Chapter of the National Association of Social Workers holds its 8th Annual Ocean City Conference from Wednesday, May 5, to Friday, May 7, 2027, at the Hilton Garden Inn Ocean City Oceanfront on Baltimore Avenue. The chapter lists the event as a save-the-date on its continuing education page; the program, fees and CE totals had not been published when we checked.

NASW Maryland runs a full calendar of CE programs for social workers and labels its live workshops by Maryland CE category (most are Category I). NASW members receive free or discounted CE through chapter programs.

The chapter's other big spring event in 2027 is the joint DC, Maryland and Virginia conference in March. Check the chapter page for registration details and the hours offered before you plan your renewal.

attributes.title: SGIM27 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
SGIM27 takes place May 5 to 8, 2027, in Seattle and marks 50 years of the Society of General Internal Medicine. Abstract, vignette and innovation submissions close December 11, 2026.

The venue, fees and CME statement are not published yet.

attributes.title: Wyoming Infection Prevention Summit
attributes.summary:
For nurses who handle infection control in Wyoming facilities, this summit in Casper on May 5 and 6, 2027, is close to home. It offers 12 contact hours, according to the Wyoming Nurses Association, which partners with the state Department of Health and Mountain Pacific.

Registration is not open yet, and fees and accreditation details are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 AOTA Technology & Innovation in Occupational Therapy Specialty Conference
attributes.series: AOTA Technology & Innovation in Occupational Therapy Specialty Conference
attributes.summary: AOTA holds this two-day virtual specialty conference on May 10-11, 2027. The program is planned around 10 educational sessions on artificial intelligence, telehealth, remote monitoring, assistive technology, smart home controls and digital health in occupational therapy practice.

attributes.title: 2027 NASW-NC Clinical Social Work Institute
attributes.summary:
A big block of hours for a clinician short on time: the chapter advertises up to 31 CE hours, including ethics, if you attend live and also watch the recordings. Live attendance alone gives fewer, so plan the recording time when you count toward a deadline.

Fees for 2027 and the session list are not published. North Carolina LCSWs should confirm how the board treats recorded hours in their renewal.

attributes.title: NKF 2027 Spring Clinical Meetings
attributes.venue: Walt Disney World Swan and Dolphin Resort
attributes.summary:
Kidney care teams meet in Orlando on May 11 to 15, 2027. Pre-conference courses on May 11 cover transplantation, home dialysis, critical care, stones and inpatient nephrology, so choose the day before booking flights. General sessions follow on May 12 to 15.

The listed fees are physician rates: $550 for members and $950 for nonmembers through March 10, 2027, then $625 and $1,000. Member rates for APPs and nurses are $425 and $475; for residents, $125 and $150. Nonmember rates in those groups are higher. The in-person and on-demand prices match.

NKF runs a continuing education program and credit can be claimed from May 15 to June 28, 2027. Physician credit types and totals are not published yet on the pages we checked.

attributes.title: Rural Emergency Medicine Course and Critical Care Ultrasound Course
attributes.summary:
Built for clinicians who rarely see these emergencies but must handle them alone: chest tubes, cricothyrotomy, ultrasound nerve blocks, trauma resuscitation, ventilators and precipitous delivery. UNMC plans lightly embalmed cadavers but warns it may substitute other training if the supply runs short.

The fees listed are for the May 12 to 14 emergency course. The May 11 ultrasound day, capped at 36 people, costs $700 by February 26 and $750 after; both together cost $1,250 or $1,350. Agendas and the credit total are not published yet.

attributes.title: CI2027 San Diego
attributes.summary: The American Cochlear Implant Alliance holds CI2027, its conference on cochlear implants, on May 12-15, 2027, at the Manchester Grand Hyatt in San Diego. Registration opens December 7, 2026. Early rates for audiologist and speech pathologist members are $500 ($700 for non-members) until March 17, 2027; physician rates are higher. The program offers CEU and CME credit.

attributes.title: CDA Presents The Art and Science of Dentistry, Anaheim 2027
attributes.series: CDA Presents The Art and Science of Dentistry
attributes.summary:
CDA Presents returns to the Anaheim Convention Center May 13 to 15, 2027. The California Dental Association runs the convention as a mix of lectures, hands-on workshops and an exhibit hall, and CDA is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider.

Registration opens in January 2027; fees, the course list and CE hours had not been published when we checked. We found no announced San Francisco edition for 2027 on the CDA site.

attributes.title: 160th CSDA Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Connecticut State Dental Association holds its 160th annual conference May 13 to 15, 2027 in Hartford. The meeting moves to the Connecticut Convention Center for this edition.

The conference brings together dentists and their teams for continuing education and an exhibit hall. The first 100 people who register are entered in a prize drawing, according to the meeting site.

The course list, CE hours and fees were not published when we checked. Dentists licensed in Connecticut should check which courses count toward the state's renewal requirements once the program is out.

attributes.title: Heart Rhythm 2027
attributes.summary:
Heart Rhythm 2027 takes place May 13 to 16, 2027, at the Moscone Center in San Francisco. The meeting covers the full breadth of cardiac electrophysiology, from clinical EP to new technology.

Registration and the official hotel block open to the public on December 1, 2026; HRS members get earlier hotel access from November 17. The block includes 21 hotels at negotiated rates of $230 to $475 per night, with shuttles to Moscone Center. Early-bird registration rates end February 9, 2027. The call for abstracts is open until December 16.

attributes.title: 35th Annual Family Medicine Update
attributes.summary:
Thursday is set aside for optional pre-conference workshops, with accredited CME running all day Friday and Saturday, so a two-day trip still covers the core program.

The chapter's event listing shows May 15 to 17 in its date fields, but its announcement and meeting page both say May 13 to 15, the dates we use here. Credit hours, fees and the agenda are not published yet.

attributes.title: NPACE 2027: May Virtual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: A two-day live virtual conference from NPACE on May 13 and 14, 2027, centred on laboratory diagnostics and test interpretation for advanced practice providers. NPACE lists 12+ CE/CME credits. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists this virtual conference at $250, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.

attributes.title: Pri-Med Irving 2027
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · AANP CE · AANP Pharm
attributes.summary: Pri-Med's Irving regional conference runs May 13 and 14, 2027, at the Irving Convention Center in the Dallas area. It offers up to 12.5 CME/CE credits for primary care clinicians as AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and AANP contact hours. Early-bird registration is $85 until January 22, 2027, then $99.

attributes.title: 2027 South Dakota Dental Association Annual Session
attributes.summary:
The South Dakota Dental Association's 2027 Annual Session takes place May 13 to 15, 2027, at the Sioux Falls Convention Center, with the vendor show on May 13 and 14. A tentative schedule has been posted.

The annual session includes CE courses with handouts posted by speakers, plus the house of delegates and the SDDA awards program. Fees and credit hours for 2027 are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 TDA Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 TDA Meeting runs May 13 to 15, 2027, at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in downtown San Antonio. Education runs all three days; the exhibit hall is open May 13 and 14, and the House of Delegates meets May 14 and 15. The meeting is aimed at the whole dental team: dentists, residents, hygienists, assistants and office staff.

Registration opens January 20, 2027. The lowest fees apply through February 28, a pre-registration tier runs March 1 to 31, and full prices apply from April 1. The fee amounts, hotel blocks and the course list have not been published yet.

The TDA assigns CE credit at one credit hour per hour of instruction and classifies courses by the categories used by the Texas State Board of Dental Examiners. Attendees record completion codes announced at the end of each course and print their own CE transcript.

attributes.title: WMHCA 2027 Conference: Bridging Connections
attributes.series: Washington Mental Health Counselors Association Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Washington Mental Health Counselors Association (ACEP No. 2079)
attributes.summary:
The Washington Mental Health Counselors Association holds its second annual conference, "Bridging Connections: Navigating Inclusive Care in an Evolving Landscape", May 13 to 15, 2027, at the Yakima Convention Center. It focuses on inclusive and culturally responsive care.

WMHCA is an NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider (ACEP No. 2079). On May 11, two days before the conference, a three-hour live Zoom ethics session on the law and ethics of inclusive behavioral health care carries 3 ethics CEs. The total hours for the main conference were not published.

Registration is open but fees were not shown on the public page, and refunds are not given. Room blocks at three nearby hotels are held until April 14, 2027, under group code 0512WM.

attributes.title: AACE Annual Meeting 2027
attributes.summary:
The AACE Annual Meeting 2027 takes place Friday to Sunday, May 14 to 16, 2027, at the Marriott Marquis San Diego Marina in San Diego, California.

AACE says registration opens in the fall of 2026. Fees, CME credits and housing for 2027 have not been published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 Idaho Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Idaho Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Idaho Chapter of the American College of Physicians holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting from Friday, May 14, to Sunday, May 16, at the Idaho College of Osteopathic Medicine in Meridian, just west of Boise.

The chapter had already put up a registration notice when we checked, but it had not listed credit hours or fees on its page. Internists who practice in Idaho or nearby states can use it to pick up CME close to home. Check the chapter page for the program and current prices.

attributes.title: ATS 2027 International Conference
attributes.summary:
The ATS 2027 International Conference takes place May 14 to 19, 2027, in New Orleans, Louisiana. It gathers pulmonary, critical care and sleep professionals for research presentations, education and early-career programs such as resident and fellow boot camps.

The call for abstracts closes at 5 p.m. ET on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, and exhibit space sales are underway. Venue, registration fees and CME details for 2027 were not yet posted on the pages we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 STAR Suicide Prevention Conference
attributes.summary:
A single Friday with CE for a wide mix of licenses makes this easy to fit around a caseload: the center names psychologists, LSW/LCSW, LPC, NCC and LMFT, plus Pennsylvania educators. That matters in states with a recurring suicide-prevention hour requirement, though each board decides what it accepts.

The page is still a save-the-date. Venue, format, hours and fees are not published, and Pittsburgh is where the center is based rather than a confirmed location, so check back before arranging travel.

attributes.title: DDW 2027
attributes.organizer: Digestive Disease Week (AASLD, AGA, ASGE, SSAT)
attributes.summary:
DDW 2027 takes place May 15 to 18, 2027, in Washington, D.C., with an online option. In person, attendees can access around 400 original sessions; the online program streams 64 key sessions on four channels, and in-person sessions are later available on demand. The exhibit hall is open May 16 to 18.

Abstracts are accepted until December 2, 2026. Registration opens January 20, 2027, for members of the four sponsoring societies and January 27 for everyone else. Early-bird pricing ends March 10, 2027: $252 for members and $693 for nonmembers, the same in person and online; rates rise on March 11 and again on May 14. CME and MOC can be claimed after the meeting; credit totals were not shown on the pages we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 NJVMA Veterinary Education Conference
attributes.summary:
The New Jersey VMA holds its 2027 Veterinary Education Conference on May 15 and 16, 2027, at Harrah's in Atlantic City. The association describes the VEC as its main CE event for New Jersey veterinarians, technicians, practice managers and veterinary students.

NJVMA presents the meeting as a way to collect CE needed for license renewal, including opioid-related sessions, with tracks such as pain management and emergency and critical care.

Fees, the number of CE hours and the session list are not published yet; only the save-the-date is online.

attributes.title: SAEM27 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
SAEM27 runs Tuesday through Friday, May 18 to 21, 2027, at the San Francisco Marriott Marquis on Mission Street. The meeting is the main annual gathering of the Society for Academic Emergency Medicine, so the program leans toward research presentations, teaching and the academic side of emergency practice rather than a pure board-review format.

As of our check, SAEM had not posted fees, credit totals or hotel rates for 2027. The society says a reservation link for its room block will appear once registration opens. If you plan to present, watch the SAEM27 submission calendar on the society site for abstract deadlines.

attributes.title: 38th Annual International Trauma Conference
attributes.summary:
The conference moves to The New School in New York for the first time and adds an embodiment track, which suits clinicians looking for somatic approaches next to the neuroscience. Both ticket types include 90 days of replay, so the virtual option works for anyone who cannot clear four weekdays.

The organizer advertises up to 30 CE credits for accredited sessions, live and enduring; its credit page names APA CE for psychologists and ASWB ACE for social workers. Counselors and MFTs should ask about their own board before buying, because the published list of credit types does not settle it for every license.

attributes.title: AGS27 Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
AGS27 runs May 20 to 22, 2027, at the Georgia World Congress Center in Atlanta, with a pre-conference day on May 19. The society aims the program at physicians, nurses, pharmacists, physician associates, social workers and other geriatrics professionals.

Room blocks are set at the Omni Atlanta Hotel at Centennial Park and the Signia by Hilton. Fees, registration and the continuing education statement are not published yet.

attributes.title: LIMITLESS 2027 BrownGirl RDH Conference
attributes.summary:
BrownGirl RDH moves its conference to Caesars Palace in Las Vegas for 2027, under the name LIMITLESS. It opens with an evening reception on Thursday, May 20, followed by courses, talks and lunch on Friday, with the afternoon left free, and a Saturday session that ends by 2 p.m. on May 22. The organizer plans 10 CE hours in total, five each day, and says final course details are still to come.

The focus this time is on careers more than clinical technique: pay and production, jobs outside the operatory, independent and mobile hygiene, and practice or DSO leadership. Hygienists are the core audience, though assistants, dentists, students and educators are also invited.

The early rate is $349 through January 31, 2027, or until 50 tickets are gone, then $399. Registration covers the reception, two lunches and the CE hours. Hotel rooms are booked separately through the group block, which closes April 19, 2027, and registrations cannot be refunded.

attributes.title: 2027 Great Lakes Dental Summit
attributes.summary:
If you have been looking for the MDA Annual Session, this is it under a new name. The Michigan Dental Association's Great Lakes Dental Summit runs May 20 to 22, 2027, at DeVos Place in Grand Rapids.

The association says registration opens in January 2027, together with the course schedule and speaker lineup, so credit hours and fees are not published yet. Hold off on planning your Michigan renewal hours around this meeting until the schedule appears.

The organizer describes the event as evidence-based CE for the whole dental team but does not yet name hygienists or say which credit system applies.

attributes.title: AAPA 2027
attributes.summary:
AAPA 2027 takes place May 21 to 25, 2027, at the Phoenix Convention Center in downtown Phoenix. AAPA describes 200+ hours of CME across 45 therapeutic categories, hands-on workshops, Main Stage sessions, an expo and the PA JobSource Career Fair, and expects more than 5,000 PAs and PA students.

Registration and hotels opened October 28, 2026. With an AAPA hotel-block stay, full registration for PA members starts at $600 (super saver, through November 11, 2026), then $700 early bird through January 13, 2027; nonmembers start at $1,000. Staying outside the block costs up to $200 more. NPs and affiliates register in a separate category; the free retired-member registration does not include CME.

attributes.title: 2027 ACOG Annual Clinical & Scientific Meeting
attributes.organizer: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists
attributes.summary:
ACOG's 2027 Annual Clinical & Scientific Meeting (ACSM) takes place May 21 to 23, 2027, in Los Angeles, California. The meeting offers focused programming for clinicians who provide obstetric and gynecologic care.

Registration is open, and on-site registration is at the Los Angeles Convention Center. ACOG Fellows pay $750 at the Early Access rate through January 29, 2027, $850 at the Advance rate through May 14 and $950 on site. Non-ACOG physicians and other health care professionals pay $950, $1,050 or $1,150, Junior Fellows in Training $525, $625 or $750, and ACOG medical student members $150, $200 or $250. Member rates require membership valid through May 23, 2027. The CME statement was not on the pages we checked. Sessions from the 2026 meeting can be bought as ACSM On Demand.

attributes.title: AUA2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
AUA2027, the American Urological Association's annual meeting, takes place at the San Diego Convention Center. The Science & Technology Hall is open Friday, May 21, through Sunday, May 23, and educational programming continues on Monday, May 24, 2027; the meeting also marks the AUA's 125th anniversary.

Registration fees, CME credits and housing details have not been published on the page we checked.

attributes.title: 44th Annual Institute for Alcohol and Drug Studies
attributes.series: Institute for Alcohol and Drug Studies
attributes.venue: University Center West, University of Southern Indiana
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ANCC CH · ACPE · ASWB ACE
attributes.cme_provider: USI Center for Health Professions Lifelong Learning
attributes.summary:
An inexpensive way to pick up addiction hours from a jointly accredited provider, with a virtual option on the same day. Hours are promised for social workers and Indiana-licensed MFTs, among others; the listing does not name counselors in the CE line even though they are invited, so Indiana LMHCs should ask before registering.

The $140 professional price holds through April 30, then rises to $155. The hour total and speakers are not published, and the page currently shows registration as closed, which looks like a leftover from the last edition.

attributes.title: 2027 Utah Nurse Practitioners Pharmacology Conference
attributes.summary:
Pharmacology hours are the draw here: Utah NPs list about 13 CE credits, 10 of them pharmacology, for May 21 and 22, 2027, in Park City. Those numbers are approximate because AANP approval is pending.

Wendy Wright is announced as a keynote speaker. Registration has not opened, and fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: SGNA 54th Annual Course
attributes.organizer: Society of Gastroenterology Nurses and Associates
attributes.summary:
SGNA's 54th Annual Course for gastroenterology and endoscopy nurses takes place May 22 to 24, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency New Orleans.

Registration is open. The full course costs members $585 through April 1, 2027, and $665 after; non-members pay $805, then $885. One day is $295 for members and $405 for non-members, and students working toward initial licensure pay $140. The SGNA room rate at the Hyatt Regency is $259 per night, and refunds (less $150) are available for cancellations received by April 9, 2027.

SGNA is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development and says attendees earn contact hours, but the number of hours is not published yet.

attributes.title: NASW NH 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, New Hampshire Chapter
attributes.summary:
The New Hampshire Chapter of NASW holds its eighth annual conference at the Omni Mount Washington Resort in Bretton Woods, with a pre-conference workshop on Sunday, May 23, 2027, and the main conference on May 24 and 25. The chapter pitches it as a destination conference in New Hampshire for social workers and allied professionals.

The 2027 brochure, with the session list and CE hours, is due in December. The agenda currently posted on the chapter page offers 6 CEs on each main conference day, plus a 3-CE stand-alone pre-conference workshop on suicide prevention (the Connect Program). Confirm the 2027 hours once the brochure is out.

Early-bird registration is open until December 1, 2026; member rates require NASW membership both when you register and at the time of the conference. The resort's group room rate closes about a month before the conference, and the chapter warns that the hotel fills up.

attributes.title: 39th Annual LPCA Convention & Regional Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Licensed Professional Counselors Association of Georgia
attributes.organizer: Licensed Professional Counselors Association of Georgia
attributes.summary:
This year's theme is AI and counseling, a practical draw for anyone writing a practice policy on documentation tools or client chatbots. The convention names LPCs, APCs, social workers and LMFTs in its audience, and there is a dedicated track for CPCS renewal, which Georgia supervisors should look at first.

Registration is listed as coming soon and fees and hours are not published. The convention page lists May 25 as the pre-convention day and May 26 to 28 as the general convention, under the headline dates of May 25 to 28.

attributes.title: AOSW 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Association of Oncology Social Work will hold its 2027 annual conference as a virtual event on May 26 and 27, 2027. The association announced the dates as a save-the-date; the program, registration and fees had not been posted when we checked in November 2026.

The conference serves social workers in cancer centers, hospitals, hospice and community programs who help patients and families through diagnosis, treatment, survivorship and end of life. A virtual format lets clinicians attend without travel.

AOSW is an ASWB ACE-approved continuing education provider (#1351, approval period through November 11, 2028) and is recognized by the New York State Education Department as a CE provider for licensed social workers. The 2026 in-person conference in Portland offered up to 20.25 CE credits; the number of credits for the 2027 virtual edition has not been announced, so check the conference page before planning your CE hours.

attributes.title: AAPD 2027 (80th Annual Session)
attributes.summary:
AAPD 2027, the Academy's 80th Annual Session, takes place May 27 to 30, 2027, at the Gaylord National Resort & Convention Center just outside Washington, D.C. Scientific sessions are included in registration; pre-conference courses and life-support workshops (PALS, BLS, PEARS) cost extra.

AAPD is a recognized ADA CERP Provider. Registration opens in late 2026; fees and CE hours are not published yet. Guests earn no CE, so team members who need credit must register as dentists or office staff.

attributes.title: 2027 NHDS Annual Meeting: Come Together
attributes.summary:
The New Hampshire Dental Society's 2027 Annual Meeting takes place May 27 and 28, 2027, at the Inn at Church Landing in Meredith, on Lake Winnipesaukee. The weekend combines CE courses with social events, the NHDS Annual Awards Ceremony and the society's business meeting.

Announced speakers include Dr. Miles Cone, Dr. Mark Hyman and Dr. Taryn McCarthy, with more CE courses still being added. Fees and credit hours are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 NASW-NY CE Conference: Social Work Forward
attributes.cme_provider: NASW New York Chapter (NYSED-approved CE provider)
attributes.summary:
The New York Chapter of NASW holds its 2027 Continuing Education Conference, "Social Work Forward: Change, Action, and Impact", on Friday, May 28, 2027, at the University at Albany. It is an in-person event only, running from morning registration to an evening reception.

Attendees can earn up to 8.0 New York State Education Department CE credits across welcome remarks, two keynotes, four breakouts and optional fireside chats. NASW-NY is a NYSED-approved provider for LMSWs, LCSWs, LMFTs, LMHCs and licensed psychologists; ASWB ACE approval is not mentioned, so licensees from other states should check with their board.

Keynote speakers, fees and the registration link were not published yet; the chapter says early-bird pricing is planned.

attributes.title: VAM27
attributes.summary:
The Society for Vascular Surgery holds VAM27 June 2 to 5, 2027, at the San Diego Convention Center, with the VQI meeting on June 1 and 2 and the Society for Vascular Nursing conference alongside. Registration and housing open March 3, 2027.

Early rates (March 3 to 24) are $995 for member surgeons and $1,825 for non-members, rising to $1,145 and $1,975 onsite. Reduced rates apply to residents, students and allied health staff.

SVS is ACCME-accredited and will offer AMA PRA Category 1 Credit and ABS self-assessment credit; the maximum will be posted when the program is final. Physician assistants receive a participation certificate they can use toward NCCPA requirements.

attributes.title: Musculoskeletal Galaxy 2027
attributes.summary:
AAPA lists Musculoskeletal Galaxy 2027 for June 3 to 6, 2027, in San Francisco, California. The conference is designed to give PAs and NPs a solid base in orthopaedics, whether they are new to the specialty or see musculoskeletal problems in family, emergency or urgent care practice.

So far only the dates and city have been published for 2027. The venue, faculty, CME and fees are not yet available; we will update this page when they appear.

attributes.title: APACVS 46th Annual Meeting
attributes.venue: DoubleTree by Hilton at the Entrance to Universal Orlando
attributes.organizer: Association of Physician Associates in Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery
attributes.summary:
The 46th Annual Meeting of the Association of Physician Associates in Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery runs June 3 to 6, 2027, at the DoubleTree by Hilton at the Entrance to Universal Orlando. Plenary tracks cover cardiac, congenital, thoracic and vascular surgery, critical care and CTV pharmacology, alongside a three-day Cardiac First Assist Course, a three-day Critical Care Boot Camp and a hands-on cardiac anatomy course.

The didactic sessions carry 22 hours of live CME and 52 hours in total with post-meeting access. Registration for them costs $550 for PA, NP, MD and DO members and $725 for non-members; residents, students and RNs pay $325 or $475. The hands-on courses are booked separately ($650 to $925). Early registration ends May 1, 2027, which is also the last day for refunds, less a $100 fee.

The group rate at the host hotel is $189 per night until May 12, 2027. Attendees who do not stay at least three nights at the hotel pay a $200 surcharge to receive their CME certificate and post-meeting lecture access. Abstracts are due December 1, 2026.

attributes.title: Eastern Allergy Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
An early-summer update for practicing allergists, June 3 to 6, 2027, at The Breakers. The conference page carries an ACCME accreditation statement, so physician credit is expected, but the 2027 credit total is not published yet.

The registration page still shows the previous edition, so 2027 fees are not published yet either. We will add them once the organizer updates that page.

attributes.title: PacVet 2027
attributes.summary:
PacVet 2027, the California VMA's 20th-anniversary Pacific Veterinary Conference, runs June 3 to 6, 2027, at the Town and Country Resort in San Diego. It is open to veterinarians, new graduates, RVTs, practice managers, hospital staff and students, with in-person, virtual and hybrid registration options.

Full four-day registration for veterinarians costs $625 (CVMA member, early) up to $865 (non-member, onsite); fees listed here are veterinarian rates, with lower prices for technicians, staff and students. Early registration opens November 16, 2026. Rooms at the resort are $269 per night until May 2, 2027.

attributes.title: Psych Congress Elevate 2027
attributes.credits_text: 16.75 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 16.75 ANCC CH · 16.75 ACPE
attributes.summary:
Psych Congress Elevate 2027 runs June 3 to 6, 2027, at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. It is aimed at early-career mental health clinicians: psychiatrists, nurse practitioners, PAs, psychologists and primary care physicians.

HMP Education designates the live activity for 16.75 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, with matching nursing and pharmacy contact hours; the enduring version with recorded content is designated for 31.75. Registration is open and the early bird rate runs until February 19, 2027. The Caesars Palace group rate is $189 a night Tuesday to Friday and $219 on weekend nights, plus a $45 daily resort fee, if booked before April 26. Registration fees were not shown on the rates page when we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 Summer Break Away & Annual Assembly
attributes.series: SCAFP Summer Break Away & Annual Assembly
attributes.organizer: South Carolina Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
South Carolina's family medicine academy returns to the Sonesta Resort on Hilton Head Island for its 2027 Summer Break Away and Annual Assembly, June 3 to 6. The meeting is open to family physicians, residents and other primary care clinicians, including those who practice outside South Carolina.

Residents present their work on Friday and Saturday, June 4 and 5. The academy says CME is offered but had not posted a credit total, fees or a schedule when we checked. SCAFP holds a discounted room block at the resort and says reservations open at the start of 2027.

attributes.title: SDVMA 2027 Summer Continuing Education Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 subject is ophthalmology, with 8 CE hours for every attendee and a hands-on wet lab option, so it suits a general practitioner who wants to sharpen one skill. Thursday evening is a social reception; the teaching is all on Friday.

Fees and full details are expected in early 2027. RACE status is not stated.

attributes.title: West Coast Symposium 2027
attributes.series: West Coast Symposium on Addictive Disorders
attributes.summary:
California addiction professionals get a specific reason to look here: the accreditation page lists CCAPP alongside APA, ASWB ACE and NBCC. The organizer advertises 20+ CME/CE credits for 2027, without a count per license yet.

California MFTs should wait, since the organizer says it will be applying for state pre-approval rather than holding it. The clinical rate ends January 29, 2027. Written cancellations by March 28 cost $150, and transfers are free through June 2.

attributes.title: 2027 ASCO Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ASCO Annual Meeting takes place June 4 to 8, 2027, at McCormick Place in Chicago.

Auditions for the ASCO Voices session are open until November 13. Registration, hotel and CME details for 2027 were not yet published on the page we checked.

attributes.title: ASE 2027 Scientific Sessions
attributes.summary:
The American Society of Echocardiography meets in Tampa for its 2027 Scientific Sessions, June 4 to 6, at the Tampa Convention Center. ASE builds the program for cardiologists and sonographers, and it also names pediatricians, anesthesiologists, point-of-care clinicians and nurses among the people it expects to attend.

Registration had not opened when we checked. The society offers an email alert for the opening date, and it had not yet posted fees, credit hours or hotel information. The 2027 call for abstracts was still open on the ASE site at the time of our check.

attributes.title: 2027 Connected Care Conference
attributes.summary: APTA Nevada, the Nevada Occupational Therapy Association and the Nevada Speech-Language-Hearing Association run this interprofessional meeting on June 4 (1-5 PM) and June 5 (8 AM-5 PM), 2027 at Las Vegas City Hall. Tracks cover patient- and family-centered care, interprofessional practice, technology, education, policy and research; the full agenda is due in April.

attributes.title: 2027 MDVMA Summer Conference
attributes.summary:
A beach weekend with CE hours attached. Mark the calendar: registration opens March 1, 2027, the early discount ends May 3, and registration closes May 30, ahead of the meeting itself.

Program details, CE totals and fee amounts are due in early 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 SNMMI Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: Society of Nuclear Medicine and Molecular Imaging
attributes.summary:
SNMMI lists its 2027 Annual Meeting for June 5 to 8, 2027, in Washington, D.C. The meeting serves physicians, scientists, pharmacists and technologists working in nuclear medicine and molecular imaging.

The venue, fees, registration and the continuing education statement are not published yet.

attributes.title: SLEEP 2027
attributes.summary:
SLEEP 2027, the joint meeting of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine and the Sleep Research Society, takes place June 6 to 9, 2027, at the Colorado Convention Center in Denver. The organizers describe a program spanning clinical sleep medicine, sleep and circadian research and sleep health.

Speakers, hotel details, fees and the continuing education statement are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 AOTA Adult Rehabilitation Specialty Conference
attributes.summary: AOTA runs this specialty conference virtually on June 7-8, 2027 for occupational therapy practitioners in adult rehabilitation. Planned topics include acute and inpatient rehab, outpatient and community reintegration, functional cognition, neurological rehabilitation, chronic conditions, and oncology, vision and vestibular rehab.

attributes.title: 2027 FSWA Annual Conference: Creating Pathways to Hope
attributes.series: Forensic Social Work Alliance Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Forensic Social Work Alliance meets June 7 to 10, 2027, at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas for its annual conference, "Creating Pathways to Hope". The program mixes plenaries, workshops, roundtables, posters and research presentations on social work in courts, corrections, child welfare and other legal settings.

FSWA is an ASWB ACE provider (#1823), and social workers who register for CE can earn up to 17.0 credits. The organization is also a New York State-approved CE provider for licensed social workers under its former name.

Participant fees were not published yet; registration runs through Whova. Abstracts are due November 15, 2026, and the discounted hotel rate is available until May 14, 2027.

attributes.title: SDPA Annual Summer Dermatology Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
SDPA's 2027 summer dermatology meeting takes place June 9 to 13, 2027, at the Sheraton Grand Chicago Riverwalk. It is one of the society's two yearly CME conferences for PAs working in dermatology.

SDPA says registration prices vary by membership type, with lower rates for members, but has not published amounts. Registration, the CME credit count and the program are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 TNA Annual Conference: Navigating New Horizons in Nursing
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Texas Nurses Association Annual Conference, "Navigating New Horizons in Nursing," takes place June 9 to 11, 2027, at the Omni Corpus Christi. A special track is planned for prelicensure nursing students.

Registration is open through TNA's education portal, and a discounted room block is available at the Omni. TNA's registration page lists the main program on June 10 and 11 with 10.25 contact hours from TNA's ANCC-accredited provider unit. Early-bird registration is $425 for members and $575 for nonmembers until February 28, 2027, against a full price of $675; LVNs pay $285, and prelicensure students pay $125 for the first day or $285 for both days.

attributes.title: 2027 AAOHN National Conference
attributes.organizer: American Association of Occupational Health Nurses
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Occupational Health Nurses runs its 2027 National Conference as an all-virtual event on three days: June 10, June 12 and June 15, 2027. Because there is no venue, occupational and employee health nurses can join from their own workplace or home.

AAOHN says continuing nursing education will be offered and that the total number of contact hours will be announced once the program is final. Fees and the session list were not published when we checked. AAOHN also lists a separate in-person Conference of Leaders in Chicago on April 5 and 6, 2027.

attributes.title: AHS 69th Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: American Headache Society Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
Headache specialists and neurologists meet at the Gaylord Pacific Resort in San Diego on June 10 to 13, 2027.

The society's CME portal shows AMA PRA Category 1 Credit for earlier meetings, with 25.25 credits for the live 2025 activity. Treat that only as a rough guide, since the 2027 total and fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 APNA Clinical Psychopharmacology Institute
attributes.summary:
The 2027 APNA Clinical Psychopharmacology Institute takes place June 10 to 13, 2027, in Reston, Virginia, with an online option. The program focuses on psychopharmacology for psychiatric-mental health nurses and advanced practice nurses.

APNA is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development. Its page states up to 30.25 pharmacology contact hours in one place and up to 31.25 in another; we list the lower figure until APNA confirms. The 2027 program and fees are still in development.

attributes.title: ISDA Annual Session 2027 (AS27)
attributes.summary:
The Idaho State Dental Association's 2027 Annual Session (AS27) takes place June 10 and 11, 2027, at Boise Centre East. The ISDA plans CE lectures, hands-on courses, special events, an exhibit hall and its Flossy 5K run.

The ISDA is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider. The course schedule, speakers, fees and credit hours are not published yet.

attributes.title: 69th Annual Family Medicine Seminar
attributes.cme_provider: New Mexico Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.organizer: New Mexico Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
The chapter has moved this meeting to June for 2027; last summer's seminar ran in August and listed a continuing medical education program covering dementia, alcohol use disorder, opioids and CGM use in primary care.

Credits, fees and the 2027 agenda are not published yet.

attributes.title: TOTA 2027 OT and PT Service Delivery in Schools: Policy, Research and Best Practices Conference
attributes.series: TOTA OT and PT Service Delivery in Schools Conference
attributes.summary: TOTA's day-and-a-half conference for school-based occupational and physical therapists runs June 10-11, 2027 at Region 10 ESC in Richardson, with online attendance possible. Topics include special education legal updates, evaluation and goal writing, equipment and restraint, and a new funding model. Registration opens in January 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 TLPCA Counseling and Therapy Summit
attributes.summary:
TLPCA spells out how summit hours relate to Tennessee rules. It is an NBCC provider, ACEP No. 6376, and its CE page reasons that the 2025 summit also met requirements for psychologists and social workers under their state boards. Confirm the same applies in 2027.

For LPC/MHSP licensees, the reminder that ten of twenty hours must be live, in-person sessions is the useful one; a two-day in-person summit addresses that directly. Fees and hours for 2027 are not published.

attributes.title: ASHP Pharmacy Futures 2027
attributes.summary:
ASHP Pharmacy Futures 2027 takes place June 12 to 16, 2027, at the Seattle Convention Center in Seattle, Washington. The meeting groups its education into learning communities, which in 2026 covered ambulatory care, informatics and digital health, leadership, medication safety, specialty pharmacy and the National Pharmacy Preceptors Conference.

ASHP has opened exhibitor booking for 2027, but the program, CE hours and registration fees have not been published yet. ASHP is an ACPE-accredited provider; we will add the credit details once they appear on the official site.

attributes.title: 40th NADONA National Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Directors of Nursing Administration (NADONA)
attributes.summary:
The 40th NADONA National Conference for directors of nursing and post-acute care leaders is set for June 13 to 16, 2027, at the South Point Casino and Resort in Las Vegas.

NADONA says sessions are submitted for nursing contact hours and for NAB credit for long-term care administrators; the total number of hours, registration fees and the program are not published yet. The call for presentations closes October 31, 2026.

attributes.title: APIC27 Annual Conference & Expo
attributes.cme_provider: Association for Professionals in Infection Control and Epidemiology (APIC)
attributes.organizer: Association for Professionals in Infection Control and Epidemiology
attributes.summary:
APIC27, the annual conference of the Association for Professionals in Infection Control and Epidemiology, runs June 14 to 16, 2027, at the Los Angeles Convention Center. APIC lists more than 100 educational sessions plus an exhibit floor and networking events.

APIC is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development, so infection-prevention nurses can earn contact hours here; the number of hours for 2027 is not published yet.

Attendee registration opens December 8, 2026. The registration site shows member rates of $715 early-bird and $815 regular, and $305 for student members; nonmember prices and the early-bird deadline are not published yet.

attributes.title: WOCNext 2027
attributes.organizer: Wound, Ostomy, and Continence Nurses Society
attributes.summary:
WOC nurses and others in wound, ostomy, continence and foot care head to Savannah on June 14 to 16, 2027. The format mixes 30- to 90-minute sessions, ePosters and sponsored symposia. Among the symposia, only select sessions carry contact hours, so check before you sign up for one.

WOCN is a California BRN provider (CEP 15115), but the 2027 contact-hour total and the venue are not published yet. Registration opens mid-February 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 AANP National Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AANP National Conference takes place June 15 to 19, 2027, in New Orleans, Louisiana. AANP says registration opens in mid-December 2026; the venue, contact hours and fees have not been published yet.

The call for presentations for this conference is already closed, so the program is being assembled. We will add the CE contact hours, pharmacology hours and registration fees as soon as AANP announces them.

attributes.title: FLASHA 2027 Annual Convention
attributes.venue: Hilton Lake Buena Vista Disney Springs
attributes.organizer: Florida Association of Speech-Language Pathologists and Audiologists
attributes.summary: FLASHA holds its 2027 Annual Convention on June 16-19, 2027, at the Hilton Lake Buena Vista Disney Springs in Orlando. The in-person program for SLPs, audiologists, assistants and students is supplemented by pre-recorded virtual sessions available from June 20 to July 20. Attendees receive certificates of completion for the sessions they attend.

attributes.title: PPA2027 Annual Convention
attributes.summary:
The Pennsylvania Psychological Association holds PPA2027 at the Pittsburgh Airport Marriott, from Wednesday, June 16 to Saturday, June 19, 2027. The theme is "Single Impact, Infinite Echo," about how small clinical moments can lead to wider change. Hotel rooms can already be reserved, but registration has not opened yet.

PPA says attendees can earn up to 30 CE credits. These include the mandatory Pennsylvania topics: Act 31 child abuse recognition and reporting, suicide prevention and ethics. School psychologists receive Act 48 credit, and members get a significant discount. The fees and the session program are not published yet. The exhibitor registration page lists the exhibit dates as June 16 to 18, 2027.

attributes.title: EAA 2027 Summer Conference
attributes.summary: The Educational Audiology Association holds its 2027 Summer Conference, themed "CHEARS for 2027," on June 17-19, 2027, at the Hilton Rosemont / Chicago O'Hare. Valerie James Abbott is the announced keynote speaker. EAA lists registration as opening in February 2027.

attributes.title: ONL's 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.venue: The Omni Mount Washington Resort and Spa
attributes.cme_provider: Organization of Nurse Leaders - New England
attributes.organizer: Organization of Nurse Leaders - New England
attributes.summary:
The Organization of Nurse Leaders - New England holds its 2027 Annual Meeting on June 17 and 18, 2027, at the Omni Mount Washington Resort in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire. The program combines sessions with nationally known speakers, a vendor area and ONL's business meeting.

ONL is approved as a provider of nursing continuing professional development by ANA Massachusetts, an ANCC-accredited approver; the number of contact hours is not published yet. Registration is open at $499 for members and $749 for non-members, which includes a year of membership.

attributes.title: ADA 87th Scientific Sessions
attributes.summary:
The American Diabetes Association's 87th Scientific Sessions take place June 18 to 21, 2027, at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C. The meeting usually draws more than 12,000 researchers and clinicians.

Abstract submissions close January 5, 2027, at 5 p.m. ET. Registration and housing open in January; fees and CME details have not been published yet.

attributes.title: Internal Medicine for Primary Care: Addiction/Gyn/Vasc
attributes.series: MER Internal Medicine for Primary Care
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ABIM MOC · 6 ANCC CH
attributes.summary:
This MER course takes place June 18 to 20, 2027, at The Broadmoor in Colorado Springs. It covers addiction medicine, gynecology and vascular medicine for primary care clinicians.

MER lists 12 credit hours, including 6 ANCC pharmacotherapeutic contact hours, and says the course covers 4 hours of the MATE Act requirement. The early-bird fee is $995 until April 19, 2027; rooms at The Broadmoor start at $565 per night.

attributes.title: 2027 AWHONN Convention
attributes.organizer: Association of Women's Health, Obstetric and Neonatal Nurses
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AWHONN Convention is set for June 19 to 23, 2027, at Gaylord Opryland in Nashville, Tennessee. The meeting serves nurses working in obstetrics, women's health and neonatal care.

AWHONN lists only the dates and venue so far. Contact hours, registration fees and the program are not published yet. Later conventions are planned for Minneapolis in June 2028 and Kissimmee, Florida, in July 2029.

attributes.title: 2027 NASW National Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 NASW National Conference is scheduled for June 21 to 25, 2027, at the Oregon Convention Center in Portland. The theme is "Navigating Uncertainty. Strengthening Service. Influencing the Future." The Hyatt Regency Portland next to the convention center is the headquarters hotel.

NASW has posted in-person rates ahead of opening the registration site: NASW members pay $555 early bird, $620 regular and $760 on-site; non-members pay $810, $945 and $1,260; BSW and MSW student members pay from $265, and retired members from $280. Pre-conference workshops cost $145 for members and $195 for non-members. The proposal window closed on November 16, 2026. Virtual fees, the number of social work CE contact hours and the session program are not published yet.

attributes.title: AAHFN Annual Meeting 2027
attributes.organizer: American Association of Heart Failure Nurses
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Heart Failure Nurses meets in Boston, Massachusetts, for its 2027 Annual Meeting, listed on the official call for papers as June 23 to 25, 2027. The meeting is for nurses and advanced practice clinicians who manage patients with heart failure in hospitals, clinics and home care.

AAHFN is collecting abstracts in three tracks. Best Practices submissions close November 30, 2026, and Research and Quality Improvement submissions close December 15, 2026. Registration fees, the venue and contact hours had not been published when we checked.

attributes.title: 2027 AzVMA State Meeting
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Phoenix Scottsdale
attributes.summary:
A single 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. day in the Valley, convenient for Phoenix-area practitioners who cannot leave the clinic for long. AzVMA lists it under in-person events on its CE calendar.

Only the save-the-date is out, so CE hours, topics and fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: Connect4Success 2027
attributes.summary:
The Missouri Dental Association's Connect4Success (C4S) meeting runs June 24 to 26, 2027, at Margaritaville Lake Resort in Osage Beach on the Lake of the Ozarks.

The MDA hands out physical CE cards at the meeting and also uploads credits for every attended program to each attendee's ADA CE transcript within a week after the meeting. The 2027 program, fees and credit totals are not published yet.

attributes.title: Florida Dental Convention 2027 (FDC2027)
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Florida Dental Convention is scheduled for June 24 to 26, 2027, at the Gaylord Palms resort in the Orlando area. The Florida Dental Association runs it as a three-day program of education and exhibits for the entire dental team.

The FDA says FDC2027 will offer more than 150 courses where attendees can earn CE. The course catalog, registration fees and hotel details have not been published yet; we will add them once the association releases them.

attributes.title: 2027 GDA Annual Convention & Expo
attributes.summary:
The Georgia Dental Association holds its 2027 Annual Convention & Expo June 24 to 26, 2027, at the Omni Amelia Island Resort & Spa in Fernandina Beach, Florida. The program combines CE courses, an exhibit area with dental vendors and social events.

A "Save Your Seat" option opened at the 2026 convention and locks in 2026 pricing for a limited time. Standard registration, hotel rooms and the CE course list are expected in early 2027; fees and credit hours are not published yet.

attributes.title: MVMA 2027 Summer Meeting
attributes.summary:
The association calls itself Montana's leading CE provider for veterinarians and runs this as the second of its two yearly programs, so it is the natural summer option for in-state license hours, alongside a trade show.

Speakers, CE hours and fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: NASN 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The NASN 2027 Annual Conference for school nurses is held June 25 to 28, 2027, at the JW Marriott Indianapolis, with a preconference day on June 24.

NASN is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development and is also approved by the California Board of Registered Nursing (CEP 12292). Contact hours, fees and deadlines for 2027 have not been published yet; New Orleans hosts the 2028 conference.

attributes.title: Pri-Med Nashville 2027
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · AANP CE · AANP Pharm
attributes.summary: Pri-Med's Nashville regional conference takes place June 24 and 25, 2027. The page points attendees to the Music City Center but names the venue inconsistently, so check before booking. Up to 12.5 CME/CE credits are offered as AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and AANP contact hours. The early-bird rate is $85 and the advance rate $99; the page gives two different early-bird deadlines.

attributes.title: AROTA mOTivate 2027
attributes.summary: The Arkansas Occupational Therapy Association holds mOTivate 2027 at Arkansas State University in Jonesboro on June 25-26, 2027. Friday evening is the conference and awards dinner and Saturday is the education day. Full and Saturday-only registrations are offered.

attributes.title: Internal Medicine for Primary Care: Gastro/Neuro/Pain
attributes.series: MER Internal Medicine for Primary Care
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · ABIM MOC · 5.75 ANCC CH
attributes.summary:
MER's Nashville course runs June 25 to 27, 2027, at The Westin Nashville. Lectures cover gastroenterology, neurology and pain management in primary care.

The course carries 12 credit hours, including 5.75 ANCC pharmacotherapeutic contact hours, and MER says it covers 4 hours of the MATE Act requirement. The early-bird fee is $995 until April 26, 2027; rooms start at $329 per night.

attributes.title: PSHA 2027 Annual Convention (Diamond Jubilee)
attributes.summary: The Pennsylvania Speech-Language-Hearing Association marks its 60th year with a Friday-Saturday summer convention on June 25-26, 2027, at Duquesne University in Pittsburgh. This is a new venue and season for the meeting. Online registration for professionals and students opens March 15, 2027, and a room block is available at the DoubleTree by Hilton in downtown Pittsburgh.

attributes.title: APTA Orthopedics 2027 Virtual Conference
attributes.organizer: APTA Orthopedics (Academy of Orthopaedic Physical Therapy)
attributes.summary: APTA Orthopedics runs its 2027 Virtual Conference online on Saturday, June 26, 2027. The program uses short formats such as 30-minute microlearning sessions plus posters aimed at orthopedic clinicians, educators and researchers; speaker proposals are due February 15, 2027.

attributes.title: ASMBS Annual Meeting 2027
attributes.venue: Walt Disney World Swan and Dolphin Resort
attributes.organizer: American Society for Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery
attributes.summary:
The American Society for Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery meets at the Walt Disney World Swan and Dolphin Resort in Orlando from June 27 to July 1, 2027. The theme for this edition is "Elevating Our Future, Enhancing Our Specialty."
