The meeting serves the metabolic and bariatric surgery field, with the program centered on obesity care. ASMBS had published the dates, venue and theme when we checked. Pricing, credit hours and travel details sit on separate tabs of the meeting site, so check them there before you register.

attributes.title: Pri-Med Southwest 2027
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · AAFP · AANP CE · AANP Pharm
attributes.summary:
Pri-Med Southwest runs June 28 to 30, 2027, at the George R. Brown Convention Center in Houston. Like the other Pri-Med annual meetings it is a broad primary care update for family and internal medicine clinicians.

Up to 19 CME/CE credits are available as AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and AANP contact hours, with pharmacology hours and AAFP Prescribed credit. The early-bird rate of $129 expires March 12, 2027, after which the advance rate is $165.

attributes.title: NAHN 52nd Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The National Association of Hispanic Nurses holds its 52nd Annual Conference from June 29 to July 1, 2027, in Detroit, Michigan. NAHN expects hundreds of nurses, nursing students, researchers and other health professionals to attend.

The association's page asks visitors to stay tuned for details. The venue, program, contact hours, fees and hotel arrangements had not been published when we checked.

attributes.title: NPACE 2027 Newport: Catching the Next Wave
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: NPACE holds its summer conference in Newport, Rhode Island, from June 29 to July 1, 2027, at the Wyndham Newport. The program covers current practice topics every advanced practice provider should know, and NPACE lists 18+ CE/CME credits. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists full conference registration at $1,050, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.

attributes.title: GAPA Summer 2027 CME/CE Conference
attributes.summary:
The Georgia Association of Physician Assistants holds its 2027 summer CME conference July 1 to 3, 2027, at the Sandestin Golf & Beach Resort in Miramar Beach on Florida's Gulf Coast.

Registration is $600 for members, $800 for nonmembers, $750 to join and attend, and $550 for PA faculty. Rooms are booked with group code 24U51N until May 31, 2027. GAPA says the meeting offers CME credit but has not published the number of credits or the agenda yet.

attributes.title: AOSSM Annual Meeting 2027
attributes.venue: Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center
attributes.organizer: American Orthopaedic Society for Sports Medicine
attributes.summary:
The American Orthopaedic Society for Sports Medicine brings its 2027 Annual Meeting to Boston, July 7 to 10, at the Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center. The meeting is aimed at orthopaedic surgeons who treat sports injuries, and the program is built from submitted abstracts and instructional courses.

AOSSM had posted only the dates and venue for 2027 when we checked. The abstract window for this edition has closed, with decisions due in early 2027. Fees, credit hours and hotel blocks should appear on the society's meeting site closer to the date.

attributes.title: AGD2027 Annual Dental Conference
attributes.summary:
AGD2027, the Academy of General Dentistry's annual Scientific Session, takes place July 8 to 10, 2027, in Chicago and marks the AGD's 75th anniversary. AGD says the meeting offers more than 100 hours of CE to choose from, plus hands-on workshops, and attendees can work toward FAGD, MAGD or LLSR.

Registration fees, the venue and hotel details for 2027 have not been published on the meeting page yet.

attributes.title: RDH Under One Roof 2027
attributes.summary:
RDH Under One Roof 2027, the 27th edition of this hygienist-focused conference, runs Thursday to Saturday, July 8 to 10, 2027, at the Gaylord Opryland Resort in Nashville. The program is built entirely around dental hygiene education, with an exhibit hall of more than 125 companies.

A full-conference pass costs $480 (military $400, students $330) and earns up to 20 CE credits; one-day passes cost $225 (up to 7 credits) and two-day passes $400. EndeavorB2B is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider, an AGD PACE provider and an American Academy of Dental Hygiene approved provider. Credit codes must be claimed within one year.

attributes.title: GSHP Summer Meeting 2027
attributes.summary:
The Georgia Society of Health-System Pharmacists holds its 2027 Summer Meeting July 9 to 11, 2027 at the Omni Amelia Island Resort on Florida's Amelia Island. The society has already booked the same resort for the 2028 summer meeting, July 14 to 16.

Like the spring and fall meetings, it gives hospital and health-system pharmacists in Georgia a chance to earn live hours in person, this time in the middle of the year.

GSHP had posted only dates and venue when we checked. Watch the society's site for the agenda, ACPE hours and registration.

attributes.title: National Nurse Practitioner Symposium 2027
attributes.cme_provider: AKH, Inc., Advancing Knowledge in Healthcare
attributes.summary:
The National Nurse Practitioner Symposium returns to Keystone, Colorado, from July 14 to 17, 2027, with a welcome reception the evening of July 13. The program is written for nurse practitioners and other advanced practice providers, and the organizers present it as family-friendly, so many attendees bring a spouse or children to the mountain resort.

The activity is planned with AKH, Inc. under joint accreditation by ACCME, ACPE and ANCC, and it is also approved through AANP and AAPA. The site says ACNM and NAPNAP accept the credits as well. The 2027 credit totals, fees and hotel details had not been posted when we checked, though a registration portal for 2027 was already linked.

attributes.title: Bridging Smiles: The West Virginia-Virginia Dental Meeting 2027
attributes.series: Bridging Smiles: The West Virginia-Virginia Dental Meeting
attributes.summary:
Bridging Smiles, the joint West Virginia-Virginia Dental Meeting, takes place July 15 to 17, 2027, at The Greenbrier Resort in White Sulphur Springs, West Virginia. It also serves as the West Virginia Dental Association's summer annual meeting, and the Virginia Dental Association promotes it as a save-the-date.

The WVDA states that CE credits are available. The program, fees and credit hours have not been published yet.

attributes.title: LPA Annual Convention & Trade Show 2027
attributes.series: Louisiana Pharmacists Association Annual Convention & Trade Show
attributes.summary:
The Louisiana Pharmacists Association plans its 2027 Annual Convention and Trade Show for July 15 to 17, 2027, at the DoubleTree by Hilton in Lafayette, Louisiana.

LPA is an ACPE-accredited provider, and its convention faculty guide describes CE sessions with separate objectives for pharmacists and pharmacy technicians. The 2027 program, CE hours, fees and hotel details have not been published yet.

attributes.title: AVMA Convention 2027
attributes.summary:
AVMA Convention 2027 takes place July 16 to 20, 2027, in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The convention gathers veterinarians, veterinary technicians, students and practice managers for CE, networking and special events.

Registration has not opened yet; AVMA members get reduced rates. The venue, program and fees for 2027 have not been published on the convention page.

attributes.title: ASCA 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The American School Counselor Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference July 17 to 20, 2027, at the Greater Columbus Convention Center in Columbus, Ohio. ASCA says registration and hotel booking open in February 2027, and the featured speakers are still to be announced.

Early rates apply from February 1 to March 1, 2027. They are $449 for members, $349 for student and retired members and $649 for non-members. Afterwards the rates rise to $499, $399 and $699. A one-day pass costs $219, or $239 after March 1.

ASCA says attendees can earn CEUs, contact hours or graduate credit. The approving bodies and total hours for 2027 are not published yet, so school counselors should check with their state licensing or certification board.

attributes.title: 114th NDA Annual Convention
attributes.summary:
The 114th National Dental Association Annual Convention takes place Thursday, July 22 to Sunday, July 25, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Chicago. NDA describes four days of continuing education, leadership development, advocacy and networking for dentists, students and partners.

The CE program, credit hours, accreditation statement and fees for 2027 have not been published yet.

attributes.title: Pri-Med Charleston 2027
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · AANP CE · AANP Pharm
attributes.summary: Pri-Med's Charleston regional conference runs July 22 and 23, 2027, at the Charleston Marriott in South Carolina. It offers up to 13 CME/CE credits for primary care clinicians. Early-bird registration is $85 until April 2, 2027 and $99 after that.

attributes.title: 2027 TPA Conference & Expo
attributes.venue: Marriott Dallas Allen Hotel & Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The Texas Pharmacy Association holds its 2027 Conference & Expo from July 23 to 25, 2027, at the Marriott Dallas Allen Hotel & Convention Center in Allen, north of Dallas. The weekend brings Texas pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and student pharmacists together for education, an expo hall and networking.

TPA advertises CE credit at its annual conference, but the 2027 CE hours, program and registration fees have not been published yet. We will update this page when TPA opens registration.

attributes.title: ARIN 2027 Conference
attributes.summary:
The Association for Radiologic & Imaging Nursing holds its 2027 Conference from July 25 to 28, 2027, in San Jose, California. The meeting is for nurses who work in interventional radiology, diagnostic imaging, CT and MRI suites and related procedural areas, where sedation, contrast safety and procedural care are core topics.

ARIN says more details are coming soon. The venue, fees, contact hours and hotel arrangements for 2027 had not been posted when we checked; only exhibitor and sponsorship options were available.

attributes.title: 45th Annual National Pharmacy Technician Convention
attributes.series: AAPT Annual National Pharmacy Technician Convention
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Pharmacy Technicians holds its 45th national convention from July 29 to 31, 2027, at the Sundial Resort & Spa on Sanibel Island, Florida. People can attend on site or join virtually; virtual attendees get access to the session recordings for a short period afterwards.

AAPT advertises 9 continuing education credits for the convention. The convention page does not name the accrediting body or give ACPE activity numbers, so check the CE details with AAPT if your state board needs ACPE-accredited hours.

The full package was listed at $385 (marked down from $490) when we checked, with a $90 discount for Elite members and a group offer for teams. A $75 guest pass covers meals and amenities but no CE. Hotel rates and a detailed schedule were not published yet.

attributes.title: NBNA 55th Annual Institute and Conference
attributes.summary:
NBNA's 55th meeting runs August 3 to 8, 2027, in New Orleans. Past programs have covered cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes, HIV/AIDS, kidney disease and women's health, with more than 1,200 nurses and students attending, so there is usually something for most specialties.

NBNA says its CE units have been provided by the Pennsylvania State Nurses Association. Registration details, 2027 hours and fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 NDVMA Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The North Dakota VMA's 2027 Annual Meeting is planned for August 5 to 7, 2027, at the Bismarck Hotel in Bismarck. NDVMA lists it under its CE events and calls it the main conference for North Dakota veterinarians, practice managers, technicians and veterinary students.

Only the save-the-date is online. NDVMA says meeting details will be posted in June 2027 and exhibitor information in March 2027; CE hours, fees and the program are not published yet.

attributes.title: Nebraska State Trauma Symposium
attributes.venue: UNL Nebraska Innovation Campus Conference Center
attributes.summary:
This is a save-the-date for now. UNMC describes the symposium as accredited continuing education for physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses and EMS, so a whole trauma team from one facility could attend together.

Credit types, hours, fees and the program are not published yet.

attributes.title: ARN's 2027 Rehabilitation Nursing Conference
attributes.summary:
ARN's 2027 Rehabilitation Nursing Conference is a hybrid event: live virtual sessions on July 29 and 30, 2027, followed by the in-person meeting in New Orleans on August 7 to 9, 2027. Recordings of both parts stay available on demand through the end of the year.

The Association of Rehabilitation Nurses is accredited by ANCC as a provider of continuing nursing education, and the conference is built around earning CE in both formats. The venue, number of contact hours and registration fees are not published yet; ARN mentions group discounts for members and non-members.

attributes.title: 2027 AMSN Convention
attributes.summary:
The Academy of Medical-Surgical Nurses holds its 2027 convention August 10 to 12, 2027, in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The convention is the main annual gathering for medical-surgical nurses.

So far AMSN has published only a save-the-date. The venue, contact hours and registration fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: Pri-Med Philadelphia 2027
attributes.credits_text: AMA PRA Cat 1 · AANP CE · AANP Pharm
attributes.summary: Pri-Med's Philadelphia regional conference runs August 10 and 11, 2027, at the Pennsylvania Convention Center. Up to 13 CME/CE credits are offered as AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and AANP contact hours, with AAFP credit still being determined. Early-bird registration is $85 until April 23, 2027, then $99.

attributes.title: APA 2027 Convention
attributes.summary:
The American Psychological Association holds its 2027 convention on August 12 to 14, 2027, in San Francisco, with a virtual option, according to APA's convention site. Later conventions are already scheduled for Chicago (2028), Washington, DC (2029), San Diego (2030) and Atlanta (2031).

At the 2026 convention APA offered one-hour CE sessions for psychologists that were included in the in-person registration fee, plus separately priced three-hour preconvention CE workshops. The 2027 venue, CE session list, credit totals and registration fees are not published yet; the call for proposals for 2027 opens soon.

attributes.title: 2027 FNPN Annual Conference: There's No Place Like FNPN
attributes.series: Florida Nurse Practitioner Network Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
Florida NPs can build a schedule around six tracks in Orlando, August 12 to 14, 2027: pharmacology, acute care, aging health, business, metabolic health and leadership. The draft agenda credits sessions individually, with 0.5 CE for podium talks and 2.0 for preconference workshops, but a conference total and fees are not published yet.

If you want to present, abstracts for workshops, podium talks and posters are due January 30, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 Adaptive Sports Medicine Symposium
attributes.series: Nationwide Children's Adaptive Sports Medicine Symposium
attributes.summary: Nationwide Children's Hospital holds its Adaptive Sports Medicine Symposium on August 13, 2027, 8 AM to 5 PM, at its Education Center in Columbus. The hospital lists physicians, nurses, athletic trainers, OTs, PTs, advanced practice providers, recreational therapists, social workers and psychologists as the audience. Registration closes August 6, 2027.

attributes.title: NPACE 2027 Chicago: The Great APP Exchange & Expo
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: NPACE's Chicago conference runs August 16 to 19, 2027, at the InterContinental hotel and is paired with NPACE's APP Connect Expo, which brings together employers, schools, technology vendors and pharmacology updates. NPACE lists 18+ CE/CME credits for the conference itself. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists full conference registration at $1,250 (the APP Connect Expo alone is $99); staying three or more nights at the conference hotel takes $150 off, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.

attributes.title: 158th SCDA Annual Session
attributes.venue: Hilton Beachfront Resort & Spa Hilton Head Island
attributes.summary:
The South Carolina Dental Association's 158th Annual Session is listed for August 18 to 21, 2027, at the Hilton resort on Hilton Head Island; the session website gives the main program dates as August 19 to 21. The association says the meeting draws about 1,200 people a year: dentists, hygienists, assistants, office staff and students.

The program includes classes and workshops with invited speakers. The 2027 agenda, fees and CE hours have not been published yet.

attributes.title: Keystone Veterinary Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The Pennsylvania VMA's Keystone Veterinary Conference 2027 is scheduled for August 19 to 22, 2027, at Wind Creek in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. The association advertises more than 20 CE hours; it does not say on the page whether they are RACE-approved.

Fees, housing and the program for 2027 have not been posted yet.

attributes.title: 2027 Southwest Dental Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Southwest Dental Conference is hosted by the Dallas County Dental Society in Dallas. The official registration page lists on-site registration hours for Thursday August 19, Friday August 20 and Saturday August 21, with 2027 deadlines, so we show August 19 to 21, 2027; confirm the dates with the organizer.

All courses are ticketed. Registration opens in March 2027; a $50 late fee applies after July 12, 2027, and the refund deadline is July 23, 2027. The Hilton Anatole Dallas is the headquarters hotel. DCDS is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider and grants one credit per hour unless noted. Fees and the course brochure are not published yet.

attributes.title: Fetch Kansas City Veterinary Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
Fetch Kansas City 2027 runs August 20 to 22, 2027, at the Kansas City Convention Center. dvm360 promises more than 80 CE sessions in small-classroom format, planned with the entire veterinary team in mind, plus an exhibit hall.

The event page does not yet list registration prices, CE hour totals or hotel blocks. Practice owners can apply for a separate VSS Priority Pass built around scheduled vendor meetings, which needs a refundable deposit.

attributes.title: WVC Nashville 2027
attributes.summary: WVC Nashville 2027 is scheduled for Saturday to Tuesday, August 21 to 24, 2027, in Nashville, Tennessee, according to Viticus Group. The venue, CE hours and fees have not been announced yet; we will update this page when the organizer publishes them.

attributes.title: 2027 EMDRIA Conference
attributes.summary:
Worth noting for EMDR clinicians who are building toward certification: EMDRIA says sessions can count both for licensure boards and for its own credentialing, two buckets that do not always overlap. Trainer and Consultant Day runs on August 26, the day before the main program.

For 2027, the venue, hour totals and fees are not published yet. EMDRIA has been listed as an NBCC approved provider, ACEP No. 5757; check the current statement once the program appears. A separate virtual summit runs April 16 to 17, 2027.

attributes.title: ASCIP 2027 Annual Conference & Expo
attributes.organizer: Academy of Spinal Cord Injury Professionals
attributes.summary: The Academy of Spinal Cord Injury Professionals holds its 2027 Annual Conference and Expo on September 5-8, 2027 in Philadelphia. The academy includes a Therapy Leadership Council alongside nursing, medicine and psychosocial sections; a call for abstracts is open and further details are to come.

attributes.title: AACC World Conference 2027
attributes.cme_provider: American Association of Christian Counselors (ACEP No. 7543)
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Christian Counselors holds its World Conference from September 7 to 11, 2027, at Rosen Shingle Creek in Orlando, Florida, with registration opening the evening of September 6. General registration covers plenaries, track workshops and the exhibit hall; intensives and pre-conference workshops cost extra.

AACC is an NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider (ACEP No. 7543), and its CE statement lists APA-sponsored credit for psychologists through National Marriage Seminars of America, NAADAC approval and play therapy credit. The ASWB ACE approval shown on the statement runs to September 2026, so social workers should confirm it for 2027. CE hours by profession will be released with the track workshops.

Registration prices were not published on the conference pages when we checked; discounted rates exist for members, spouses and students.

attributes.title: PAINWeek 2027
attributes.summary:
PAINWeek 2027 is scheduled for September 7 to 10, 2027, at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas. The conference focuses on acute and chronic pain for frontline clinicians: physicians, pharmacists, nurse practitioners, PAs, nurses, psychologists and others.

Accreditation details for 2027 have not been published yet. For the 2026 meeting, PAINWeek offered credit through ACCME, ANCC, AAPA, ACPE (pharmacists), APA and ASWB, jointly provided by Partners for Advancing Clinical Education and Informa Connect. We will add the 2027 ACPE hours, program and fees once they are announced.

attributes.title: Cape Cod Symposium on Addictive Disorders 2027
attributes.series: Cape Cod Symposium on Addictive Disorders
attributes.summary:
Despite the name, the meeting now sits at the Rhode Island Convention Center in Providence. The organizer advertises 24+ CME/CE credits, and its accreditation page lists APA for psychologists, ASWB ACE for social workers, NBCC and NAADAC for counselors, plus New York MFT recognition.

The current rate ends December 11, 2026, nearly nine months before the meeting; the next price is not posted yet. Students, residents and fellows pay $199 but cannot claim CE. Groups of five or more get $100 off each new registration.

attributes.title: TNP 2027 Annual Conference and Skills Workshops
attributes.series: TNP Annual Conference and Skills Workshops
attributes.summary:
Texas Nurse Practitioners lists its 2027 Annual Conference and Skills Workshops for September 8 to 12, 2027, at the Kalahari Resort in Round Rock, Texas. The meeting combines general sessions for nurse practitioners with separately bookable skills workshops.

Registration, fees and contact hours had not been posted yet when we checked the TNP calendar.

attributes.title: Eastern Pulmonary Conference 2027
attributes.cme_provider: American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.summary:
A four-day pulmonary update at The Breakers, September 9 to 12, 2027, for chest physicians who want a smaller setting than a national congress.

The page names the American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology as the ACCME-accredited body. The credit total and fees are not published yet, so check back before planning your CME budget around it.

attributes.title: IVECCS 2027
attributes.series: International Veterinary Emergency & Critical Care Symposium
attributes.organizer: Veterinary Emergency and Critical Care Society
attributes.summary:
IVECCS 2027 takes place September 9 to 12, 2027, in Grapevine, Texas. The symposium is run by the Veterinary Emergency and Critical Care Society and advertises more than 37 hours of CE in emergency and critical care.

Registration is planned to open in late April 2027. The venue, program and fees have not been published yet.

attributes.title: MA-AUA 85th Annual Meeting
attributes.series: Mid-Atlantic Section of the AUA Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: Mid-Atlantic Section of the American Urological Association
attributes.summary:
Urologists in the Mid-Atlantic region meet in Baltimore on September 9 to 11, 2027. A section meeting is a smaller, closer-to-home alternative to the national AUA, and it is often easier for community practices to attend.

The section published an accreditation notice for its 2026 meeting. The 2027 credit total and fees are not published yet. For a rough budget, 2026 physician rates were $400 for active members and $425 for nonmembers.

attributes.title: TAPA 53rd Annual CME Conference
attributes.venue: Kimpton Santo San Antonio Riverwalk Hotel
attributes.summary:
The Texas Academy of PAs holds its 53rd Annual CME Conference from September 9 to 12, 2027, at the Kimpton Santo San Antonio Riverwalk Hotel in San Antonio. The conference brings together PAs and PA students from across Texas for CME, networking and the academy's annual awards.

TAPA has announced only the dates and hotel so far. The CME hours, program and registration fees have not been published yet.

attributes.title: Emergency Nursing 2027
attributes.summary:
Emergency Nursing 2027, the annual conference of the Emergency Nurses Association, is scheduled for September 15 to 18, 2027, at the Kansas City Convention Center in Missouri. It is an in-person meeting aimed at emergency department nurses, educators and leaders.

ENA has not published registration fees, contact hours, the program or hotel blocks yet; its event page offers a sign-up for registration and housing announcements. We will add those details when they appear.

attributes.title: AABP Annual Conference 2027
attributes.summary: The 2027 AABP Annual Conference for bovine practitioners is scheduled for September 16 to 18, 2027, in Louisville, Kentucky. The association's future-meetings page lists only the city and dates so far; venue, fees and CE details are still to come.

attributes.title: AAHA CON 2027
attributes.summary:
AAHA CON 2027 is scheduled for September 16 to 18, 2027, at the Gaylord National Resort & Convention Center in National Harbor, Maryland. The American Animal Hospital Association's conference brings small animal veterinarians and practice teams together for CE, networking and an exhibit floor.

The 2027 program and fees have not been published yet. For comparison, the 2026 conference in Portland had about 75 sessions.

attributes.title: 113th AAP Annual Meeting
attributes.series: American Academy of Periodontology Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 113th AAP Annual Meeting is scheduled for September 16 to 19, 2027, in Boston. The Academy has not yet published the venue, program, fees or CE total.

For reference, the 2026 meeting carried 30.25 ADA CERP credits and had registration categories and a symposium for dental hygienists; we will update this edition once AAP opens 2027 registration.

attributes.title: FPTA 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.series: FPTA Annual Conference & Assembly of Representatives
attributes.summary: The Florida Physical Therapy Association has posted a save-the-date for its 2027 Annual Conference, Thursday September 16 to Sunday September 19, 2027, at the Rosen Centre in Orlando. Program and registration details are not yet published.

attributes.title: Heartland Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Modeling, and Simulation in Cardiovascular Medicine
attributes.series: Heartland Conference on AI, Modeling, and Simulation in Cardiovascular Medicine
attributes.summary:
The first edition brings clinicians together with researchers, technologists and industry investigators, so expect more on how these tools are built and tested than a typical cardiology update. Topics run from prevention and screening through diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation.

UNMC calls it accredited continuing education, but credit types, hours and fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 NDDA Annual Session
attributes.summary:
The North Dakota Dental Association has scheduled its 2027 Annual Session for September 16 and 17, 2027 at Brewhalla in Fargo. The 2026 session took place in Bismarck.

The annual session is the association's main in-state continuing education event for dentists, and the association says more offerings for the whole dental team are coming.

No 2027 program, fees or CE hours were posted when we checked. The registration details on the page still refer to the 2026 meeting.

attributes.title: NLN Education Summit 2027
attributes.summary:
The National League for Nursing holds its 2027 Education Summit in person in Phoenix, Arizona, September 16 to 18, 2027. The summit is the main yearly meeting for nursing faculty and academic leaders.

NLN has posted a save-the-date only. The venue, contact hours and registration fees are not published yet.

attributes.title: KOTA Annual Conference 2027
attributes.summary: The Kansas Occupational Therapy Association has set its 2027 annual conference for September 17-18, 2027 in Manhattan, Kansas. Only the save-the-date has been posted so far; venue, program and fees are not yet announced.

attributes.title: TNOTA 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary: The Tennessee Occupational Therapy Association holds its 2027 annual conference in Knoxville on September 17-19, 2027. TNOTA has announced the dates, city and keynote speaker; venue, program and registration details will be posted later.

attributes.title: AAO-HNSF 2027 Annual Meeting & OTO EXPO
attributes.organizer: American Academy of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery
attributes.summary:
The AAO-HNSF 2027 Annual Meeting & OTO EXPO is set for Saturday, September 18 to Tuesday, September 21, 2027, in New Orleans. The academy notes these dates are subject to change.

The venue, program, fees and CME statement are not published yet.

attributes.title: FMX 2027
attributes.summary:
FMX 2027, the American Academy of Family Physicians' main annual meeting, takes place Monday to Friday, September 20 to 24, 2027, at the San Diego Convention Center. AAFP describes more than 250 education sessions, an expo hall and more than 40 hours of continuing education credit on offer.

Registration is open. AAFP members pay $865 through May 31, 2027, and $1,015 from June 1 to July 26; non-members pay $1,175 or $1,365. Residents who are members pay $100 and student members $50. The exact credit designation for 2027 has not been published yet; cancellations are refunded less a $50 fee until August 30, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 HPNA Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 HPNA Annual Conference takes place September 22 to 24, 2027, at the Renaissance Orlando at SeaWorld in Florida. It offers two days of education on clinical and emotional aspects of hospice and palliative nursing.

Registration opens in September, and attendees of the 2025 or 2026 conference receive an automatic loyalty discount. HPNA, an ANCC-accredited provider, will offer NCPD contact hours including pharmacotherapeutic hours; the totals and the fee amounts have not been published yet. Discounted rates run through July 15, 2027, and the conference hotel rate of $194 per night (plus tax and a $15 resort fee) is available until September 1, 2027.

attributes.title: 2027 ANPT Annual Conference
attributes.summary: The Academy of Neurologic Physical Therapy holds its 2027 Annual Conference from Thursday September 23 to Saturday September 25, 2027 in St. Louis, Missouri. The meeting focuses on neurologic physical therapy practice; recent editions combined education sessions, posters, networking and an exhibit hall.

attributes.title: APAO 30th Annual Oncology Symposium
attributes.series: APAO Annual Oncology Symposium for the Healthcare Provider
attributes.venue: San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter on the River Walk
attributes.organizer: Association of Physician Associates in Oncology
attributes.summary:
The 30th APAO Annual Oncology Symposium runs September 23 to 26, 2027, at the San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter on the River Walk. APAO aims it at PAs and the wider oncology team, including NPs, physicians, pharmacists and nurses, and it usually combines lectures with small hands-on workshops.

APAO marks CME credit as pending AAPA approval; the number of credits, the 2027 fees and the speaker list are not published yet, and registration shows as coming soon. The call for abstracts (45 to 60 minute talks on QI projects, research, practice pearls or supportive care) closes November 20, 2026.

attributes.title: 2027 Couples Therapy Conference
attributes.summary:
PESI's 2027 Couples Therapy Conference runs September 23 to 25, 2027, at the Westin Bonaventure in downtown Los Angeles and is streamed live online. The three days are devoted to couples work across therapy models, with live Q&A in most sessions.

PESI says CE credit is included with registration and that the program is designed for counselors, social workers, psychologists and marriage and family therapists, but the 2027 accreditation statements and hour totals were not published yet; its CE page lists the states where credit is only anticipated. Live attendees get credit only for workshops attended live, while the recording package offers self-study credit.

At the time we checked, the discounted in-person pass was $499.99 and the virtual pass $147.99, with a recording package available as an add-on.

attributes.title: ICOI/ADIA World Congress 2027
attributes.summary:
The ICOI/ADIA World Congress, held jointly with the American Dental Implant Association, takes place September 23 to 25, 2027, in Orlando, Florida. It is the ICOI's main yearly congress on implant surgery and restoration.

ICOI is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider and an AGD PACE provider. The venue, program, fees and credit hours have not been published yet.

attributes.title: MAPA Annual CME Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The Minnesota Academy of Physician Associates moves its annual fall CME conference to Stillwater, on the St. Croix River east of the Twin Cities, for 2027. The save-the-date lists Thursday, September 23, and Friday, September 24.

MAPA says the education will be submitted for AAPA approval, but the 2027 venue, credit total, fees and hotel had not been announced when we checked. The fees and hotel link on the page refer to the 2026 meeting at Breezy Point, so don't budget from them. The conference is a chance for Minnesota PAs to earn Category 1 CME and meet colleagues from around the state.

attributes.title: Mid-Continent Dental Congress 2027
attributes.summary:
The Mid-Continent Dental Congress is set for September 23 to 24, 2027, at St. Louis Union Station. The Greater St. Louis Dental Society runs it as a two-day meeting with lectures for dentists and hygienists and an exhibit hall.

Attendees get a code at the end of each course and download CE certificates from the meeting app or website. The 2027 program, fees and CE hours have not been published yet.

attributes.title: NASS 42nd Annual Meeting
attributes.venue: Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center
attributes.summary:
The North American Spine Society holds its 42nd Annual Meeting September 23 to 25, 2027, at the Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center in Boston. Abstract submission opens December 2, 2026.

Registration, fees and the 2027 CME statement are not published yet.

attributes.title: Clinical & Macro Conference 2027
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Maryland Chapter
attributes.summary:
NASW Maryland's Clinical & Macro Conference takes place on September 23 and 24, 2027, at The Maritime Institute conference center in Linthicum Heights. As the name says, the two-day program is built for both clinicians and macro practitioners working in community organizing, policy, administration and supervision.

The chapter has posted the dates and venue as a save-the-date. Session topics, fees and the number of continuing education hours are not yet listed. NASW Maryland labels its programs by Maryland CE category, and members get free or discounted CE at chapter events.

Social workers who need Category I hours, ethics or supervision content for a Maryland renewal should check the chapter page once the agenda is posted.

attributes.title: 2027 NCNA Annual Convention
attributes.summary:
The North Carolina Nurses Association's 2027 Annual Convention is scheduled for September 23 and 24, 2027, at the Benton Convention Center in Winston-Salem. The convention brings nurses from across the state together for education, networking and the association's business.

NCNA is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development and lists the CNE amount as to be determined. The program, fees and hotel details are not published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 New England Veterinary Conference
attributes.summary:
NEVMA's 2027 New England Veterinary Conference takes place in Portland, Maine, in late September 2027. The published 2027 schedule starts on Thursday, September 23 (invitation-only leadership day and wet labs) and continues with lectures through Sunday, September 26; the page banner reads September 24-27, so confirm the exact days before booking.

NEVMA's FAQ says the conference is not RACE-approved, but its credits are accepted automatically by all six New England states. Veterinary technicians and office staff may attend all educational sessions except labs reserved for veterinarians.

Attendee registration opens in June 2027; 2027 fees have not been announced.

attributes.title: 2027 VCS Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Veterinary Cancer Society holds its 2027 Annual Conference September 23 to 25, 2027 in St. Louis, Missouri. It is the society's main meeting for veterinary oncology.

Recent editions included pre-conference workshops, keynote talks, specialty sessions, research abstracts, a resident review workshop and technician workshops such as cytology for veterinary technicians. The society describes its community as clinicians, researchers, trainees, technicians and industry partners.

The 2027 venue, fees and CE hours were not posted when we checked. The society's calendar lists only dates and city so far.

attributes.title: 2027 IFS Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
This one returns to in-person format at Q Center west of Chicago after a virtual 2026 meeting; the institute has already said 2028 will be virtual again, so clinicians who want the room should note the alternating pattern.

The 2027 CE details and prices are not published. The in-person 2025 conference advertised up to 21 CEs, and the institute's other programs list APA and ASWB ACE credit, with state-by-state limits. Note that IFS credits toward certification and professional CE are counted separately.

attributes.title: 2027 Pacific Northwest Veterinary Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Pacific Northwest Veterinary Conference is scheduled for September 24 to 26, 2027, in Tacoma, Washington. The organizers advertise more than 150 CE hours and name veterinarians, technicians, practice managers and veterinary students as the audience.

Attendee registration opens May 1, 2027 (vendor registration opened November 1, 2026). The venue, fees, technician program and RACE status for 2027 are not published yet.

attributes.title: CPTA Annual Conference 2027
attributes.summary: The California Physical Therapy Association has set its 2027 Annual Conference, themed Fresh Ideas, Everyday Impact, for September 25-26, 2027 at the Hilton Costa Mesa. The association plans the conference program about 18 months ahead.

attributes.title: 2027 NCPA Annual Convention
attributes.summary:
The 2027 NCPA Annual Convention is scheduled for September 25 to 28, 2027, in San Antonio, Texas. It is the national meeting of independent community pharmacy, mixing business and clinical education, pre-convention workshops, a large expo, a poster symposium and a residency showcase.

NCPA is an ACPE-accredited provider. For the 2026 convention it offered up to 12 contact hours of continuing pharmacy education for community pharmacists and technicians. The venue, CE hours and fees for 2027 have not been published yet. Later conventions are planned for Louisville (2028) and San Diego (2029).

attributes.title: NASP inSPire 2027
attributes.summary:
NASP's 2027 annual conference, now branded inSPire, is scheduled for September 27 to 30, 2027, at the Gaylord Palms Resort & Convention Center in Orlando, Florida. The National Association of Specialty Pharmacy brings together specialty pharmacies, payers, manufacturers, health systems and patient groups, and its 2025 meeting drew more than 2,100 attendees.

CE details for 2027 have not been published yet. In 2026, pharmacists could earn 10.5 live ACPE contact hours in the main conference, up to 8 more in workshops and 1 in an accredited symposium, and NASP also offered CE for pharmacy technicians (ACPE), nurses and attorneys. Fees and the 2027 program will follow.

attributes.title: All Ohio Counselors Conference 2027
attributes.summary: The Ohio Counseling Association has moved the 2027 All Ohio Counselors Conference to an earlier slot, Wednesday September 29 to Friday October 1, 2027, at a new location, the Hilton Polaris in Columbus. The call for proposals runs from mid-January to mid-March; sessions, CE hours and fees will be added once they are posted.

attributes.title: 2027 APHON 51st Annual Conference and Exhibition
attributes.summary:
The Association of Pediatric Hematology/Oncology Nurses holds its 51st Annual Conference and Exhibition from September 29 to October 1, 2027, at the Pasadena Convention Center in Pasadena, California. The theme is "Heart & Science in Action." The meeting serves nurses who care for children and young adults with cancer and blood disorders.

The call for abstracts opens December 18, 2026. APHON lists three recommended hotels near the convention center: Hotel Dena and The Westin Pasadena at $239 per night and Hyatt Place Pasadena at $259 per night with breakfast, all before taxes and fees. Registration fees and contact hours had not been posted when we checked.

attributes.title: NPACE 2027: September Virtual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: A two-day live virtual conference from NPACE on September 29 and 30, 2027, pairing functional medicine with the business side of advanced practice. NPACE lists 12+ CE/CME credits. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists this virtual conference at $250, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.

attributes.title: KSHA Convention 2027
attributes.summary: The Kansas Speech-Language-Hearing Association lists its 2027 convention for September 30 to October 1, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency in Wichita. The association's convention serves speech-language pathologists and audiologists across Kansas. Program, fees and CE details for 2027 were not yet posted.

attributes.title: Southwest Veterinary Symposium 2027
attributes.summary:
SWVS 2027 is set for September 30 to October 3, 2027, at the Kay Bailey Hutchison Convention Center in Dallas. The symposium is a four-day continuing education meeting connected to the Texas Veterinary Medical Association.

The official site has not yet posted registration fees, CE hour totals or housing details for 2027; registration and hotel questions go to the organizer's Maritz contact.

attributes.title: Pediatric Vestibular Physical Therapy Workshop - October 2, 2027
attributes.venue: Children's Hospital Colorado, Conference Center - Mt. Princeton
attributes.summary: Children's Hospital Colorado's vestibular physical therapy team runs this in-person workshop on October 2, 2027, the third day of its Pediatric Vestibular Conference. Lectures and labs cover pediatric vestibular examination and treatment for intermediate-level PTs. The hospital lists 7.5 APTA credits and a $150 fee.

attributes.title: 2027 ACVS Surgery Summit
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ACVS Surgery Summit will be held at the Hyatt Regency Chicago. Hands-on laboratories are on October 6, 2027, followed by seminars and scientific abstract sessions from October 7 to 9.

ACVS plans to open abstract submissions in February 2027 with a deadline in May 2027, and exhibit sales also start in February. Registration fees and CE hours have not been published yet.

attributes.title: IDWeek 2027
attributes.summary:
IDWeek 2027 is scheduled for October 6 to 9, 2027, in Boston. The venue, program, fees and registration have not been published yet.

IDWeek is organized by IDSA and partner societies. For the 2026 meeting IDSA offered AMA PRA Category 1 Credit for physicians as well as nursing and pharmacy credit; the 2027 accreditation statement is not published yet, so no credit amount is listed here.

attributes.title: NANN 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The National Association of Neonatal Nurses meets October 6 to 8, 2027, in Las Vegas, Nevada, for its annual conference on neonatal intensive care nursing.

NANN lists only dates and city so far. The venue, contact hours and registration fees are not published yet. The 2028 conference is planned for Dallas.

attributes.title: 30th Annual NPWH Women's Healthcare Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Nurse Practitioners in Women's Health
attributes.summary:
NPWH has announced its 30th Annual Women's Healthcare Conference for October 6 to 8, 2027, at the St. Paul RiverCentre in St. Paul, Minnesota. The meeting is aimed at women's health nurse practitioners, other advanced practice nurses, students and leaders in women's and gender-related care.

So far only a save-the-date has been published. The program, CE contact hours and registration fees are not yet available; we will update this page when they appear.

attributes.title: Pri-Med Midwest 2027
attributes.summary: Pri-Med Midwest 2027 is scheduled for October 6 to 8, 2027, at the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Rosemont, Illinois, near Chicago. Credit details and 2027 fees have not been posted yet; the 2026 edition offered AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and AANP contact hours.

attributes.title: 41st Annual Veterinary Dental Forum
attributes.venue: America's Center Convention Center / Marriott St. Louis Grand
attributes.summary:
The 41st Annual Veterinary Dental Forum is scheduled for October 6 to 9, 2027, in St. Louis, Missouri, using America's Center Convention Center and the Marriott St. Louis Grand. The forum focuses on veterinary dentistry and oral surgery and is co-sponsored by the American Veterinary Dental College.

Registration, program and CE details for 2027 have not been released yet.

attributes.title: 2027 ANCC Magnet & Pathway Conference
attributes.summary:
ANCC has announced Orlando, Florida, as host of the 2027 Magnet & Pathway Conference, October 7 to 9, 2027. The meeting is aimed at nursing staff and leaders at Magnet-recognized and Pathway-designated organizations.

The venue, contact hours and registration fees for 2027 have not been published yet.

attributes.title: 2027 MI-ACP and SHM-MI Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: MI-ACP and SHM-MI Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.venue: Radisson Plaza Hotel at Kalamazoo Center
attributes.summary:
Michigan's ACP chapter and the state chapter of the Society of Hospital Medicine hold a joint Annual Scientific Meeting from Thursday, October 7, to Sunday, October 10, 2027. It takes place at the Radisson Plaza Hotel at Kalamazoo Center in downtown Kalamazoo. Because both groups plan it together, the program should suit office-based internists and hospitalists.

When we checked, the chapter had listed only the dates and venue. Program, credits, fees and hotel booking were not yet posted. The two chapters also hold a separate Resident and Medical Student Day on May 7, 2027, in Troy.

attributes.title: MiVetCon 2027
attributes.summary:
MiVetCon 2027, the Michigan VMA's fall conference, is set for October 8 to 10, 2027, at DeVos Place in Grand Rapids. The association says the agenda, speakers, registration and lodging details will be posted in summer 2027.

The 2026 edition was RACE-approved for 19 hours and had dedicated LVT registration rates for members and non-members; whether 2027 follows the same pattern is not published yet.

attributes.title: JFPS 2027
attributes.summary:
The Joint Federal Pharmacy Seminar returns to National Harbor, Maryland, on October 10 to 12, 2027, according to the meeting's official site. JFPS brings together pharmacists and pharmacy technicians who work in federal health systems, including the uniformed services, the VA and other federal agencies.

The American Pharmacists Association manages the meeting and has served as its continuing pharmacy education provider. The 2027 program, venue details, registration fees and the number of CPE hours have not been published yet.

Federal employees usually need approval to attend, so it is worth checking the organizer's justification materials once registration opens.

attributes.title: CASP Convention 2027
attributes.series: CASP Annual Convention (California Association of School Psychologists)
attributes.summary:
The California Association of School Psychologists has set its 2027 convention for October 12 to 15, 2027, in Costa Mesa, California. The association announced the dates and city right after its 2026 convention; the venue, program, registration and fees for 2027 had not been posted when we checked in November 2026.

CASP's convention is the main statewide gathering for school psychologists and licensed educational psychologists (LEPs) in California, along with other school-based mental health staff. The association reports that its convention drew more than 1,100 attendees from across the state, with workshops, paper presentations and an exhibit hall.

The CASP pages we checked do not state how many continuing education credits the 2027 convention will offer or which bodies approve them. School psychologists who need CE for a state license, an LEP license or NCSP renewal should confirm credit details with CASP once registration opens.

attributes.title: ASHT 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary: The American Society of Hand Therapists meets in Portland, Oregon in October 2027. Pediatric and Sports Specialty Days are on October 13, and the main annual meeting runs October 14-16. The meeting is aimed at hand therapists, occupational and physical therapists and other clinicians who treat the upper limb.

attributes.title: CAPC National Seminar 2027
attributes.summary:
Because this seminar runs only every two years, the next chance after Columbus is well off. It takes place October 13 to 15, 2027, and leans toward program operations, which makes it a good fit for palliative care medical directors and team leads.

CAPC says continuing education details will appear in 2027, and registration opens in early 2027, so credits and fees are not published yet. A full refund less a $150 fee is available through September 13, 2027.

attributes.title: Wild West Vet 2027
attributes.summary:
Wild West Vet 2027 is scheduled for October 13 to 16, 2027, at the Peppermill Resort Spa Casino in Reno, Nevada. It is aimed at veterinarians, veterinary technicians, practice owners and managers, students and other animal health professionals.

The organizer says attendees can earn up to 36 CE credits, pending RACE approval that it expects before the event. Prices rise in four steps by booking date: the conference pass costs $350 until February 28, 2027 and $575 in the last window to October 12; the technician pass runs $300 to $475, a one-day pass $199 to $349, and the student pass is always $99.

attributes.title: AAP Experience 2027 National Conference & Exhibition
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AAP National Conference & Exhibition (AAP Experience) is scheduled for October 15 to 19, 2027, at McCormick Place in Chicago, according to the academy's future dates page.

The program, fees and credit totals for 2027 have not been published yet. For reference, the 2026 meeting advertised up to 97 credits, but that figure has not been confirmed for 2027.

attributes.title: ADHA27 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
ADHA27, the annual conference of the American Dental Hygienists' Association, is set for October 15 to 17, 2027 in Phoenix, Arizona. The national association organizes it for dental hygienists, and it combines continuing education with networking and association events.

Registration had not opened when we checked. ADHA offers a "Phoenix First" sign-up that sends early news and priority access when registration opens. The venue, fees and CE hours have not been announced yet.

Hygienists who need hours before a fall 2027 license renewal should watch for the program release, since state boards differ on how many live hours they accept.

attributes.title: ANESTHESIOLOGY 2027
attributes.venue: Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center
attributes.summary:
ANESTHESIOLOGY 2027, the American Society of Anesthesiologists' annual meeting, runs October 15 to 19, 2027, at the Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center in Boston.

ASA is accepting submissions for the program. Registration, fees, housing and CME totals have not been announced yet.

attributes.title: 2027 CAPA Annual CME Conference
attributes.series: Colorado Academy of PAs Annual CME Conference
attributes.summary:
The Colorado Academy of Physician Associates holds its 2027 annual CME conference October 15 to 17, 2027, at the Telluride Conference Center. The academy describes two and a half days of live sessions plus on-demand lectures attendees can watch later.

The host hotel, The Peaks Resort & Spa, offers $219 per night plus taxes and fees until September 23, 2027. Registration, fees, the CME credit count and the agenda are not published yet.

attributes.title: School Social Work Symposium 2027
attributes.series: NASW Maryland School Social Work Symposium
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Maryland Chapter
attributes.summary:
NASW Maryland's School Social Work Symposium is set for Friday, October 15, 2027, and will be held virtually. The chapter has published the date as a save-the-date on its continuing education page; topics, fees and CE hours were not yet listed when we checked.

The symposium is aimed at social workers in public and private schools, who deal with student mental health, attendance, special education teams, crisis response and family engagement. A one-day online format fits the school calendar and lets staff attend without leaving their district.

NASW Maryland labels its programs by Maryland CE category, and members receive free or discounted CE at chapter events. School social workers licensed outside Maryland should confirm that their board accepts the chapter's CE before registering.

attributes.title: NYSSPA 2027 CME Conference
attributes.organizer: New York State Society of Physician Associates
attributes.summary:
The New York State Society of Physician Associates holds its 2027 CME Conference from Friday, October 15, to Sunday, October 17, 2027, at the Albany Capital Center in downtown Albany. CME is scheduled on all three days.

NYSSPA is collecting presentation proposals until January 31, 2027. The program, CME hours and registration fees have not been published yet. Parking at the Albany Capital Center costs $12 per car per day.

attributes.title: 2027 ACCP Global Conference on Clinical Pharmacy
attributes.series: ACCP Global Conference on Clinical Pharmacy
attributes.summary:
The American College of Clinical Pharmacy lists its 2027 Global Conference on Clinical Pharmacy for Saturday, October 16, to Tuesday, October 19, 2027, in New York City. The official meeting location and hotel is the New York Hilton Midtown.

ACCP's fall meeting usually combines clinical pharmacy education, research presentations and board certification sessions. For 2027 the program, CE hours and registration fees have not been published yet; we will add them when ACCP posts the meeting site.

attributes.title: Clinical Congress 2027
attributes.summary:
The American College of Surgeons lists Clinical Congress 2027 for Saturday, October 16 to Tuesday, October 19, 2027, in San Diego. Hotel information is available through the college's housing provider.

The venue, fees, registration and accreditation statement are not published yet. The call for abstracts, videos and posters is expected to open in December 2026.

attributes.title: AMCP Nexus 2027
attributes.summary:
AMCP Nexus 2027 is scheduled for October 18 to 21, 2027, at the Marriott Orlando World Center in Orlando, Florida, according to AMCP's list of future meetings. Nexus is the Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy's fall meeting for pharmacists and other professionals working in health plans, PBMs and the pharmaceutical industry.

The 2026 edition advertised more than 30 CE-accredited sessions on formulary development, value-based care, biosimilars and real-world evidence. For 2027, the program, CE hours and registration fees have not been published yet; we will add them when AMCP opens the 2027 site.

attributes.title: TCT 2027
attributes.summary:
The Cardiovascular Research Foundation has set TCT 2027 for October 18 to 21, 2027, at the Moscone Center in San Francisco. The 2026 edition was held in San Diego.

As in past years, TCT is expected to focus on coronary, structural heart and peripheral vascular intervention, with live cases, late-breaking trials and sessions for interventional teams. The organizer has not yet posted the program, registration fees or the number of CME credits for 2027.

We will add pricing, credit totals and registration details once CRF publishes them on the official TCT site.

attributes.title: Pri-Med East 2027
attributes.summary: Pri-Med East 2027 is scheduled for October 20 to 22, 2027, according to Pri-Med's Providence conference page; the 2026 edition was held at the Rhode Island Convention Center. Registration for 2027 is already open: a launch rate of $89 ran until October 16, 2026, and the early-bird rate is now $129. Credit amounts and the early-bird deadline for 2027 have not been published. Pri-Med East has offered AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, AANP contact hours and Massachusetts nursing contact hours.

attributes.title: 52nd Annual PSPA Fall CME Conference
attributes.summary:
PSPA's 52nd Fall CME Conference is planned for October 20 to 23, 2027, at the Bayfront Convention Center in Erie, Pennsylvania, with the Courtyard by Marriott Erie Bayfront named alongside it on the society's list of future meetings.

CME credits, fees, hotel rates and the program are not published yet.

attributes.title: CSWE 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Council on Social Work Education holds its 2027 Annual Conference October 21 to 24, 2027, in Long Beach, California. The meeting used to be called the Annual Program Meeting. It brings together educators, students, administrators and practitioners from the more than 900 CSWE-accredited social work programs, with hundreds of sessions in more than 40 topic tracks.

Six pre-conference institutes and summits run on the Wednesday and Thursday before the conference opens on Thursday evening. Each needs its own registration, and where an event offers CE credit, the cost is included in its fee. At the main conference CE is available only for selected sessions, and some presentations count toward ethics and values credit. The 2027 venue, fees and CE details are not published yet. Later conferences are planned for Chicago (2028) and Columbus, Ohio (2029).
